A Small App for Enhanced Privacy & Security
 Memory Guardian is a lightweight Android app that enhances user privacy and security by automatically clearing the clipboard at set intervals. This helps protect sensitive information, like passwords, from potential leaks to other applications.
 Key Features: 
 Automatic Clearing: Set customizable intervals for automatic clipboard clearing.
 Manual Clearing: Use the "Clear" button for immediate action.
 Clipboard Editing: Edit clipboard content directly within the app for quick adjustments.
 Notifications: Get notified when the clipboard is cleared.
 Dark Mode: Switch between light and dark themes for a personalized experience.
 Tiny: The app is small in size and does not consume much storage space.
 No Permissions: Memory Guardian does not require any permissions to function, ensuring user privacy.
 No Ads: Enjoy an ad-free experience with no interruptions.
 Minimalistic: Experience a clean and clutter-free interface for a distraction-free user experience.
 Open Source: Contribute to the project and help improve the app for everyone.

izzyondroid:com.cogwheel.LuCIMobile.name: LuCI Mobile
izzyondroid:com.cogwheel.LuCIMobile.summary: Manage your OpenWrt router from your phone.
izzyondroid:com.cogwheel.LuCIMobile.description:
Take full control of your OpenWrt router with LuCI Mobile. Our app offers a modern, intuitive interface to securely manage your home network from anywhere.
 Designed for both power users and network enthusiasts, LuCI Mobile simplifies router management without sacrificing functionality.
 Key Features: 
 Multiple Router Management: Add, switch, and manage any number of OpenWrt routers. Each router’s data is kept separate and secure.
 Real-Time Dashboard: Instantly view system status, performance metrics, and uptime with interactive charts.
 Complete Network Management: Monitor all wired and wireless interfaces, track bandwidth usage, and check IP configurations.
 Detailed Client Oversight: See a live list of all connected devices with their IP/MAC addresses, hostnames, and active connection times.
 Wireless Configuration: Edit SSIDs, security, channel, width and country code, and add or remove networks on any radio.
 Firewall & Routing: Manage port forwards, traffic rules, zones and static routes.
 Per-Client Control: Reserve a DHCP address, block a device with a firewall rule, or wake a sleeping one over the network.
 Services & Add-ons: Start, stop and restart services, and configure SQM, adblock, UPnP and DDNS.
 Diagnostics: Run ping, traceroute and nslookup from the router, and read its system and kernel logs.
 Activity & Alerts: Keep a feed of what changed on the network, with optional background notifications on Android.
 Powerful System Control: Edit the hostname, timezone and description, change the router password, and reboot with a single tap.
 Safe Changes: Configuration edits use the router's own apply-with-rollback protocol, so a change that cuts off your connection is undone by the router itself.
 Secure & Flexible Connection: Connect via HTTP or HTTPS, with support for self-signed certificates and secure credential storage.
 Modern UI: Enjoy a clean experience with Material Design 3, including full support for light and dark themes.
 Requirements: 
 This app requires an OpenWrt router with the LuCI web interface enabled. For remote access, ensure your router's firewall is configured correctly.
 Support & Source Code: 
 LuCI Mobile is an open-source project. For support, to report issues, or to view the source code, please visit our GitHub repository:
 https://github.com/cogwheel0/luci-mobile
 Email: cogwheel@cogwheel.app
 Disclaimer: This is an independent, third-party application licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPLv3) and is not officially affiliated with the OpenWrt project.

izzyondroid:com.philkes.notallyx.summary: A simple and minimalistic open source notes app
izzyondroid:com.philkes.notallyx.description:
NotallyX is a minimalistic note taking app with a simple design and powerful features.
 Organization 
• Create rich text notes with support for bold, italics, mono space and more
• Create task lists and order them with subtasks
• Set reminders with notifications for important notes
• Complement your notes with any type of file such as pictures, PDFs, etc.
• Sort notes by title, last modified date, creation date
• Display the notes either in a List or Grid
• Color, pin and label your notes for quick organisation
• Add clickable links to notes with support for phone numbers, email addresses and web urls
• Actions to quickly remove checked tasks
• Undo/Redo actions
• Extensive preferences to adjust views to your liking
• Quickly share notes by text
• Lock your notes via Biometric/PIN
• Configurable auto-backups
• Create audio notes
• Adaptive android app icon
• Support for Lollipop devices and up
 Convenience 
• Dark mode
• Completely free (+ no Ads!)
• Adjustable text size
• Auto save and auto-backups (optionally password-protected)
• Add notes and lists to your home screen with widgets
• Import from other Notes apps such as Evernote, Google Keep or plain text files
 Privacy 
There are no ads, trackers or analytics of any kind. All your notes are stored completely on and never leave your device.
 Optional Permissions 
• Show Notifications, Run Foreground Service: To display a notification if a backup fails or if reminders are triggered
• Schedule exact Alarms: To schedule reminder notifications at exact date-times
• Prevent Phone from Sleeping, Run at Startup: Used by the auto backup feature to ensure backups keep happening even if your phone is restarted
• Record audio: when recording an audio note
• Use Biometrics: if Biometric/PIN app lock setting is enabled, to unlock the app
 Note 
Due to a bug on Xiaomi's part, some MiUI devices might not be able to access the text formatting options.

fdroid:ace.software.pocketsense.name: Pocket Sense
fdroid:ace.software.pocketsense.summary: Private, offline money tracker in English and Arabic, in 100 currencies
fdroid:ace.software.pocketsense.description:
Pocket Sense tracks your income, spending, accounts, budgets, bills, loans and savings circles without signing up and without the internet. Everything stays on your phone in an encrypted database. It leaves only as an encrypted backup, or, if you turn on sync, encrypted to your own paired devices on your Wi-Fi.
 Private by design No sign-in, no servers, no ads, no analytics. The network is used only to sync with your own devices on your local network, and only if you turn that on.
 Your data is encrypted with SQLCipher, using a key kept in the Android Keystore.
 Optional app lock with a 4–6 digit PIN, and fingerprint or face unlock.
 Hide amounts: every amount shows as ••• until you tap the eye. On by default.
 Your currency, in English or Arabic Amounts in any of 100 currencies, each with its usual decimals: from JOD (12.500), SAR, AED and EGP to USD, EUR and MXN.
 Full Arabic interface, right to left, with Latin digits.
 Five looks for the whole app: Plain, Leather wallet, Coin nap, Pocket LCD and Receipt.
 Features Home: this month's income, spending and net, a 30-day spending chart, breakdowns by category and by merchant, income vs spending over 6 months, this month against last, spending by weekday, and the income and spending of any month you pick. You choose the order of its sections and hide what you don't need.
 Quick add: a home-screen widget and app-icon shortcuts for a new expense, income or voice entry.
 Balance widgets: your total balance and the day's spending, or one account's balance, on the home screen, in four pixel-art styles. Amounts show only if you turn them on.
 Activity: add, edit, search and filter transactions, each with a description, merchant and category or subcategory.
 Accounts: cash, bank, savings, cards and e-wallets, each with its balance, and transfers between them that don't count as spending.
 Merchants: keep a list in Settings. The merchant field searches it as you type and adds names it doesn't find.
 Voice entry (English): say "Spent 3.5 on lunch at Reem yesterday" and check the filled-in form.
 Budgets: weekly or monthly limits per category, with progress and over-budget warnings. A category's budget includes its subcategories.
 Recurring: bills, subscriptions and salary with due dates and a reminder at the time you pick, posted as transactions in one tap, and a month calendar of what's due.
 Loans: money you lend or borrow, per person, with partial repayments and due dates. Each payment is also a normal entry, so your totals follow the cash.
 Savings circles (جمعيات): your payment each round, your turn and payout, the schedule, and whether the circle owes you or you owe it, with a reminder before each payment.
 Backup: export everything to a password-encrypted file (or plain JSON if you choose), or back up automatically once a day, and import it on another phone.
 CSV: import and export transactions, categories and merchants as spreadsheet files, with a preview before anything is added.
 Sync: pair your phone with your computer or another phone, and keep the same data on both over your Wi-Fi. No server, no internet.
Voice entry uses your phone's speech recognizer. On most phones that is a separate app with its own privacy terms; the sentence itself is interpreted inside Pocket Sense.

fdroid:com.aeropayout.game.name: AeroPayout
fdroid:com.aeropayout.game.summary: Become a pilot in 7 days — buy tickets, advance seats, earn real rewards
fdroid:com.aeropayout.game.description:
AeroPayout is an open-source social flight game where passengers advance toward
the pilot seat by referring new players and watching flights fill up.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy a ticket on any active flight using in-game coins.
2. Each new passenger who joins the same flight moves everyone one seat forward.
3. Reach seat #1 (the pilot seat) to earn a real coin payout.
4. Trade tickets on the in-game marketplace while the flight is still boarding.
MARKETPLACE
List your ticket for sale with a starting bid and optional Buy Now price.
Other players can bid in real time while the flight is in progress.
Auctions close automatically when the flight lands.
LIVE GLOBE
Watch all active flights on an interactive globe.
Track your seat position and estimated payout in real time.
OPEN SOURCE
AeroPayout is free software released under the GNU Affero General Public
License v3 (AGPL-3.0). The full source code — including the Android app and
the Odoo backend — is available in our public repository.
No ads. No tracking. No proprietary libraries.
REQUIREMENTS
An account on the AeroPayout server (free registration in the app).
Internet connection required for live flight data.

fdroid:com.joebywan.daybook.name: Daybook Puzzles: Daily Sudoku
fdroid:com.joebywan.daybook.summary: Daily sudoku, nonograms, word and logic puzzles. No ads, no account, offline.
fdroid:com.joebywan.daybook.description:
Daily Sudoku, killer sudoku, nonograms, word games and logic puzzles, free and with no ads. No account, no internet needed, and every past day is open from the start.
Every day brings a fresh set of classic pencil puzzles and brain games, each in three difficulties (Standard, Hard and Expert). The grid puzzles are built so they have exactly one answer you can reach by reasoning alone, with nothing to guess. Play one a day or as many as you like: a streak needs just one solve.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• Sudoku, and Cage Sudoku (killer sudoku, with sum cages)
• Nonogram picture grids
• Futoshiki-style inequality grids, Shikaku rectangles, LITS, Tents and trees, Regions
• Kings, a Star Battle-style crown placement; Sun & Moon, a Takuzu-style binary grid; Atoms, Hashi-style bonds
• Number puzzles: Reckon arithmetic cages, Tally sums, Cipher letter sums (cryptarithms) and Target arithmetic
• Dominoes: lay every tile so each coloured region keeps its rule
• Mines: clear a minefield by its numbers alone, never a guess
• Lamps: light every square, with no lamp shining on another
• Pearls: draw one loop through every black and white pearl
• Loop: draw one loop round the numbers, from dot to dot
• Who's Who: match everyone to their house, pet and job from the clues
• Word puzzles: Lexicon (find the hidden word in a few guesses), Word Wheel, Codeword and a mini Crossword
• Codebreaker: crack a hidden colour code from scored guesses
• Mate: chess puzzles, mate in 2, 3 and 4
• Quick ones too: Pipes, Mosaic flood-fill, Trail one-line paths, Sand colour sorting, Sets, and Arrows, where every bump costs one of three lives
HINTS THAT TEACH
Stuck? Ask for a hint and Daybook explains the next step in plain language, pointing at the squares it is talking about. You make the move yourself, so you learn the technique instead of watching it get filled in. Every puzzle has a one-minute walkthrough, and its rules are always one tap away.
LEVELS AND ACHIEVEMENTS
Levels give you five boards from five different puzzles at a time; finish them and the next level opens. Achievements mark the milestones along the way, from your first Expert board to a week-long streak.
NO ADS. NO SUBSCRIPTION. NO ACCOUNT.
There are no adverts, no paywall, no sign-in and no in-app purchases. The app does not even ask for network access, so these are true offline puzzles: they work on a plane, on a train and in a tunnel.
THE WHOLE ARCHIVE, FROM DAY ONE
Puzzles are made on your device from the date, so every past day is already there. Missed a week? Play it. Want more? Switch to Random boards at any difficulty.
KEEP YOUR STREAK
Track your daily streak, your times and your statistics, all stored privately on your phone.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Daybook collects nothing. No analytics, no trackers, no third-party SDKs. Your progress never leaves your device.
PHONES AND TABLETS
Turn your phone on its side or play on a tablet and the board sits beside the controls.
PLAY ANYWHERE
The same daily puzzles run in a web browser at knowhowit.com.au/daybook, no install needed.
Open source, with hand-built puzzle generators, proven boards and a calm, uncluttered design. Come back tomorrow for the next one.

fdroid:com.minar.randomix.name: Randomix - Decision Maker
fdroid:com.minar.randomix.summary: An app to randomly choose between numbers, answers, options. 🃏
fdroid:com.minar.randomix.description:
Introduction 👋 
This is an app created as a demo of some Android features.
The main purpose of the app is to provide a random choice in different ways. The app contains some basic personalization options and an introduction, plus some new resources like animated vector drawables and the full light theme. The design is a bit personal: it follows the Android guidelines, but just partially.
 Why should i use Randomix? 😕 
Well, i'll tell you 3 main reasons:
 It can help you to decide randomly in 4 different ways, elegantly! 
 It will cost just 3MB of storage! 
 It's beautiful, full of animations and simple to use! 
An example?
→ During a table game, you have to throw a dice, a coin, or choose which player should start: Randomix does it all! 
→ You're hungry but you and your friends can't decide a place to have a meal: just spin the roulette and accept its wise answer!
→ You're starting to develop apps and you need a simple app to look at, to find some inspiration and tricks: click on the Github link, and the Randomix source code is served!
 Features 🎲 
 Every tab in the bottom navigation bar contains a type of random choice. The available types are: 
 Roulette → select an option from a list. 
 Coin → simply flips a coin and prints the result. 
 Dice → throws a dice and prints the result. 
 Magic Ball → provides randomly chosen answers to any question. 
 The recent options used in the roulette are automatically saved and can be restored! 
 Roulette presets, such as 1-100 numbers and letters 
 Shake to launch option 
 Light, dark and Amoled themes, Material You 
 Up to 10 dice and different dice types, plus a 3v3 mode 
 Selectable accent 
 Android 13 per-app language and themed icon support 
 Vibration and sounds 
 Rude answers, allow equal options, dice number 
 First time introduction 
 Multiwindows support 
 Simple and precise ui following the material guidelines 
 Credits ⚡ 
This app was written during my free time as a training. Many good devs have helped me understanding the best practices. Thanks to BValeo for the russian translation, and to Firokat for the french translation. And a special thanks to Stack Overflow, obviously.

fdroid:com.roguetemple.hyperroid.name: HyperRogue
fdroid:com.roguetemple.hyperroid.description:
You are a lone outsider in a strange, non-Euclidean world. As a Rogue, your goal
is to collect as many treasures as possible. However, collecting treasures
attracts dangerous monsters (on the other hand, killing the monsters allows more
treasures to be generated).
You can kill most monsters by moving into them. Similarly, if the monster was
next to you at the end of your turn, it would kill you. The game protects you
from getting yourself killed accidentally by ignoring moves which lead to
instant death (similar to the check rule from Chess).

Linwood Flow is a free, opensource time and event management software. You can choose where your data is stored and who can access it. Group your events and manage places and people. The app is available for Windows, Linux, Android and Web.
* Simple and intuitive: Every tool is in the right place. Open the app and start managing your time. Invite people to your events and share your calendar with them.

* Works on every device: The app is available for android, windows, linux, and in the web. You can use it on your phone, tablet, or computer.
* Choose where your data is stored: You can choose to store your data locally, in your favorite cloud (caldav) or decentralized using S5. You can also export your data to a file and import it again.
* Available in many languages: The app is available in many languages. Help us to translate this app to your language.
* FOSS: The app is open source and free. You can contribute to the project and help to make it better.
* Use it offline: You can use the app offline. You can draw, paint, and export your notes without an internet connection.
* Manage your time: You can manage your time using a calendar. You can add events to it and share them with your friends.
* Manage your places: You can add places to the app and share them with your friends. Keep track which places are free and which are busy.
* Manage users: Add users to the app to keep track of who is available and who is not. You can also share your calendar with them. Add birthdays to the app and get a notification when it is time to celebrate.
* Manage your tasks: You can add tasks to the app and share them with your friends. You can also add your favorite tasks to the app. Set a deadline and get notified when it is due.
* Take notes: You can add files and notes to your events. Add a backlog to your events to keep track of your progress.
* Group your events: Group your events to know which events are related to each other. You can also add tags to your events to find them faster.

fdroid:ee.ioc.phon.android.speak.name: Kõnele
fdroid:ee.ioc.phon.android.speak.description:
Kõnele is an app that offers speech-to-text user interfaces to other apps. Many apps contain a text area or a text field (e.g. a message box or a search bar) that can be edited using the input method editor (IME) , aka the on-screen keyboard. Kõnele provides an IME that is optimized for speech input. Modalities like swiping and buttons are also supported, for situations where speaking is less convenient. Many apps (e.g. intelligent assistants, navigation apps) also contain a microphone button that is linked to the standard Android speech recognition activity . Kõnele provides an implementation of this activity, and uses it itself as a launcher.
Kõnele can connect to any speech recognition service available on the device but by default uses, and is optimized for Kõnele service ( https://github.com/Kaljurand/K6nele-service ), a separate lightweight app whose backing server runs the kaldi-gstreamer-server ( https://github.com/alumae/kaldi-gstreamer-server ) software. The default server operates from Tallinn and provides Estonian speech recognition, but the software is easy to deploy elsewhere (e.g. a private network) and customize for other languages.
(Note that Kõnele also includes a simpler version of "Kõnele service" under the name "Kõnele (fast recognition)".)

fdroid:io.github.anka1981.bikerouteplann.name: BikeRoutePlanner
fdroid:io.github.anka1981.bikerouteplann.summary: Plan bike routes with bbbike, save them as GPX and navigate in OsmAnd
fdroid:io.github.anka1981.bikerouteplann.description:
BikeRoutePlanner calculates bike routes using the bbbike routing service, shows the key
figures for them, and hands the route to a map or navigation app as a GPX track.
 Features 
* Routes over any number of waypoints. Set start, stops, and destination by address search,
 map, current location, contacts, or saved favourites.
* One button reverses the order for the return trip.
* All bbbike route preferences: category, surface quality, green routes, speed, traffic
 lights, ferries, unlit ways, and travelling with a trailer or a child seat. Preferences
 can be stored as named profiles.
* Route statistics: length, number of traffic lights, and bbbike's travel time at 10, 15,
 20, and 25 km/h.
* Events on the route: closures, roadworks, and markets that affect it. On request the app
 calculates an alternative route around them. These reports exist for Berlin only, because
 that is the only place bbbike keeps them.
* In-app map showing the calculated route and your own position.
* Navigation directly in OsmAnd, or sharing the GPX file with any map app.
* Interface in German and English; light, dark, colourful, and system themes.
 Data sources 
Routes come from the official bbbike interface, address search from OpenStreetMap
Nominatim, map tiles from OpenTopoMap. The events come from www.bbbike.de.
 Privacy 
The app needs no account and sends no usage data. Addresses and coordinates go only to the
services named above, so that the route can be calculated. Favourites, profiles, and
settings stay on the device.

fdroid:io.github.capitan0n.droynis.name: Droynis
fdroid:io.github.capitan0n.droynis.summary: Read-only security and privacy audit for your phone
fdroid:io.github.capitan0n.droynis.description:
Droynis checks the security and privacy settings of your phone, explains every finding in plain words, shows the raw evidence and opens the Settings screen that fixes it. It never changes anything itself.
It is not an antivirus: it audits how the phone is set up and looks for signs adware leaves, not for malicious code.
 What it checks 
 Device integrity: patches, encryption, bootloader, root, SELinux, SD card, chips with unfixable boot flaws, StrongBox
 Access control: screen lock, biometrics, USB debugging, SIM PIN
 Apps and permissions: accessibility, device admins, sideloaded apps, Shizuku, Termux and adb grants
 Suspicious apps: hidden apps, background camera/mic use, trojan permissions
 Network: Private DNS, VPN, Wi-Fi, certificates, 2G, call forwarding, Bluetooth, NFC
 Honest results 
A check passes only on a value it actually read; otherwise it is Unknown. A 0–100 score sums it up.
 Private by design 
No internet permission, no Google Play Services, no analytics.

fdroid:uk.nktnet.webviewkiosk.name: Webview Kiosk
fdroid:uk.nktnet.webviewkiosk.summary: Turn your Android device into a locked-down web page in fullscreen mode.
fdroid:uk.nktnet.webviewkiosk.description:
Webview Kiosk is a free and open-source Android application for secure, kiosk-style web browsing.
It can function as digital signage, a kid-friendly restricted browser, an immersive web reader, an interactive sign-up form, a home assistant dashboard, or simply a wall clock.
Designed for small businesses and device owners who are looking for a simple and standalone Kiosk solution.
 Key Features 
 Core / Standalone 
- Lock Task Mode (Pin): prevent access to your device's home screen, apps and status bar
- Secure Settings: configurations are protected by biometrics, device credentials or custom password
- URL Filtering: use regular expressions to control web access through a URL blacklist and whitelist
- Export/Import: backup and restore user settings in Base64 or JSON format
- Local files: display images, audio, video, HTML or PDF (using Mozilla's PDF.js) in kiosk mode
- Default Launcher: use as the home app and launch other apps in lock task mode (kiosk)
- JS Scripts: supports NFC (Near Field Communication), Eruda console, Dark Reader and custom scripts
- Adblock: blocks ads and trackers using rules from uBlock Origin, AdGuard, EasyList and HaGeZi
 Remote Management / Enterprise 
1. MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport)
 - Monitor events, update settings, execute commands and build custom automations
 - Requires an MQTT broker (e.g. Mosquitto, EMQX, HiveMQ, or their HomeAssistant integrations)
2. UnifiedPush
 - Send commands and update settings via a decentralised push notification system
 - Requires a distributor application (e.g. sunup, ntfy, gCompat-UP)
3. Managed Configurations (App Restrictions)
 - For fully-managed (company-owned) devices, settings can be configured via an MDM/EMM provider
 - Advanced users with a device policy controller (e.g. Test DPC or OwnDroid) can also enforce configurations locally
For more details, visit https://webviewkiosk.nktnet.uk
 Permissions 
- INTERNET : general web browsing
- ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE : refresh web pages when network connectivity is restored
- ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK : (optional, Android 17+) web apps needing LAN
- CAMERA : (optional) web apps requiring photo/video capture
- RECORD_AUDIO : (optional) web apps requiring audio capture
- MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS : routing audio - needed for microphone
- ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION : (optional) web apps requiring precise geolocation
- ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION : (optional) web apps requiring approximate geolocation
- NFC : read/write NFC tags using hardware
- VIBRATE : (optional) web apps requiring navigator.vibrate(pattern)
- INSTALL_SHORTCUT : home screen launcher shortcuts on Android 7.1 and below
- QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES : find launchable apps, device owners and lock task packages
- POST_NOTIFICATIONS : (optional) for lock task mode launches and MQTT
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE : persistent notification for required services
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE : return mechanism after opening apps in kiosk
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK : background audio/video streaming, e.g. YouTube
- USE_BIOMETRIC : replaces USE_FINGERPRINT from Android 9.0 onwards
- USE_FINGERPRINT : fingerprint hardware for authentication
- WAKE_LOCK : (optional) wake screen when receiving MQTT commands
- WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE : download files in Android 9.0 and below
- API (Dhizuku) : request shared owner privileges
- API_23 (Shizuku) : auto-activate device/profile owner
 Contact 
- https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk
- support@webviewkiosk.nktnet.uk
 Alternatives 
- Fully Kiosk Browser Lockdown (feature-rich, but not a free kiosk solution)
- Web Kiosk (by Screenlite)
- FreeKiosk (by Rushb-fr)
- Kite AOS (by andrew-malitchuk)

fdroid:xyz.metiq.name: Metiq: noise & ambient sounds
fdroid:xyz.metiq.summary: Colored noise, binaural beats & ambient sounds for sleep, study and focus.
fdroid:xyz.metiq.description:
Metiq plays high-quality colored noise — white, pink, brown and grey — binaural beats, and relaxing ambient sounds to help you focus, study, meditate, fall asleep, or block out the world with soothing background noise.
Open it, tap, listen. That's the whole app.
Colored noise
• White noise — the classic, masks sudden sounds.
• Pink noise — softer than white, great for sleep and reading.
• Brown noise — deep and warm, good for focus and tinnitus relief.
• Grey noise — perceptually flat, designed to feel even across the spectrum.
Ambient sounds
• Sea waves, rain, fire crackling, birds chirping, café ambience, wind, crickets, and a water stream.
• Start from a quick mix, or blend sounds from any category into your own mix, set each level, and save it.
Binaural beats
• Layer delta, theta, alpha, beta or gamma tones under any sound — headphones required.
• Each band nudges a different mental state: deep sleep, meditation, relaxation, focus, alertness.
Features
• Four colored noises, eight ambient sounds and five binaural bands, looped seamlessly.
• One mix for everything: colored noise, ambient sounds and binaural beats play together, with quick mixes to start from and your own saved mixes.
• Sleep timer with quick presets and custom hours/minutes/seconds.
• Pick what opens at launch: home, or straight into noise, ambient or binaurals.
• Light, dark or system theme, and eight app languages.
• Optional dynamic colors (Material You): the app takes its palette from your wallpaper (Android 12+).
• Media-session integration: control playback from your lock screen, notification, or Bluetooth headset.
• Works fully offline. Audio is bundled — no streaming, no account, no internet permission.
• No ads. No tracking. No analytics. No third-party SDKs.
• Tiny footprint, minimal battery use.
Whether you want a sound machine to help a baby sleep, calm background noise for studying or concentration, storm and rain sounds to relax and unwind, or steady sleep sounds through the night — Metiq keeps it simple.

• Access to over 100 million songs

ADVANCED MEDIA LIBRARY

BUILT FOR iOS

flathub:com.github.ahrm.sioyek.name: Sioyek
flathub:com.github.ahrm.sioyek.summary: PDF viewer designed for reading research papers and technical books
flathub:com.github.ahrm.sioyek.description:
Some features in Sioyek:
 You can quickly search and open any file you have previously interacted with using sioyek.
 You can search and jump to table of contents entries.
 You can jump to any referenced figure or bibliography item even if the PDF file doesn't provide links.
 You can also search the names of bibliography items in google scholar/libgen by middle clicking/shif+middle clicking on their name.
 You can open a quick overview of figures/references/tables/etc. by right clicking on them (Like Smart Jump, this feature works even if the document doesn't provide links).
 Bookmarks are similar to marks except they are named by a text string and they are all global.
 Highlight text using different kinds of highlight, you can search among all the highlights.
 You can customize all key bindings and some UI elements by editing keys_user.conf and prefs_user.conf. The default configurations are in keys.conf and prefs.conf
 Sometimes when reading a document you need to go back a few pages (perhaps to view a definition or something) and quickly jump back to where you were. You can achieve this by using marks. Marks are named locations within a PDF file (each mark has a single character name for example 'a' or 'm') which you can quickly jump to using their name. In the aforementioned example, before going back to the definition you mark your location and later jump back to the mark by invoking its name. Lower case marks are local to the document and upper case marks are global (this should be very familiar to you if you have used vim).
 Suppose you are reading a paragraph which references a figure which is not very close to the current location. Jumping back and forth between the current paragraph and the figure can be very annoying. Using portals, you can link the paragraph's location to the figure's location. Sioyek shows the closest portal destination in a separate window (which is usually placed on a second monitor). This window is automatically updated to show the closest portal destination as the user navigates the document.
 Under Wayland, Sioyek will use by default the Wayland backend, if you prefer the X11 backend you can force it with flatpak run --nosocket=wayland --socket=x11 com.github.ahrm.sioyek 
 If you want to theme Sioyek, the prefs_user.config file will be looked up in ~/.config/sioyek/

flathub:dev.qwery.AddWater.name: Add Water
flathub:dev.qwery.AddWater.description:
A utility app to easily install the Firefox GNOME Theme* and automatically update it in the background. This theme keeps Firefox fashionable within the GNOME design ecosystem, and provides many helpful features to customize the interface to make browsing even more pleasant:

flathub:fm.reaper.Reaper.description:
REAPER is a complete digital audio production application for computers, offering a full multitrack

 Using REAPER you can import any audio and MIDI, synthesize, sample, compose, arrange, edit,
 mix, and master songs or any other audio projects. If you add a hardware audio interface and a
 microphone, you have a complete professional quality recording studio, suitable for recording anything
 from a soloist to a band to an orchestra.

flathub:io.github.ezQuake.name: ezQuake

flathub:io.github.ezQuake.description:
Welcome to the home of ezQuake, a modern QuakeWorld client focused on competitive online play.
 Combining the features of modern QuakeWorld® clients, ezQuake makes QuakeWorld® easier to start and play.
 The immortal first person shooter Quake® in a brand new skin with superb graphics and extremely fast gameplay.
 Features:
 Modern Graphics: Particle explosions, shaft beam, gunshots, nails, rocket and grenade trails, blood, and others,
 MD3 models, fog, water effects, killing spree messages, rain
 Modern competitive gaming features: Fullbright skins, forcing team/enemy colors, advanced weapon handling,
 teamplay messages, auto game recording, automated screenshots and console logging
 Graphics customization: Customize your HUD, colors of walls and liquids, turn superfluous graphics effects off,
 change world textures, crosshair, sky picture, console background, game font
 Independent Physics: Get the smoothest experience possible without being limited by server or network settings
 Integrated Server Browser: Easy searching and filtering of online servers

flathub:one.ablaze.floorp.name: Floorp
flathub:one.ablaze.floorp.description:
Unlimited Customization For Everyone
 Enable more advanced customization than your default browser. Floorp is based on the smart Firefox,
 and enhances functionality and flexibility while maintaining security and privacy.
 What can Floorp do for you?
 Flexible UI Customization: Floorp's most distinctive feature is its customizability. Floorp
 is the first Firefox-based browser to enable UI customization, designed so that anyone can easily
 adjust their browsing experience to their preferences and access the web with ease.
 Various Ways to Browse the Web: Floorp features workspaces that integrate tab groups with
 containers that can separate login information. Additionally, you can easily access social media
 and chats through web panels.
 Various Control Methods Supported: Browse more efficiently with mouse gestures and customizable
 keyboard shortcuts. Of course, it's also designed to be easily operated with a mouse.
 Development and Research Focused: Floorp actively pursues experimental browser development.
 It's a browser that continuously incorporates new technologies and ideas, and energetically improves
 based on community feedback.
 Aiming for a Sustainable Web: We respect users' rights and contribute to building an open
 and sustainable web ecosystem. Let's create the future of the internet together for the next
 generation.

flathub:org.audiveris.audiveris.name: Audiveris
flathub:org.audiveris.audiveris.description:
An Optical Music Recognition (OMR) application, featuring
 an OMR engine coupled with a dedicated editor.
 It recognizes music from digitized images and converts it into
 computer-readable symbolic format. This enables further music processing
 by any external notation editor, most notably: digital playback,
 transposition and arrangement.
 Audiveris provides outputs in two main digital formats: its OMR format
 and standard MusicXML format. It has a graphical user
 interface focused on quick verification and manual
 correction of the OMR outputs. Other music editors, such as MuseScore,
 Finale, or Lilypond, can be used on Audiveris MusicXML output.

flathub:org.cutwire.Drift.name: Drift
flathub:org.cutwire.Drift.description:
Drift is a free desktop video editor that feels simple from the first cut. Drop in video, photos,
 and music, add effects and stickers, generate captions automatically, and export — no subscription,
 no watermark, and no account required.
 Great for social videos, explainers, and everyday projects. Cut subjects out of a frame, animate
 to the beat, style text and shapes, then add fonts and stickers only when you need them.
 What you get:
 Multi-track timeline — trim, split, snap, and undo as you go
 Effects, transitions, and reusable look templates
 Stickers, emoji, titles, and shapes for a finished look
 Auto captions from speech in your video
 Cut out subjects, mask clips, and key out green screens
 Speed changes, reverse playback, and fades
 Animate to the beat of your music
 Mix audio and clean up background noise
 Optional addons for fonts, stickers, and extras
 Project bundles that keep your media together

flathub:org.kde.kreversi.name: KReversi
flathub:org.kde.kreversi.description:
KReversi is a simple one player strategy game played against the computer. If a player's piece
 is captured by an opposing player, that piece is turned over to reveal the color of that player.
 A winner is declared when one player has more pieces of his own color on the board and there are
 no more possible moves.

flathub:uk.co.powdertoy.tpt.name: The Powder Toy
flathub:uk.co.powdertoy.tpt.description:
Have you ever wanted to blow something up? Or maybe you always dreamt of operating an atomic
 power plant? Do you have a will to develop your own CPU? The Powder Toy lets you to do all of these,
 and even more!
 The Powder Toy is a free physics sandbox game, which simulates air pressure and velocity, heat,
 gravity and a countless number of interactions between different substances! The game provides
 you with various building materials, liquids, gases and electronic components which can be used
 to construct complex machines, guns, bombs, realistic terrains and almost anything else. You can
 then mine them and watch cool explosions, add intricate wirings, play with little stickmen or operate
 your machine. You can browse and play thousands of different saves made by the community or upload
 your own – we welcome your creations!
 There is a Lua API – you can automate your work or even make plugins for the game. The Powder
 Toy is free and the source code is distributed under the GNU General Public License, so you can
 modify the game yourself or help with development.

Full details can be found at the PCG-Random website (http://www.pcg-random.org/). This version of the code provides many family members – if you just want one simple generator, you may prefer the minimal C version of the library. There are two kinds of generator, normal generators and extended generators. Extended generators provide k dimensional equidistribution and can perform party tricks, but generally speaking most people only need the normal generators. There are two ways to access the generators, using a convenience typedef or by using the underlying templates directly (similar to C++11’s std::mt19937 typedef vs its std::mersenne_twister_engine template). For most users, the convenience typedef is what you want, and probably you’re fine with pcg32 for 32-bit numbers. If you want 64-bit numbers, either use pcg64 (or, if you’re on a 32-bit system, making 64 bits from two calls to pcg32_k2 may be faster).

fedora-packages:perl-Data-Tumbler/perl-D.name: perl-Data-Tumbler
fedora-packages:perl-Data-Tumbler/perl-D.description: The tumble() method calls a sequence of 'provider' code references, each of which returns a hash. The first provider is called and then, for each hash item it returns, the tumble() method recurses to call the next provider. The recursion continues until there are no more providers to call, at which point the consumer code reference is called. Effectively the providers create a tree of combinations and the consumer is called at the leaves of the tree. If a provider returns no items then that part of the tree is pruned. Further providers, if any, are not called and the consumer is not called. During a call to tumble() three values are passed down through the tree and into the consumer: path, context, and payload. The path and context are derived from the names and values of the hashes returned by the providers. Typically the path defines the current "path" through the tree of combinations. The providers are passed the current path, context, and payload. The payload is cloned at each level of recursion so that any changes made to it by providers are only visible within the scope of the generated sub-tree.

firefox-addons:3030259.description:
Video Downloader. Download video from any website (Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, Vimeo, etc)
Video Downloader for all websites — save videos you can watch in your browser to your computer.
What it does
• Detects playable videos on the page you are viewing.
• Lists available qualities (resolution, bitrate, codecs) in the popup.
• Saves the selected stream as a single file.
• Supports segmented streams (HLS / m3u8 and MPEG-DASH / mpd) by joining segments.
• For live streams: press Record, then Stop to save the captured portion.
Supported sites
• Facebook
• Instagram
• TikTok
• Vimeo
• Many other sites that serve standard HLS, DASH, or direct MP4 / WebM streams.
Not supported
• YouTube (per Firefox Add-ons policy).
• Audio-only files, documents, images, or other non-video media.
• DRM-protected video (Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, etc.).
• Sites that explicitly block third-party download.
How to use
1. Open the direct page of the video (e.g. tiktok.com/@user/video/123…), not the home feed.
2. Play the video — the toolbar icon turns amber when a stream is detected.
3. Click the extension icon, pick a quality, and press Download. For live streams use Record, then Stop.

firefox-addons:868350.name: Prevent Pwned Passwords
firefox-addons:868350.summary: Checks password hashes against Have I Been Pwned and displays a notification if the hash has been leaked in a breach.
firefox-addons:868350.description:
Prevent Pwned Passwords helps make sure you don't use any password that's known to have been part of a data breach. If you try to use a password that's known to have been compromised, you'll get an alert.
You can choose to run it whenever you enter a password on any site, whenever you enter a password on a "Create Account" page, or only when you choose to check a password from a context menu. You can also whitelist sites, giving you greater control over what passwords are checked.
This extension hashes your password and securely checks that hash against a database of hashes known to be breached. If it's been involved in a past breach (of any account across hundreds of sites), it notifies you so you can change your password.
Note that the only data ever transmitted is a password hash. We never send a clear-text password or any identifiable information like a username or a URL.
This extension uses the Have I Been Pwned service.

The UniquePasswordBuilder addon allows you to construct strong and different passwords based from a single master password (the only you have to know).
When you’re on a login page, click on the lock icon, then type your master password. When finished, a password for that login page has been generated. You can then click on the icon on the right or press enter to paste it into clipboard, then just paste it in the login form. For each website, the generated password is different.
The master password is hashed a large number of time with the domain’s site generating an unique password for that site. Hashing algorithm is scrypt (which is memory resistant).
Note that your master password should be strong (more than 10 characters in lower and upper case, numbers and special characters). Using simple password makes brute force attack easier.
Other password tools (LastPass, KeyPass, etc) usually stores websites passwords into a encrypted database.
The drawback of that approach is that the database needs to be synced between all of your devices.
UniquePasswordBuilder doesn’t uses a central database because it recomputes your password each time. 
For increased security, you can set a `user salt`, which make it even more resilient against rainbow table attacks.
You can use CTRL + SHIFT + L to open the addon.
That addon is free software and you can study the source code here : https://github.com/paulgreg/UniquePasswordBuilder 
You’ll find further information on the project home page : https://paulgreg.me/UniquePasswordBuilder/

Coinz: Your Ultimate Coin Companion!
Are you a coin enthusiast searching for the perfect app to enhance your numismatic experience? Look no further! Coinz is here to revolutionize the way you interact with coins and enrich your collecting journey.
Identify with Ease
With powerful AI-driven image recognition technology, easily identify any coin with a snap or by uploading a photo. Say goodbye to tedious catalog searches!
Get Coin Insights

Determine Coin Value
Use the coin grading feature and reference prices to make smart numismatic purchases, sales, and trades. Stay ahead in the market and maximize your collecting potential.
Organize Your Collection
Keep your collection organized and secure with Coinz. Record and store your coins directly in the app, arranging them by series or creating custom collections. Say goodbye to misplaced or forgotten coins!

Beyond just a rating, it helps you understand how wear, scratches, and preservation impact your coin’s market value, giving you the ultimate confidence when buying, selling, or trading.
Coinz is designed for collectors of all levels, providing a user-friendly interface and a wealth of features. Unlock the full potential of your passion. Download Coinz now and embark on a new era of numismatic exploration!

bluejetty:00049459:android.description:
Bikini Bottom Mod is a fictional nickelodeon cartoon city and the main venue for the Sponge Bob SquarePants series. This add-on allows you to get acquainted with the city of spongbob in Minecraft and its inhabitants. On this spungbob map you can find all the attributes of a series of cartoons and films about the spongebob squarepants: from the Sponge Bob Pineapple house to the Bikini Bottom Mall and all friends. Everything include Krusty Krab fastfood in these spoungebob games and maps is stylized specifically for Minecraft Pocket Edition. For maximum pleasure, we recommend that you download the soongebob BikiniBottom map and then use this spungbob add-on.
Characters in this mod is from the Bikini Bottom universe, the first 8 mobs of them can be tamed by feeding them with bones:
SpongeBob SquarePants, Squidward Tentacles, Sandy Cheeks, Patrick Star, Mr. Krabs from Krusty Krabs, Larry Omar, Mrs. Puff - teacher at SpongeBob School, Gary Snail.
Plankton, Citizens Bikini Bottom, Soongebob, Medusa, Flying Dutchman, Boat that can be controlled.
In each of our mods, addon, or map for MCPE you will find some additional free soft to diversify Minecraft PE playing.
This sponge bob squarepants application is not an official product of Minecraft. It is also not approved or not affiliated with Mojang.

bluejetty:00028850:ios.summary: Norman On Demand makes it easier than ever to move around core Norman — with a few taps, book a ride using the app and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. University of Oklahoma students also access OU SafeRide with Norman On Demand
bluejetty:00028850:ios.description:
Norman On Demand makes it easier than ever to move around core Norman — with a few taps, book a ride using the app and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. University of Oklahoma students also access OU SafeRide with Norman On Demand.
How does Norman On Demand work? 
- Book a ride on your phone.
- Get picked up at a nearby corner.
- Share your ride with others.
- Save cash and reduce carbon emissions.
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
AFFORDABLE.
Rides are affordably priced and you can add people to your bookings for even less.
Questions? Reach out to support-norman@ridewithvia.com. Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00015013:ios.description:
-Educational games for toddlers and kids aged 2-4 years.
-Games for kids on sorting and classifying objects by shape, size, color, and quantity.
-Games for boys and girls developed in close collaboration with preschool education experts.
Trusted by the largest teacher community in the USA: "We Are Teachers"!
Baby games are intended to improve your child’s skills and learn new about shapes and colors, quantity and sizes of different objects. Games for girls and boys can become a part of the preschool education program for your baby. 
We believe that games for toddlers should include entertaining elements and be educational as well. Therefore, we take special care about the design and content of our baby games.
Key features:
-Quests: Build problem-solving abilities by completing various missions.
-Labyrinth: Enhance spatial awareness by navigating mazes.
-Constructor: Encourage creativity through building structures.
-Backpacks: Teach categorization by packing items into backpacks.
-Puzzles: Boost cognitive skills with a variety of match-three puzzles.
-Doors: Strengthen critical thinking by solving challenges to unlock doors.
-Way: Improve navigation by finding and following paths.
-Chests: Develop deduction skills by solving puzzles to unlock treasures.
-Seek: Boost observational skills by finding hidden objects.
-Sandwich: Teach sequencing and creativity by making sandwiches.
Join Bimi Boo on a marvelous journey around the world, where your child will help penguins build houses in the Arctic, and equip cars in Africa. These engaging baby games show your child the diversity of the world.
Explore 30 captivating games for preschool education:
-Arctic: Sort items by size to help penguins build their houses.
-Boat: Sort objects and characters by color to transport Bimi’s friends.
-Waterfall: Use logical thinking to place characters correctly.
-Tomb: Sort items by shapes and colors to discover ancient treasures.
-Garden: Classify items by shapes and harvest fruits and vegetables.
-Space: Complete shape-based puzzles to build a space adventure.
-Road: Sort cars by color and patterns for loading trucks.
-Numbers: Sort items by quantity and learn to count.
-Safari: Sort items by meaning to distinguish between edible and non-edible items.
-Savanna: Classify items by size and dress characters in appropriate outfits.
-Sea: Sort by color to choose the right house for sea animals.
-Winter: Sort items by shapes to clean the slopes and enjoy winter fun.
We look forward to your feedback and hope baby games bring joy and valuable learning experiences to your child’s educational journey!

bluejetty:00069129:ios.name: Baby Tracker・Breastfeeding Log
bluejetty:00069129:ios.summary: This App is a handy and reliable assistant for tracking your newborn baby’s daily activities. You can track breastfeeding, bottle feeding, solid food feeding, and milk pumping. You can save diaper changes, sleeping periods, and the results
bluejetty:00069129:ios.description:
This App is a handy and reliable assistant for tracking your newborn baby’s daily activities. You can track breastfeeding, bottle feeding, solid food feeding, and milk pumping. You can save diaper changes, sleeping periods, and the results of your baby's height and weight measurements.
With this baby care app, you get all of these incredible features:
- Track baby's sleep and predict sleep patterns
- Track feeding by one breast or by both, if you give your baby two breasts at one feeding
- Track bottle feeding
- Fix solid food feeding
- Fix how many ml/oz of each breast were pumped
- Fix diaper changing, you can note whether it is wet or dirty
- Always know how many diapers were changed per day
- Record baths, temperatures, walks, and medications
- Handy breastfeeding timer and sleeping timer are easy to stop and to restart
- Your baby's height and weight can be measured almost daily! They are also stored in the baby diary
- Add a reminder for each event - periodic and easy-to-set
- Log and track the activity of several babies. Supports twins!
One of the most crucial features is the sleep monitoring. Sleep is vital for a baby’s development, and managing your baby’s rest can be a challenge. Our app helps you track the length and quality of naps and nighttime sleep, providing valuable insights into their patterns. This feature helps ensure your baby gets the rest they need.
Sleep is important not only for babies but for moms too. With our app, you can monitor your baby's sleep patterns without added stress, giving you peace of mind.
Being a mom is very tiring and challenging! You’ve just made it home from the hospital, exhausted and overwhelmed by your new responsibilities. Don’t worry! In the first few months of baby's life, it really revolves around eating, sleeping, diaper changes and occasional little doctor's visits. It’s not always easy to remember the last time you fed your baby or changed their diaper. We don’t blame you for falling asleep on the couch occasionally, so we’ve got you covered with handy alarms and reminders. Alarms and graphs are a great way to have an at-a-glance look at what you need to do.
The app will help you keep track of feedings, your baby’s weight and how long they were eating to make sure they’re gaining weight properly and at a normal rate. Unfortunately for some parents, it’s imperative that they track every last drop of food their baby eats since some infants are born with illnesses that make it harder to gain weight normally. Keeping track of diapers is also imperative to keeping your baby healthy. Everyone needs an easy way to check how often they’re changing diapers, and if everything looks normal during each change.
Just click the appropriate button at the beginning of the feeding or other activities. Your baby care history will be reliably stored. All this info may be useful when you visit the pediatrician, as well as for the further development of your child.
Check your baby’s day-to-day activities easily. Our app will help you keep track of everything in one convenient place and take care of yourself with peace of mind.
GOLD STATUS IN THE APP
- You can subscribe to regularly updated backup and synchronization with relatives
- The subscription costs $2.49 per month, $11.49 per year, $4.99 and $9.99 for lifetime
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

bluejetty:00092151:ios.name: Vinylly Music Lovers Dating
bluejetty:00092151:ios.summary: Vinylly is a dating app based entirely on music compatibility. We are the largest dating app for music lovers and we have *reinvented* how to use Vinylly. Anyone can sign up in a few minutes; no streaming music service sync needed. You can
bluejetty:00092151:ios.description:
Vinylly is a dating app based entirely on music compatibility. We are the largest dating app for music lovers and we have *reinvented* how to use Vinylly. Anyone can sign up in a few minutes; no streaming music service sync needed. You can now create an account with your email using our Vinylly profile generator based on your music tastes alone. When you sign up this way, you can create and edit your playlist too! We have maintained the Spotify sync as a way to create a profile, if you prefer to let your Spotify streaming data do all the work. We have improved the concert search, suggestions and ticket purchase process in the chat. Beyond just a superficial swipe, Vinylly has the ability to match on a deeper level. And, when you stream more music, Vinylly uses that data to produce new matches. Vinylly’s “Suggest a Concert” feature encourages users to stop chatting and start dating, which offers a better chance at finding real relationships. Vinylly learns to understand you by learning about the music you love – and in doing so, puts the needle on true compatibility.
DISCOVER
Browse your lineup of potential matches based on musical tastes.
PLAY
Press play when you discover someone you want to connect with.
CHAT
Hit it off as you chat with your matches.
DATE
Get tickets to a show for you and your new match to enjoy. 
Vinylly is a new app and you'll probably have the best chance of meeting someone in major metro areas while we grow our music-loving database.
Vinylly has three options to view your match queue: $3.99 every 2 months, $8.99 every 6 months or $11.99 every year. There is no limit on the amount of profiles you can view, changes to your profile you can make and chats you can send. Use the provided conversation starters with references to a potential match's profile to easily get the conversation going. Think you want to take the next step and ask your match to see a show? You don't have to leave the chat--just click the calendar icon and select a virtual concert or live show based on an artist or a location and the show will appear in the chat.
-----------------------------------
If you have any issues with the app, please visit https://vinyllyapp.com/troubleshooting or contact us at support@vinyllyapp.com and we'll be happy to help you.
In order to see your recent Spotify listening history under "Playlist," you need to have a Spotify Premium account. Spotify offers free trials for Premium that may be available. 
Creating an account means you agree to Vinylly's Terms of Use and Privacy Policy which can be found at: https://vinyllyapp.com/privacy-policy/

Key Features

bluejetty:00022182:ios.description:
The wicked witch was jealous of the beauty and elegance of the princess. So she cast an evil spell on the princess to make her fall asleep forever. Meanwhile, the prince was trapped in the dungeon and couldn’t come to the rescue. But the prince left some clues, hoping that someone who is intelligent and brave could solve the puzzles to release both the princess and himself.
In Papo Town, Purple Pink the Bunny is inviting all boys and girls to the mystery castle, not only for a royal tour, but also to resolve the puzzles and free the prince and the princess! There are mysterious information and symbols in the castle. Can you put the clues together, work out the puzzles and rescue everyone in the castle? 
There are so many rooms for exploration in the castle, including the hall, royal garden, kitchen, bedrooms, living room, attic and cellar! Feel free to enjoy the royal life here. There are lots of fun things to do, like hosting a wonderful feast with friends, taking a walk in the scenery royal garden, cooking your favorite dish with all kinds of food ingredients or having a nice and relaxing spa after a long day. 
Play with your imagination and creativity, and enjoy the fantasy world!
[Features]
 Explore in seven different scenarios!
 Solve the puzzles and rescue the royal members!
 Enjoy royal life!
 Dress up as a princess or king, etc!
 Beautiful pictures and vivid animations!
 Support multi-players mode! Play with friends!
 Open exploration! No rules and no limit!
 Hundreds of interactive props!
 Inspire imagination and creativity!
 No Wi-Fi required, it could be played anywhere
This version of Papo Town Castle is free to download. Unlock more rooms through in-app purchase. Once complete the purchase, it will be permanently unlocked and bound with your account. 
If there are any questions during the purchase and playing, feel free to contact us via contact@papoworld.com

Papo World aims to create a relaxed, harmonious and enjoyable game play environment to stimulate children's curiosity and interest in learning. 
Focused on games and supplemented by fun animated episodes, our preschool digital educational products are tailored for children. 
Through experiential and immersive gameplay, kids could develop healthy living habits and arise curiosity and creativity. Discover and inspire talents of every child!

bluejetty:00044235:ios.description:
Gangster Nation is a free multi-player gangster game set in the United States of America. Take on the role of a gangster today and join 1000's of other players across the globe. You will start from the bottom taking guidance from mob boss Butchie Gweyno, soon enough you will be on your way to becoming a top gangster. Be careful though because other gangsters may want to kill you, especially as you start to gain more of a reputation.
Let's take a quick glance at Gangster Nation's features:
- Steal cars and trade with them other gangsters.
- Extort money from other gangsters.
- Loot items to be used in various ways later.
- Take your chances at defusing a bomb and get paid for it.
- Start a gangster family or join someone else's family.
- Acquire perks to boost your capabilities.
- Organise heists with friends.
- Invest your money in drugs or company shares to make a profit.
- Purchase a weapon, stock up ammo and open fire on other gangsters.
- Put bounties on another gangster's head for someone else to do the dirty work.
- Take flights between 10 different cities.
- Bust other gangsters out of prison and get them to bust you out in return.
...and much more!

bluejetty:00168098:ios.description:
GED & Me is the official GED study app, built to help learners study in a way that fits real life. Whether you’re getting started, coming back after time away, or trying to stay consistent, the app gives you practical tools to help you keep moving forward. 
With GED & Me, learners can get guidance for the GED journey, practice with questions and answer explanations, use Syd, the AI tutor, for help with challenging topics, build study habits with reminders and goal support, know when to take GED Ready, and schedule the official GED test. 
For learners who want more support, Boost is the paid monthly subscription in GED & Me. It’s designed for people who want more clarity, more structure, and more confidence as they prepare for the GED. 
Boost includes unlimited Syd AI tutor chats, more video lessons for deeper instruction, and expanded practice questions for extra repetition and review. 
GED & Me is designed to be flexible, supportive, and easy to use on the go. Learners can study in short sessions, get help in the moment, and keep making progress one step at a time. 
Download GED & Me to start studying today, and upgrade to Boost whenever you’re ready for more support. 
Already created a student account at GED.com?
Be sure to log in to the app with that same email address to so your test appointments can be linked to your mobile app notifications and reminders!

Research shows that many adults struggle to spell even simple words. To help improve spelling skills and vocabulary, we created Spelling Quiz—a fun and engaging word game designed to boost your vocabulary.

With the right learning methods, you can remember words faster. Spelling Quiz is a free, offline-friendly trivia game filled with enjoyable spelling challenges and useful word knowledge. Practice anytime, anywhere in a relaxed atmosphere, and strengthen your memory through continuous play.

Game Features:
- Thousands of fun and challenging trivia quizzes!
- Daily rewards of generous chests and gems！
- Play for free, offline or online anytime, anywhere.
- Improve your vocabulary and test your knowledge!
- Various tools assist you in completing the puzzle.
- Global leaderboard, challenge the top！
- Well-crafted gameplay that helps you learn effectively.
- A must-have game for all word game enthusiasts!

What are you waiting for? Download Spelling Quiz: Word Trivia now and embark on an exciting, fun-filled spelling adventure! Test your word knowledge, train your brain, and enjoy your amazing spelling journey!

bluejetty:00061737:ios.summary:

TapeACall, a #1 business app in The United States, Argentina, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Denmark, Chile, Croatia, Czech Republic, Dominican Republic, El Salvador,
bluejetty:00061737:ios.description:
TapeACall lets you record your iPhone's incoming and outgoing phone calls. 
TapeACall, a #1 business app in The United States, Argentina, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Denmark, Chile, Croatia, Czech Republic, Dominican Republic, El Salvador, Estonia, Finland, France, Hong Kong, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Panama, Peru, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Singapore, Slovakia, Slovenia, South Africa, Spain, and Sweden!
TONS OF EXTRA FEATURES
√ Record your incoming calls 
√ Record your outgoing calls 
√ No limit on how long you can record a call for 
√ No limit on how many recordings you make 
√ No per minute fees! 
√ Transfer recordings to your new devices 
√ Easily download recordings to your computer 
√ Upload your recordings to Dropbox! 
√ Upload your recordings to Evernote! 
√ Upload your recordings to Google Drive! 
√ Email recordings to yourself in MP3 format 
√ Share recordings via SMS, Facebook & Twitter 
√ Label recordings so you can easily find them 
√ Recordings available as soon as you hang up 
√ Play recordings in the background 
√ Access to call recording laws 
√ Beautiful easy to use interface 
√ Push notifications take you to the recording
√ Customer service with real humans 
√ Developers that care about their customers 
√ New features added all the time 
√ One low yearly rate
NOTE: TapeACall requires your carrier supports 3-way calling.
- SimpleTalk and H2o Wireless do NOT offer this in the US. 
- EE in the UK no longer supports 3-way conference calling on new plans. 
Upon payment, you’ll gain immediate access to all features and unlimited recordings for one year. After the year ends, your plan will expire.
To continue using the app and enjoying its features, you can upgrade to a TapeACall Pro subscription. The TapeACall Pro subscription includes unlimited recordings and automatically renews unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your iTunes Account will be charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends, with the cost depending on the selected plan. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings at any time after purchase.
Frequently Asked Questions
—————————————————————— 
How does this app record calls? 
Take a look at our screenshots for step by step instructions. 
When you're on a call and you want to record it, open TapeACall and press the record button. We will put your call on hold and dial our recording line. As soon as our line answers tap the merge button on your screen to create a 3 way call between your other caller and our recording line. 
If you want to record an outgoing call, just press the record button. The app will dial our recording line and will begin recording as soon as our line answers. Once that happens, tap the add call button on your screen, call the person you want to record, then press the merge button when they answer. 
—————————————————————— 
Can I download recordings to my computer? 
Yes, and we've made it extremely easy to do this. Simply select a recording then tap the arrow button to the right of the player. This will show a screen containing a number of ways to share your recording. The most popular ways to transfer recordings to your computer are by email, Dropbox or Google Drive.
—————————————————————— 
How many recordings can I make? 
As many as you want! We don't have a limit on the number of recordings you can make. 
—————————————————————— 
Privacy Policy: tapeacall.com/privacy
Terms of Service: tapeacall.com/terms

bluejetty:00048513:android.summary: Pocket application is an AI and fintech-based product of “Pocket NBFI” LLC and it offers comprehensive financial services. “Pocket NBFI” LLC was established in May of 2019 and received the non-banking financial service license under Decree
bluejetty:00048513:android.description:
Pocket application is an AI and fintech-based product of “Pocket NBFI” LLC and it offers comprehensive financial services. “Pocket NBFI” LLC was established in May of 2019 and received the non-banking financial service license under Decree No 327 of the Financial Regulatory Commission of Mongolia on 25 November 2019. 
 Registering on the app: 
• Verification of phone number 
• National Identification Number 
• First and last name 
Privacy Policy 
We strictly adhere to the local regulations and laws of Mongolia. In addition, we keep the confidentiality of private information in a highly secure place. We are complaining to the Anti-Money Laundering Commission as well as the National Data Privacy Commission. We comply with the PCI-DSS international payment system and Information security management system ISO/IEC 27001 standards. 
Pocket application provides the following services under Mongolian laws and regulations: 
• QR code-based payment method
• Online Loan
We do not collect personal information from users, the user must provide it. 
How to get a loan? 
Once the customer downloads the application from the App Store and registers by using valid information, his/her credit scoring is evaluated based on our AI system and the Centralized Loan Database of the Bank of Mongolia. This prevents the customers from receiving multiple loans, which may fail to repay. Once the customer’s credit scoring is completed and the parties sign the Loan Agreement, the customer will be able to receive the loan anytime to their bank account without any additional criteria. If the customer gets a loan that meets his requirements and pays on time, they can improve their rating and reduce the principal interest rate to 1.5% per month, equal to 18% APR. 
Long-term Loan 
Loan amount: MNT 500,000 – MNT 35,000,000 
Monthly interest: 1.5% 
APR: 18% 
Loan period: 3-18 months 
Example: 
Principal loan - 500,000 MNT
Loan period – 3 months (can be extended before the end of the term)
Monthly interest – 1.5%
Monthly payment – 171,400 MNT
Total fee - 5,000 MNT
Total interest- 14,198.32
Total amount: 519,199 MNT 
Pocket Zero / Buy now pay later /
Pocket Zero is a service where you can make purchases from any shop with the Pocket Zero Trademark sign (our merchants) payments of which can be divided into 90 days. 
Loan amount: MNT100,000 – MNT10,000,000 
Monthly interest: 0% 
Term of loan: 90 days 
Example: 
Principal loan - 100,000 MNT
Loan period – 90 days (can be extended before the end of the term)
Monthly interest – 0%
Monthly payment – 16,700MNT
Total fee – 0 MNT
Total interest- 0 MNT
Total amount: 100,000MNT 
How to repay the loan? 
Customers can extend their loan repayment day as much as they wish. Penalty interest will be charged in case of an overdue loan. It is 20% of the principal interest rate. Our system informs the customers regarding the repayment due date via SMS message, email, notification on the Pocket App, and a phone call from our customer service. The customers can repay the loan directly from Pocket applications, local bank applications, local bank branches, and ATMs. 
Contact us: 
Customer service: +976-19001188 
E-mail: info@pocket.mn 
Facebook: @pocketmn 
Address: 13th floor, IC Tower-1, Paris Street, Sukhbaatar district, Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia

Once the customer downloads the application from the App Store and registers by using valid information, his/her credit scoring is evaluated based on our AI system and the Centralized Loan Database of the Bank of Mongolia. This prevents the customers from receiving multiple loans, which may fail to repay. Once the customer’s credit scoring is completed and the parties sign the Loan Agreement, the customer will be able to receive the loan anytime to their bank account without any additional criteria. If the customer gets a loan that meets his requirements and pays on time, they can improve their rating and reduce the principal interest rate to 1.5% per month, equal to 18% APR. 
Long-term Loan

APR: 18% 
Loan period: 3-18 months

Principal loan - 500,000 MNT

Pocket Zero is a service where you can make purchases from any shop with the Pocket Zero Trademark sign (our merchants) payments of which can be divided into 90 days. 
Loan amount: MNT100,000 – MNT10,000,000

Total amount: 100,000MNT

Customers can extend their loan repayment day as much as they wish. Penalty interest will be charged in case of an overdue loan. It is 20% of the principal interest rate. Our system informs the customers regarding the repayment due date via SMS message, email, notification on the Pocket App, and a phone call from our customer service. The customers can repay the loan directly from Pocket applications, local bank applications, local bank branches, and ATMs.

bluejetty:00187428:ios.name: MyStuff2 Pro
bluejetty:00187428:ios.summary: It's now easier than ever to keep track of all your stuff. Organize your collections, music, movies, books, video games, electronics, wine lists, jewelry, appliances, office supplies, or anything else in your possession with this easy to us
bluejetty:00187428:ios.description:
It's now easier than ever to keep track of all your stuff. Organize your collections, music, movies, books, video games, electronics, wine lists, jewelry, appliances, office supplies, or anything else in your possession with this easy to use but powerful database and inventory application.
MyStuff2 Pro allows you to get organized. Avoid buying something you already have. Make it easy to find your stuff. Be prepared in case of theft, fire, or flood.
NOTE: The initial free version has a limit of 15 items but it includes all Pro features so you can try out all functionality. Once upgraded to unrestricted items, the Pro level features become optional in-app purchases.
Data entry is made easy with barcode scanning and product search, autofill, quick copy, and bulk editing.
User definable categories allow you to keep track of what you want and how you want it. MyStuff2 Pro comes with sample categories to get you started quickly but you can set it up any way you desire to fit your needs.
Here is a small list of things you can keep track of:
• Movies
• Music
• Books
• Video Games
• Coins
• Stamps
• Quilting/knitting/sewing materials
• Wine Cellar
• Garage Sales / Estate Sales
• Art
• Electronics
• Appliances
• Toys
• Clothes
• Jewelry
• Furniture
• Product Inventory
• Anything you want to organize
Maintain multiple, independent databases of information.
Automatically sync your data between your iOS and macOS devices or share your data automatically with other MyStuff2 Pro users.
Import existing data from other applications using CSV files, Excel (xlsx) and Open Document (ods) spreadsheet files.
Transfer data into or out of MyStuff2 Pro using your own computer, email, iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, Box, OneDrive, ftp, other apps, or other iOS/macOS devices running MyStuff2 Pro.
You can export your data as CSV files, PDF reports, or Excel (xlsx) and Open Document (ods) spreadsheet files.
Email data to yourself or others. View data in other apps installed on your iOS device.
Backup and restore features allow you make a copy of your data for safe keeping.
User defined actions allow you to keep track of various item events. Examples include donating, lending, selling, using, or repairing.
User defined bundles allow you to group related items into an easy to use collection.
Quickly find your items using MyStuff2 Pro's powerful filtering, searching, and sorting capabilities.
MyStuff2 Pro allows you to enter the following types of data:
• Text (single-line)
• Barcode
• Calculated (formulas supporting 130+ functions)
• Color
• Contact (Address Book)
• Count
• Currency
• Date
• Decimal (e.g. 3.14)
• Duration (hour, minute, second)
• Email Address
• Integer (e.g. 42)
• Item Link (related items)
• Location (GPS, address, map)
• Note (multi-line)
• Phone Number
• Rating
• Signature
• Term (years, months, days)
• Time
• Toggle (Yes/No, On/Off, etc.)
• Voice Memo
• Web Address (URL)
• Lookup List (user defined list of values)
Store up to 40 images for each of your items.
Add file attachments to your items. View and export the attachments.
Setup alarms on any date value. Great for things like warranty or replacement reminders.
Share your data with others. Email lists to co-workers or friends and family. Other users of MyStuff2 Pro can import your shared data directly simply by opening the email attachment.
Customize item lists to display exactly the data you want to see. Apply colors to categories, actions, or individual items to make them stand out.
See a summary of the item list you are viewing. Shows item count, totals, and averages of your data.
Protect access to your data with a passcode. Keep others out of your data. You can also passcode protect individual categories.
Please visit http://www.maddysoft.com/mystuff to see additional information, tutorials, FAQs, and contact information for MyStuff2 Pro.
NOTE: If you have any issues please contact support.
Supports backup files from Mindersoft's MYStuff Pro macOS app.
