listings.description:
Welcome to AI Chatbot - Ask AI Anything, your ultimate AI toolkit designed to meet all your AI needs in one convenient location! Our app offers a diverse range of powerful features to enhance your daily tasks and creativity:

1. AI Chat: Engage with our intelligent chat feature, complete with curated AI scenario presets and character presets for tailored interactions.
2. AI Image Generation: Effortlessly extract keywords from images or text, allowing you to create unique visual content with just a few taps.
3. AI Music: Generate catchy and captivating AI songs that will elevate your playlists and inspire your musical journey.
4. AI PDF Recognition: Summarize lengthy documents and extract key information quickly and easily, saving you valuable time.
5. AI Math Calculations: Solve complex mathematical problems and equations with our intuitive AI calculator.
6. AI Movie Summaries: Get concise summaries of your favorite films, helping you decide what to watch next.
7. YouTube Video Summaries: Easily digest video content with quick summaries of YouTube videos, perfect for busy schedules.
8. AI Playlist Recommendations: Discover new music tailored to your taste with our personalized playlist recommendations.
9. And More: Explore additional fun and practical AI features that enhance your everyday tasks.

Join us and experience the future of productivity and creativity with AI Chatbot - Ask AI Anything!

MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTION
You can subscribe for unlimited access to all features in the app.
Two subscription options: weekly and annually plans.

Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

bluejetty:00192201:android.summary:

With an infinity of levels to complete & mesmerising colors, we will amaze you with this asmr game, with satisfying notes
bluejetty:00192201:android.description:
Tower Color is a new one-hand addictive 3D Game where you have to do a smash hit on the color tower with a color ball.
With an infinity of levels to complete & mesmerising colors, we will amaze you with this asmr game, with satisfying notes one you break bricks and demolish the tower color.
Level after level, the difficulty increases and the color tower gets higher and higher! Become the best tower crusher once you throw the color ball and smash. Let this game amaze you with the wonderful color bricks falling apart. 
How to play?
- Start each level by choosing the right angle to hit the tower, swipe right or left.
- Throw the color ball on blocks and bricks that are same color match to destroy it!
- Demolish the Tower like a bucket crusher!
Features:
- Colorful blocks to see and a lot bricks to break
- Beautiful graphics, satisfying gameplay, asmr game with color match bricks
- Simple one-touch gameplay, just throw the color ball
- Easy to learn how to become a tower crusher
- Suitable for all ages that are fans of color ball, color match and bucket crusher games
Train your precision to win in this smash hit tower game. We challenge you to reach level 100!
Can you amaze us with your skills, tower crusher?

bluejetty:00130585:ios.name: Dash In Rewards
bluejetty:00130585:ios.summary: Dash In Rewards is the award-winning Mobile App and Loyalty Program that gets members immediate savings on Fuel & makes it easy to earn Points & Redeem offers on Fuel, Food & Car Washes at Dash In Stores. The app makes it easier to Fuel Up,
bluejetty:00130585:ios.description:
Dash In Rewards is the award-winning Mobile App and Loyalty Program that gets members immediate savings on Fuel & makes it easy to earn Points & Redeem offers on Fuel, Food & Car Washes at Dash In Stores. The app makes it easier to Fuel Up, Order Food & get a Car Wash. 
SAVE RIGHT AWAY 
Sign up and save 25 cents per gallon every time you fill up for the first 60 days & 5 cents per gallon after that for being a member. As if that isn’t enough, new Members get a Free Car Wash and great savings on delicious Food inside the store.
BUILD UP YOUR POINTS 
Scan your Member ID code at the register or enter your phone number anytime you fill-up or shop In-Store or on Car Wash and you will automatically earn as follows:
1 point per gallon for Regular or Diesel fuel
2 points per gallon for Mid-grade or Premium fuel
3 points per dollar spent on Splash In Car Wash
5 points per dollar spent in Dash In Stores 
REDEEM FOR GREAT SAVINGS ON FUEL, FOOD, AND CAR WASHES 
Redeem your points to get even more savings at the Pump, on Food & Car Washes. You choose what to Redeem on & Rewards start as low as 100 points.
AMAZING MEMBER-ONLY OFFERS 
Get access to member-only offers. 
SAVE TIME BY ORDERING AHEAD 
Use Mobile Ordering to have your favorite Dash In Stackadillas, Sandwiches, Wings, Pizza & other Made-to-Order Food prepared in advance so you can grab & get on your way. 
PAY AT THE PUMP 
Securely pay for Fuel & activate the pump directly from the App. Automatically get your 25 cent per gallon discount during the first 60 days & 5 cent per gallon discount after that for being a member. 
CAR WASHES 
Select & pay for a Car Wash in the App. You will see your Car Wash code which you can use whenever it’s most convenient.

bluejetty:00118772:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00118772:ios.description:
AgeSA Mobil
Sözleşme ve Poliçe Görüntüleme
AgeSA Mobil üzerinden Bireysel Emeklilik (BES), Hayat Sigortası ve Ferdi Kaza Sigortanıza ait birikim, poliçe ve teminat detaylarını görüntüleyebilirsiniz. BES planınız için toplu ödeme yapabilir veya katkı payınızı değiştirebilirsiniz.
FonPro ile Birikimlerinize Yön Verin
Gelişmiş fon danışmanlığı fonksiyonu ile BES birikimlerinize kolayca yön verebilirsiniz. “Fon Dağılımı” ekranındaki Risk Profil Testi’ni çözerek size en uygun fonları belirleyip fon dağılımınızı AgeSA Mobil’den hemen değiştirebilirsiniz. 
Hesaplamalar
AgeSA Mobil ile hayalinizdeki emeklilik için hedeflediğiniz birikim veya maaşa ulaşmak adına yapmanız gereken ödemeyi %2–10 getiri oranı seçenekleriyle kolayca hesaplayabilir, hayat sigortası ürünlerindeki %15’e varan vergi avantajını anında görüntüleyebilirsiniz.
App to App
AgeSA' dan iyi ki ‘leri çoğaltacak yenilik! Müşterilerimiz banka kanalından da AgeSA Mobil' e erişebilecek ve AgeSA Mobil’den banka kanalına kolaylıkla dönebileceklerdir.
Görüntülü Görüşme
AgeSA' dan iyi ki‘ leri çoğaltacak yenilik! İşaret dili ile görüntülü görüşme hizmetimiz artık AgeSA Mobil' de. Erişilebilir bir dünya için engelsiz dijital deneyimle AgeSA Mobil daima sizinle.
Finans Haberleri
Bireysel Emeklilik fonlarımıza ait performansı, piyasaların güncel durumuna dair haberleri ve uzman görüşlerini “Finans Haberleri” ekranından inceleyebilirsiniz.
Yeni Ürün Talebi
Yeni Bireysel Emeklilik (BES), Hayat Sigortası ve Ferdi Kaza Sigortası ihtiyaçlarınız için size sunduğumuz seçenekleri inceleyerek uygulama içerisinden detaylı bilgi talebinizi iletebilirsiniz. Henüz AgeSA’lı değilseniz de uygulamaya giriş yapmadan size en uygun birikim veya sigorta ürününü belirleyip başvuruda bulunabilirsiniz. Önceden yaptığınız başvuruların durumunu da kontrol edebilirsiniz.
Biyometrik Giriş
AgeSA' dan iyi ki ‘leri çoğaltacak yenilik! Müşterilerimiz yeni eklenen biyometrik giriş özelliği ile, şifre ihtiyacı olmadan AgeSA Mobil' e kolayca giriş yapabilecekler.
BES satın almak artık AgeSA Mobil ile çok kolay!
AgeSA' dan iyi ki ‘leri çoğaltacak yenilik! Hem kendiniz hem 18 yaş altı çocuklarınız için BES sözleşmenizi AgeSA Mobil ile şimdi hızlı ve kolayca başlatabilirsiniz. Çok sayıda fon seçeneğiyle birikimlerinizi değerlendirirken, %20 devlet katkısından yararlanabileceğiniz AgeSA BES ile hayallerinize bir adım daha yaklaşın.
Emeklilik Detayım Sayfası
AgeSA Mobil’e yeni eklenen “Emeklilik Detayım” sayfası sayesinde sözleşmenize ait tüm özet bilgilere artık tek ekrandan erişebilirsiniz.
Her türlü sorunuz ve talebiniz için bize uygulamanın İletişim ekranından ulaşabilirsiniz. 
https://www.agesa.com.tr

Welcome to the excavator games 2020 . It's Time to work with loader ops to become a real excavator operator and a construction worker on steep hill climb areas. This heavy excavator crane game will bring you real off-road challenging game play. In this game you have to operate heavy machinery in steep hill climb areas. Excavator game 2019 will offer you to drive your loader excavator and dumper truck to carry mud and stones from one place to another in order to clear road.
In this heavy excavator crane game you will have to play role of crane operator or a loader and a dump truck driver in hilly off-road area. You may have played truck games, trailer driving games and loader simulator, but this excavator simulator is really challenging and really daring for the beginners. Use your pro skills of operating heavy machinery and enjoy amazing drive of excavator trailer rescue simulator on sharp hilly paths. Every child dreams about controlling heavy excavators and cranes. So this excavator simulator 2020 is best driver and parking simulator game for youngster, teenager, and mature people who love to play and controlling such machines.
Sometimes we often come across natural catastrophes happening every now and then, there will always be casualties, effecties and also survivors. Why don’t you become a part of rescue excavator team off road drive adventure in this extreme dump truck driver. So get ready and use your unique skills of operating heavy machines to help some survivors in this excavator games 2020. It’s not some ordinary dump truck games , But you actually have to work on construction sites with huge construction machines like excavator crane and dumper truck. In truck driving simulator 2020 game you will have to test your driving and excavator operating skills on off-road construction areas if you can handle all kinds of construction machines and drive heavy machines with care, then this loader simulator game is for you. 
Features:
• Amazing off road landscapes.
• Smooth real trucks driving games controls.
• sand excavator and loader extremely easy to handle.
• Realistic weather condition, sunny day or raining.
• Detailed interior.
• Different camera angles, makes trailer parking a lot easier.

The system offers quick and impactful information. You can customize your personal landing page to jump into your accounts, make quick transfers, and even link accounts from other financial institutions for display. You can see your entire financial picture in one place.
Transfers & Payments is used to make or schedule transfers to other accounts at Premier Bank, make loan payments and manage external accounts.

Manage Accounts allows you to select up to five favorite accounts to display immediately on the homepage. You can then rearrange the display order as well as change the nickname of the accounts.
Messages Center is where you can send and receive secure messages with Premier Bank. You can route messages to the appropriate department, and you can include attachments. bluejetty:00071184:ios.description:
It's not just a clock. It's a statement piece. Transform your device into a stunning Flip Clock, the perfect centerpiece for your desk setup. More than just aesthetics, it's a powerful tool designed to help you focus, study, and seize every second.
BEAUTY MEETS PRODUCTIVITY
We believe your most personal device deserves more than a boring clock. Fullscreen Clock combines minimalist design with powerful productivity features to create an experience that is both beautiful and functional.
ICONIC FLIP CLOCK: Enjoy the satisfying, classic animation of a retro flip clock, reborn with a modern, clean design. It's the ultimate accessory for your Gong-stagram study sessions and aesthetic workspace photos.
DEEP FOCUS TIMER: Crush your goals with our integrated focus timer. Use the Pomodoro Technique or set custom sessions to improve concentration during study, work, or meditation.
STUNNING WIDGETS: Your clock shouldn't be trapped inside an app. Add our beautifully designed widgets to your Home Screen for an instant, stylish time check.
FEATURES YOU'LL LOVE:
Elegant & Minimalist Interface: A clean, distraction-free design that puts the focus on time.
Extensive Customization: Personalize your clock with different themes, sizes, and even your own background photos.
Versatile Timers & Stopwatch: From a simple countdown to a precision stopwatch, we have all your timing needs covered.
Floating Clock (iPadOS): Keep track of time with a clock that floats above your other apps – perfect for multitasking.

bluejetty:00024741:ios.description:
Take accurate Pupillary Distance (PD) measurements using your iPhone's TrueDepth Camera system.
Pupillary Distance is the distance between the center of your pupils and is an important value for prescription eyeglasses and VR headsets.
- Super easy to use
Just look at the camera and your face will be measured with results in real time
- Near and far sight measures
Your measurement consists of two values: One for far sight, useful for myopia glasses, and one for near sight, suitable for reading glasses or hyperopia.
- Measurements History
You can keep a history of all measurements made using the app, an useful feature for eye doctors
* This app requires iPhone X or newer with a TrueDepth Camera to work *

bluejetty:00187088:ios.description:
Welcome to the VectorVest Stock Advisory app. It puts the information you need for your investing research at your fingertips.
VectorVest analyzes, sorts and ranks over 16,000 stocks every day for Value, Safety and Timing, and gives each one a buy, sell or hold rating. It combines fundamental valuation with technical analysis, so you get clear ratings instead of raw data to sort through on your own.
RULE-BASED MARKET TIMING
It's not just what you buy, it's when you buy.
VectorVest's Market Timing System has been refined over 37 years in the financial industry. Instead of opinion-driven commentary, you get simple, rule-based signals based on market data. Whether you are aggressive, prudent or conservative, there is a timing system for you. Get timing alerts on your mobile device, check the dial gauge for current signals, and review historical performance for your favorite timing system.
The Market Timing Gauge gives you an at-a-glance summary of current market conditions, and VectorVest's Market Guidance Daily Video Report walks through what the signals are showing.
DYNAMIC STOCK SCREENER
Find stocks that match your strategy with the VectorVest Stock Screener. Whether you are conservative and focused on safety and dividend income, or aggressive and looking for more volatile stocks, we have a screen for you.
With one tap, scan thousands of stocks and see which ones meet your criteria.
PREMIUM STOCK WATCHLISTS
Where do you turn to find stocks? The internet? TV? Newsletters? They usually cover only a handful of stocks and can't keep up with live, intraday market action. VectorVest gives you daily ratings on thousands of stocks in one place.
TRADENOW
Trade directly from the VectorVest Mobile App with TRADENOW. TRADENOW is integrated with Interactive Brokers and TradeStation in the U.S. and with Questrade in Canada.
STOCK CHARTS
A picture is worth a lot more than words.
VectorVest's charts are simple, yet powerful. Display the buy/sell/hold ratings for any stock, or add VectorVest's Relative Timing Momentum Indicator to see how a stock's momentum is changing.
Available Monthly Subscriptions include:
Free
Premium $19.99 USD
Premium+ $49.99 USD
All investors should be aware of the risks involved in implementing aggressive strategies. They should not assume that future results will be profitable or will equal representations of past performance; real, indicated or implied. VectorVest, Inc., its employees or affiliates are not responsible for any losses you may incur.
http://www.vectorvest.com/legal-information
http://www.vectorvest.com/privacy-policy

Cornelius, NC 28031

bluejetty:00145712:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00145712:ios.description:
Finally Feel Your Heart Move In Prayer
Kalaam uses cutting-edge technology to help you understand Quranic Arabic - in a way that you'll never forget it.
NOW AVAILABLE IN 80+ LANGUAGES!
Including Bengali, Urdu, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi and many other languages not typically available in app stores.
We've re-imagined the Arabic learning process at every step.
By dedicating just 10 minutes a day, you can understand:
40% of the Quran in one week
70% in one month
95% in one year
It doesn't matter whether you're a beginner, intermediate or expert. There's a clear path from your current level to 100% understanding.
Start off with an on-boarding test and receive insights into your current understanding level, paving the way for a tailored learning journey. Kalaam will tell you exactly what percentage of the Quran you currently understand.
Every single day, come in for a daily lesson that will teach you new words with their Quranic context. Beautiful images showcase their range of meanings. Delve deeper to explore their usage throughout the Quran.
Memorized certain surahs? Prioritize them so you learn words from there before anything else.
Kalaam uses a learning technique known as active recall with spaced repetition (popular in medical schools) to ensure that you never forget what you've learned by prompting you to review these words right when you're on the brink of forgetting them.
Once you get to about 65% understanding, unlock a daily Quran translation challenge tailed to your vocabulary.
Earn points with each activity and win badges by competing with Kalaam users world-wide, or just those in your country or city. 
Create custom leaderboards to compete against your friends and family and learn together.
Experience the Quran come alive as you learn! With Kalaam's Quran-reading mode, words shift in color, and translations start to disappear, reflecting your growing understanding. Immerse in the text with newfound confidence, sans translation.
Privacy Policy: http://kalaamapp.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.kalaamapp.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00029310:ios.description:
This app allows you to resize up to 500 images at once to whatever size in pixels you like, quickly and easily.
You can specify the output format using one of the following four resize modes:
1. Fixed width (Proportional height)
2. Fixed height (Proportional width)
3. Maximum pixel (Proportional width or height)
4. Aspect Fill: Scale the image to fill the output size (Some parts will be clipped)
5. Aspect Fit: Scale the image to fit the output size (Some parts will be filled with the defined color) 
Batch Resize gives you the option to save the resized images in Camera Roll and additionally in a custom album.
The maximum output size for 32 bit devices is limited to 4000 x 4000 pixels and for 64 bit devices to 8000 x 8000 pixels.

bluejetty:00123752:ios.name: Bridge Constructor Stunts
bluejetty:00123752:ios.summary:
The successful Bridge Constructor series – number 1 in the AppStore in over 60 countries, with over 35 million players worldwide – treads new paths with Bridge Constructor Stunts! 
Stuntman and engineer in one? No problem with Bridge Const
bluejetty:00123752:ios.description:
The successful Bridge Constructor series – number 1 in the AppStore in over 60 countries, with over 35 million players worldwide – treads new paths with Bridge Constructor Stunts! 
Stuntman and engineer in one? No problem with Bridge Constructor Stunts!
Build imposing ramps and loops to reach your goal in the diverse stages. But building structures alone isn't enough this time: you sit behind the wheel of the vehicles yourself and have to maneuver them skillfully to the goal. Collect stars, complete daredevil jumps, flips and spectacular stunts, leaving behind a trail of destruction across the entire level to beat the high score. But you can only do all that with perfectly constructed bridges and ramps.
Join the huge Let's Play community
To ensure none of your jumps are forgotten, you can save your runs as videos, upload them via the sharing feature and share them with your friends. Let the world be part of your most outrageous jumps!
Improved Construction Mode
Once again you have access to a variety of building materials with different properties. Numerous improvements make building even easier: simply tap to convert a beam you have built into road, and vice-versa. Tap and hold on a part of the construction and you now have the option to reposition your structures without having to build them from scratch. 
Loose Screw!
We have hidden some hard-to-reach screws in some of the levels. Find and collect them, and you might be able to put these screws to good use in the future...
FEATURES: 
- The latest instalment in the internationally successful Bridge Constructor series!
- Improved and simplified Construction Mode
- Build ramps and drive vehicles across them yourself
- Diverse levels with different objectives: collect stars, score target, reach the goal… 
- Delivery vans and dump trucks with cargo that wreaks havoc when coming loose, but is also useful to help you collect items
- Various building materials
- Spectacular stunts and rampages of destruction
- Achievements and rankings
- Replay feature and video sharing: save your best bridge crossings and stunts and share them with your friends
Follow us on Twitter, Facebook and Instagram: 
www.facebook.com/BridgeConstructor
www.twitter.com/headupgames
www.instagram.com/headupgames
If you have any problems with the game or would like to share feedback or suggestions for improvements, please send us an email: support@headupgames.com

bluejetty:00146492:ios.summary: Dive into the world of Original Squishmallows™ with this relaxing, match-3 puzzle game! Unlock and collect rare Squishmallows as you solve fun puzzles and complete exciting challenges. Customize your player feed to showcase your growing Sq
bluejetty:00146492:ios.description:
Dive into the world of Original Squishmallows™ with this relaxing, match-3 puzzle game! Unlock and collect rare Squishmallows as you solve fun puzzles and complete exciting challenges. Customize your player feed to showcase your growing Squad and share your achievements with friends!
Enjoy exclusive seasonal content with season passes, discover limited-time drops tied to real-world events, and test your luck with the claw machines to win even more adorable Squishmallows. With no timer to rush you, you can take your time, solving puzzles, unlocking new Squishmallows, and enjoying endless fun at your own pace.
Collect Squishmallows Your Way! 
- Collectible Squishmallows: Unlock and collect rare, limited-edition Squishmallows styles as you progress through the game. Your collection grows as you solve puzzles and complete special challenges.
- Personalized Player Feed: Customize your player feed to show off your Squishmallows Squad and creative designs. Share your progress and achievements with friends! Collect Backgrounds and Stickers to show off your collection with your own unique style.
- Season Passes & Exclusive Drops: Enjoy exclusive seasonal content and rewards with season passes. Look out for limited-time drops that are tied to real-world Squishmallows events and promotions!
- Claw Machines: Try your luck with the claw machines to win new, rare, and even exclusive Squishmallows. The excitement never ends!
- Squishmallows Rewards: Earn Squishmallows points the more you collect, and make progress on the Squishmallows Reward Road! The higher your Squishmallows score the more rewards you receive, including Keys to unlock your favorite Squishmallows
- Squishmallows Hunt: Want to find that special Squishmallows? Use Magnets for a better chance to get the one you want, and add your favorites to your Wishlist and unlock with Keys.
- Relaxing Gameplay with No Timer: Play at your own pace, there’s no timer, so you can relax, unwind, and enjoy solving puzzles without the pressure to rush.
- Match-3 Puzzle Gameplay: Solve thousands of fun puzzle levels by matching colorful Squishmallows, with each level offering new challenges and surprises.
Contact us for support at: support@squishmallowsmatchsupport.zendesk.com 
By downloading this app, you agree to our privacy policy available at:
Privacy Policy - https://zaibatsu.fi/privacy-policy/
Please note that this game is free to download and play, but some game items are available for purchase using real money. 
A network connection is required to play the game.

Step into the next evolution of RPGs.
In Warcodes, every product you scan unlocks a one-of-a-kind creature with its own personality and powers. This intelligent world blends creativity, strategy, and technology into a groundbreaking AI RPG experience filled with dynamic AI characters that grow and evolve alongside you.
Scan and Create Intelligent Characters
Turn real-world barcodes into digital beings unlike anything else. Each scan generates a unique character with abilities inspired by the item itself. Build your squad of evolving AI characters, train them, and prepare for battles that define what makes this an unforgettable AI RPG adventure.
Train, Evolve, and Master Your Team
Discover resources, evolve your creations, and unlock powerful upgrades. As your characters level up, they learn new strategies and gain stronger abilities. This is an AI RPG that rewards curiosity, creativity, and smart play—every scan brings new surprises to your journey.
Battle Players in a Living World
Challenge friends and players worldwide in real-time combat. Watch your AI characters adapt to new opponents and environments, turning every fight into a strategic encounter. Compete in ranked matches, climb leaderboards, and prove yourself as a master in this ever-changing AI RPG universe.

Unique AI Characters: Every scan creates a different hero with its own powers and style.
Immersive AI RPG Gameplay: A blend of exploration, strategy, and intelligent evolution.
Evolving Combat: Characters learn, react, and improve through each battle.
Customization and Growth: Level up, evolve, and refine your team with rare items.
Endless Discovery: Millions of products mean limitless possibilities for creation.
Create. Battle. Evolve.
Warcodes brings together the depth of a true AI RPG with the excitement of discovery. Collect, train, and command your AI characters in a world that’s constantly changing and uniquely yours.
Download Warcodes today — where your imagination brings new characters to life.

bluejetty:00063988:ios.description:
Welcome to RealmCraft Free Block Building and Survival Game. 
Explore cube worlds, fight with aggressive mobs, destroy caves and build.
Features of RealmCraft Game
~ Fascinating open block world in which everything consists of 3D cubes.
~ Worlds creating. Destroy blocks and cubes, collect blocks, build blocks, move them as you like and create your own cube world; 
Cut wood, break stones, mine blocks and create out of them building and worlds of your dreams!
~ Blocks crafting. RealmCraft game offers you 100+ types of blocks that can be used to build and create useful items;
~ Crafting mode. Free blocks mining game allows you and your friends craft, survive, mine and build!
~ Various game modes - SURVIVAL MODE and CREATIVE MODE, WORLDS, MINI-GAMES;
~ Realmcraft is a simulator for building, crafting and farming. Spawn eggs to get to know all the unique mobs, learn how to tame a wolf, ocelot and horse, start growing plants and set up your very own block farm!
~ Multiplayer and 4 mini games! Meet other fans of building games, chat with them, do joint construction, and share life hacks and secrets of the game.
~ World exploration. In this blocks world with colorful cubic graphics, many lite biomes await you: from forests and plains to deserts and taiga. In each biome, you will be greeted by unique flora and fauna.
Survival mode
Mine, build, collect resources and plants, beat enemies and go hunting to survive in survival mode (single player). 
Master the secrets of surviving and go from simple wooden armor to strong diamond armor! 
Use enchantments to increase your damage and defense! Let the evil mobs regret meeting you! 
Creative mode
Enjoy unlimited creativity, immortality and flying in creative mode. Start your block city building! Build your dream houses from cubes, or copy real-life landmarks and houses from TV shows. Also here you can become a real engineer, creating complex mechanisms from electrum. Most importantly, remember that there are no restrictions in the open cube world of Realmcraft, so let your imagination run wild!
Worlds and mini games
Realmcraft has a multiplayer mode called Worlds. Make friends with real players from all over the world and build together! Show other players the buildings you create and give tips on crafting and building. RealmCraft game has a private chat in which you can communicate only with your friend!
 If you like creative & survival block building and craft games then the free Realmcraft sandbox is exactly what you are looking for!

Explore cube worlds, fight with aggressive mobs, destroy caves and build.

Features of RealmCraft Game
~ Fascinating open block world in which everything consists of 3D cubes.

~ Worlds creating. Destroy blocks and cubes, collect blocks, build blocks, move them as you like and create your own cube world; 
Cut wood, break stones, mine blocks and create out of them building and worlds of your dreams!

~ Blocks crafting. RealmCraft game offers you 100+ types of blocks that can be used to build and create useful items;

~ Crafting mode. Free blocks mining game allows you and your friends craft, survive, mine and build!

~ Various game modes - SURVIVAL MODE and CREATIVE  MODE, WORLDS, MINI-GAMES;

~ Realmcraft is a simulator for building, crafting and farming. Spawn eggs to get to know all the unique mobs, learn how to tame a wolf, ocelot and horse, start growing plants and set up your very own block farm!

~ Multiplayer and  4 mini games! Meet other fans of building games, chat with them, do joint construction, and share life hacks and secrets of the game.

~ World exploration. In this blocks world with colorful cubic graphics, many lite biomes await you: from forests and plains to deserts and taiga. In each biome, you will be greeted by unique flora and fauna.


Survival mode
Mine, build, collect resources and plants, beat enemies and go hunting to survive in survival mode (single player). 
Master the secrets of surviving and go from simple wooden armor to strong diamond armor! 
Use enchantments to increase your damage and defense! Let the evil mobs regret meeting you! 

Creative mode
Enjoy unlimited creativity, immortality and flying in creative mode. Start your block city building! Build your dream houses from cubes, or copy real-life landmarks and houses from TV shows. Also here you can become a real engineer, creating complex mechanisms from electrum. Most importantly, remember that there are no restrictions in the open cube world of Realmcraft, so let your imagination run wild!

Worlds and mini games
Realmcraft has a multiplayer mode called Worlds. Make friends with real players from all over the world and build together! Show other players the buildings you create and give tips on crafting and building. RealmCraft game has a private chat in which you can communicate only with your friend!

 If you like creative & survival block building and craft games then the free Realmcraft sandbox is exactly what you are looking for!

Welcome you to Our Official Gaming channel: 
YOUTUBE: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2jqGx9MXCUJjYZY_f19vug (search as Tellurion mobile Games)

Support & Suggestions & Questions & Help
https://realmcraft.app/contact-us/

https://realmcraft.app/

bluejetty:00160863:ios.name: Dots Blitz: Connect, win Money
bluejetty:00160863:ios.summary: Dots Blitz is a puzzle adventure and challenging Skillz-powered® game where your goal is to connect dots in order to earn as many points as possible. Play head-to-head games & tournaments against real people. Challenge people around the wor
bluejetty:00160863:ios.description:
Dots Blitz is a puzzle adventure and challenging Skillz-powered® game where your goal is to connect dots in order to earn as many points as possible. Play head-to-head games & tournaments against real people. Challenge people around the world - Beat them and win real cash prizes! Match colors to win!
As you can guess, the main goal is to connect adjacent planets of the same color to collect them.
Main features:
- Real Cash Prizes - Compete against real opponents, climb on the leaderboard and win real cash prizes!
- Skillz rewards - Keep playing to climb up tiers and gather points so you can get some of the valuable Skillz rewards.
- Play to Unlock Leagues - Play matches to unlock leagues that have guaranteed prizes!
- Trophies - While playing matches, you are also competing to achieve different achievements and win trophies!
- Timings and limits - There is a time and move limit for each level.
- Score - Get 10 points for each connected planet. When you connect more than 2 planets, you get a multiplied score (with x10 multiplier for 7+ planets).
- Loop Bonus - Close the circuit of planets to collect them and earn bonus points!
- Goals Bonus - Get 1000 points for each completed goal.
- Boosters - Boosters are charged with the energy of destroyed planets - Charge and use it wisely! They enable you to collect all planets on the table or to collect all the planets of a certain color.
- Multiplayer Competitions - A brand new way to play! Multiplayer competitions powered by Skillz! - Exciting tournaments, live events, and amazing prizes!
- Special Offers - There is a special section where you can find special offers such as those for new players and many others.
Check your profile to see your current rankings, collected experience points, and running competitions in which you participate.
How does it work?
- Skillz matches you with players of similar ability.
- Connect planets (dots) and earn more points than your opponent.
- Level up and climb the leaderboard.
- Win amazing prizes!
Download Dots Blitz now and enjoy the amazing puzzle adventure with a realistic opportunity to win real cash prizes!

bluejetty:00077362:ios.description:
HATCH YOUR OWN MAGICAL UNICORN!
Welcome to BoBo World: Unicorn Princess, a magical world where you can discover unicorn eggs, hatch adorable unicorns, care for them as they grow, create unique looks, design colourful outfits, and make up your own stories.
Explore magical places, find hidden eggs, raise your unicorn friends, decorate your world, and play your way with no fixed rules.
HATCH UNICORN EGGS
Explore the world and search for mysterious unicorn eggs hidden throughout different locations. Take them to the Unicorn Hatchery and discover which magical unicorn is waiting inside!
RAISE & CARE FOR YOUR UNICORNS
Feed your unicorns and care for them as they grow from adorable babies into beautiful magical companions.
CREATE YOUR OWN UNICORN
Make every unicorn unique. Customise hairstyles, eyes, horns, colours, and more to create the unicorn you imagine.
DRESS UP & CREATE
Discover more than 30 outfits and create your own magical styles. Change colours and experiment with different combinations to make every look special.
DESIGN YOUR MAGICAL WORLD
Bring your creativity into every space. Customise furniture such as beds, chairs, tables, and more using solid colours, gradients, glitter, and fun patterns.
EXPLORE 5 MAGICAL PLACES
Discover different unicorn-themed locations:
• Unicorn House
• Unicorn Castle
• Lakeside Forest
• Rainbow Ball
• Unicorn Hatchery
Look around carefully—surprises and mysterious unicorn eggs may be hiding everywhere!
CREATE YOUR OWN STORIES
There are no fixed rules. Move characters, interact with objects, dress up, decorate, care for unicorns, and create your own magical adventures.
PLAY TOGETHER
Multi-touch support makes it easy to explore and create stories together.
PLAY ANYWHERE
Enjoy your unicorn adventure without needing Wi-Fi.
BOBO SVIP
One BoBo SVIP subscription unlocks full content across participating BoBo apps. Download included BoBo games and enjoy all included content with no ads or additional purchases while your subscription is active.
Hatch your unicorn, create your magical world, and begin your own BoBo adventure!
WHAT'S NEW
A magical new update is here!
• Improved performance and overall game stability.
• Fixed several issues for a smoother unicorn adventure.
• BoBo SVIP support is now available. Enjoy full content across participating BoBo apps with no ads while your subscription is active.
Update now and continue your magical BoBo unicorn adventure!

bluejetty:00018136:ios.description:
Budget app for income, expenses, household budget and finances – MoneyControl.
Keep track of your finances, manage income and expenses, and plan your budget easily and clearly.
MoneyControl is a powerful budget app that has been continuously developed for over 15 years. It focuses on simplicity, clarity and full control over your finances – not more, but also not less.
EASY INCOME & EXPENSE TRACKING
A good budget app must be fast and easy to use. With MoneyControl, you can record income and expenses in just a few seconds – even while on the go:
 • Add a new income or expense
 • Enter the amount
 • Optionally select category, account, person or note
 • Done
With shortcuts, recurring or frequent expenses can be added even faster with a single tap.
HOUSEHOLD BUDGET & FINANCES AT A GLANCE
MoneyControl helps you plan your household budget and keep your finances under control:
 • Set personal budgets
 • Manage recurring income and expenses automatically
 • Preview upcoming months
 • Visual charts for income and expenses
 • Powerful search
 • Account management and transfers
 • Flexible financial month settings
 • CSV export for Excel
 • Internal backups
Optional extensions allow you to:
 • Attach receipt photos to expenses
 • Create, print and share PDF reports
PRIVACY & CONTROL
Your financial data stays under your control. Synchronization is only used if you explicitly activate it.
FREE TO TRY
MoneyControl can be downloaded and tested for free. The free version allows up to 20 entries per month.
A one-time in-app purchase removes this limitation permanently. Extensions are also unlocked with one-time purchases and can be used on all your iOS devices.

- File a claim quickly and easily
- Upload invoices and documents directly from your phone
- Track the status of your claims in real time
- View your coverage details and remaining plan limits
- Receive alerts and messages about your claims
- Manage your pet’s insurance and health records
- Access 24/7 live Telehealth Concierge chat*
- Read personalized pet care articles
- Find nearby pet services
- Update your contact information
- Support for credit card, debit card, or ACH/checking account Payment Types

Just snap a photo of your invoice and notes, and submit everything right from your mobile device. In fact, 80% of claims are processed in 10 days or less, and you can follow the progress every step of the way. Need help? You can chat with a helpful team member directly through the app or reach us anytime by phone or email.
Not a policyholder yet? Get a free quote in minutes at metlifepetinsurance.com.

bluejetty:00174908:ios.name: AyeTides
bluejetty:00174908:ios.summary:
Never be without the tides again!
You too can carry the tides in your pocket (or now, on your wrist!) as you walk along the shore, fly into a harbor, or sail off into the sunset. AyeTides displays tides and/or currents for over 13,400 loca
bluejetty:00174908:ios.description:
Never be without the tides again!
You too can carry the tides in your pocket (or now, on your wrist!) as you walk along the shore, fly into a harbor, or sail off into the sunset. AyeTides displays tides and/or currents for over 13,400 locations worldwide and unlike many other tide apps, it does not require a network connection. With AyeTides you will never see those annoying ads or be asked to pay for additional features! Sailors, harbor pilots, beachcombers, nature photographers, and more use AyeTides to plan their outings on or around the world's oceans. 
And there are NO ads and NO subscriptions!
Here are some of the things people are saying about AyeTides... 
"AyeTides is a quality professional product”
"Your support has been the best I have experienced!"
“As a harbor pilot in New York I’ve been using your excellent tide and current app”
"I really appreciate the effort that you put into making AyeTides as accurate as it can be. It is a great program that has been very useful to us. I think we have 60 pilots using iPhones and iNavX and your app links in so well."
"I am a ships Pilot in BC and use Aye Tides a lot and it has become invaluable.”
You can see the day’s events in tabular form, or you can rotate the phone for an interactive graph that shows you the tide’s value at any point during the day. You can find a station on a map, by name, or based on your current location.
AyeTides is updated regularly and stations are added whenever we find new data. We encourage our customers to contact us if you hare having any issues with the program so that we can help you. 
This app is designed to run on your iPhone or iPod Touch. While it will run on your iPad, it does not offer the additional features available with AyeTides XL, which was designed specifically for the iPad. If you have multiple devices, you may want to consider our bundle. You get both apps at a discount!
This is the only place to install AyeTides. Other websites may look like they have AyeTides, but they do not. We only support iOS, any other version of AyeTides is not ours.

ב-BUYME תמצאו מגוון ענק של יותר מ-1,300 מתנות וחוויות: מתנות עד הבית, ארוחות במסעדות שף ובתי קפה, בילוי בבתי ספא, חופשות במלונות וצימרים, חוויות ספורט ואקסטרים, סדנאות, סיורי אוכל, קניות ברשתות יופי וטיפוח, שופינג במותגי אופנה ועוד המון.
למה כדאי להוריד את אפליקציית BUYME?
• מתנה לכל אירוע: ימי הולדת, מתנה ליולדת, ימי נישואים או סתם כדי להגיד תודה. • טאץ' אישי: הוסיפו ברכה, תמונה, סרטון או הקלטה קולית למתנה. • תזמון מושלם: תזמנו את שליחת המתנה (בוואטסאפ/SMS/מייל) בדיוק לרגע הנכון. • הכל במקום אחד: כל המתנות שקיבלתם ונתתם שמורות באפליקציה ולא הולכות לאיבוד. • יומן אירועים: תזכורות לימי הולדת ותאריכים חשובים כדי שלא תשכחו אף אחד.
הורידו עכשיו את אפליקציית BUYME ותתחילו לשמח את האהובים שלכם.

bluejetty:00022423:ios.summary:
Are you ready to build your own Railway Empire and become the Railway Tycoon?
Widen your lead as the richest railway stationmaster in the world! Make a fortune off the station by providing the best services!
In this game, you can become a
bluejetty:00022423:ios.description:
Are you ready to build your own Railway Empire and become the Railway Tycoon?
Widen your lead as the richest railway stationmaster in the world! Make a fortune off the station by providing the best services!
In this game, you can become a real stationmaster: expand railways, improve service efficiency, increase revenue of your store… and even arrange the train timetable! Trains have to head towards different destinations at different times… But what defines an efficient timetable?
- Focus on passengers’ needs
What may your passengers need? Clear instructions on trains of different series departing from the station, comfortable seats in the waiting room, clean restrooms, more charging facilities, and the leisure zone and dining zone for passengers to kill time… Upgrade facilities inside the station and give your passengers everything they want for more tips!
-Manage trains
Unlock more routes, collect different trains, and level them up! The train ticket price will go up as the route becomes longer and the train upgrades. Considering your passengers’ needs for travelling, how to arrange a reasonable timetable…? Everything is up to you! Work out the most suitable timetable and become a railway tycoon!
-Improve service efficiency
It takes too much time for passengers to buy a ticket and pass through the security checkpoint? And the lines move too slowly? Install more self-help ticket machines, increase security checkpoints, and upgrade the facilities to improve the service efficiency! Expansion of platforms will also help you reduce passengers’ waiting time. Be careful! If waiting for too long, passengers may get angry and leave the station!
-Build stores for more money
Your passengers may need something to eat! Small stores at the station offering a larger variety of goods will enhance the speed of service delivery and help you earn more money! Of course, you can also set up a fast-food restaurant which provides not only delicious food but also a comfortable rest space.
Railway Tycoon: Idle Railway Station Themed Simulation Game 
- Increase your idle earnings through the totally automated station: unlike playing other simulation games, you don’t have to “Click Here” all the time. All you have to do is simply pamper yourself with this tycoon simulation game while upgrading the station!
- Gain the idle cash, money, and gold coins: even when you’re offline, the cash keeps pouring in!
- Use the profits earned from investments to develop the station-based economy and make a fortune with it! You are the millionaire of tomorrow! 
- Arrange a train timetable to maximize your income!
-Different types of trains will generate earnings differently! We have all the trains available for you to collect!
-Manage trains following over 100 routes like a real stationmaster: become a railway tycoon through this station simulator!
If you are a fan of idle management games, you’ll definitely fall for Railway Tycoon! It is simple, funny, and player-friendly. Players can earn considerable income through strategic planning and management of their stations. Starting from an ordinary small-sized station, you can manage to upgrade its facilities and build it into the most luxurious high-end station in the world. And you, will become the world’s most powerful stationmaster!

-Manage trains following over 100 routes like a real stationmaster: become a railway tycoon through this station simulator!

Players can earn considerable income through strategic planning and management of their stations. Starting from an ordinary small-sized station, you can manage to upgrade its facilities and build it into the most luxurious high-end station in the world. And you, will become the world’s most powerful stationmaster!

bluejetty:00026665:ios.description:
AI Keyboard is an AI-powered writing keyboard that helps you write, rewrite, reply, translate, and improve text directly while typing on your iPhone. Use AI for messages, emails, social posts, and everyday writing without constantly switching between apps.
Whether you need a quick reply, better wording, a grammar check, or help writing from scratch, AI Keyboard puts useful writing tools right where you type.
KEY FEATURES
• AI Keyboard: Access AI writing tools directly from your keyboard while typing messages, emails, social posts, and more.
• Write with AI: Turn an idea or short prompt into a complete message, email, caption, or other text.
• Smart Replies: Generate relevant responses when you’re not sure what to say or want to reply faster.
• Rewrite & Improve: Make your text clearer, more natural, concise, or polished while keeping the original meaning.
• Grammar & Spell Check: Fix grammar, spelling, and awkward wording before you send.
• Change Your Tone: Make your writing sound professional, friendly, casual, confident, or appropriate for the situation.
• Translate Text: Translate messages and other text when communicating in different languages.
• Summarize: Turn long text into key points when you need a shorter version.
MORE AI TOOLS
Beyond the keyboard, you can use additional AI tools for writing and creative tasks:
• AI Chat: Ask questions, brainstorm ideas, or get help with everyday tasks.
• AI Writer: Create longer emails, essays, posts, and other content.
• Image Generator: Turn text prompts into AI-generated images.
• AI Tattoo Creator: Generate tattoo ideas based on your preferred concept or style.
• Prompt Generator: Get ideas and prompts for creative projects.
• Photo Captions: Create captions, headlines, and hashtags for social media.
WHO IS AI KEYBOARD FOR?
AI Keyboard is useful for students, professionals, content creators, non-native speakers, and anyone who writes frequently on their iPhone and wants to communicate more clearly and efficiently.
CAN AI KEYBOARD HELP ME WRITE MESSAGES AND REPLIES?
Yes. Create new messages, generate replies, or improve text you’ve already written for everyday chats, work conversations, emails, and social media.
CAN I USE AI KEYBOARD FOR WORK AND EMAILS?
Yes. Draft emails, improve grammar and wording, adjust tone, summarize text, and make professional communication clearer.
CAN AI KEYBOARD HELP IF ENGLISH ISN’T MY FIRST LANGUAGE?
Yes. Translation, grammar correction, rewriting, and tone tools can help you express your ideas more naturally when writing in another language.
WHY USE AN AI KEYBOARD?
Instead of opening a separate AI chat whenever you need writing help, AI Keyboard gives you writing tools where you already type. Write a message, improve your wording, translate text, or prepare a reply with fewer steps.
From quick messages and social posts to emails and longer writing, AI Keyboard helps you write more efficiently while keeping additional AI tools available when you need them.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Renewal costs depend on your chosen subscription plan. Manage subscriptions and auto-renewal settings in your Account Settings. Unused portions of free trial periods (if offered) will be forfeited upon purchasing a premium subscription.

bluejetty:00019048:ios.description:
The best-rated Dirt racing Sprint Car game from the creators of Dirt Trackin' is finally here!
With 410 Winged, Non-Winged, Big Block modified, and Midget cars, you'll be sure to find all levels of dirt race competition.
More than 20 race tracks including all the favorites Atomic Speedway, Fairbury Speedway, and Brownstown Speedway!
Real World Drivers in all 4 racing classes.
Highly Competitive Multiplayer mode, race your friends in the mud, and see how you stack up against the best drivers in this sport worldwide!
NEW! Race Events - Enjoy a full racing experience earning your way up from a solid time trial, onto heats and C/B/A-Main races to get to the much-deserved Victory Lane!

Customizations: Show who you really are by customizing all your cars to best suit your adrenaline-fuelled spirit.
Collect your daily rewards & win prizes when you win multiplayer races or complete career cups.

RainDrop is the most accurate way to see how much it rained or snowed at your exact location — no rain gauge needed. RainDrop delivers real-time precipitation totals with pinpoint accuracy for any spot in the United States.

Built for farmers, contractors, landscapers, gardeners, and anyone who needs to know exactly how much it rained and how much it will rain.


PRECISE RAINFALL & SNOW TOTALS
• Real-time rain and snow totals at your exact coordinates
• Hour-by-hour, daily, monthly, and yearly precipitation breakdowns
• Interactive rain calendar — tap any day for hourly detail
• Year-over-year precipitation comparisons
• Monthly rainfall trend analysis
• Custom date range selection for any time period

16-DAY WEATHER FORECASTS
• Detailed daily and hourly forecasts
• Temperature, wind speed, humidity, and pressure
• Severe weather alerts and warnings

LIVE WEATHER MAP
• Animated radar with rain and snow accumulation layers
• Tap anywhere on the map to check precipitation totals instantly

CUSTOM RAIN ALERTS
• Set rainfall thresholds for each saved location
• Get notified the moment precipitation exceeds your limit
• Choose your preferred alert time

TRACK MULTIPLE LOCATIONS
• Save and monitor dozens of locations
• Compare precipitation across all your spots at a glance
• Search and add any US location in seconds

SHARE YOUR DATA
• Share rainfall totals and map screenshots with your team, clients, or neighbors


FREE TO START
Use RainDrop free with your current GPS location. Upgrade to save more locations and unlock full precipitation analytics, extended history, 16-day forecasts, all map layers, custom timeframes, rain alerts, and the interactive rain calendar.

Have a question? Chat directly with the developer inside the app.

Privacy Policy: https://www.raindrop.farm/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.raindrop.farm/tos

bluejetty:00148420:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00148420:ios.description:
Parenting can be overwhelming without a support network you’re able to call on.
Bubble is a community of over 300k parents and vetted babysitters & nannies built on trust. We provide the missing piece of your childcare puzzle - a recommended babysitter or nanny who can be with you at short notice.
Whether it’s a planned event, an unexpected situation or just a need to be in two places at once, we’ve got your back.
Browse, meet and book trusted babysitters who can be entertaining and engaging your kids in as little as an hour - teachers, nannies, nursery workers and every background and personality of childcarer.
So why try Bubble?
We’re trusted by parents and kids - from health workers to movie stars to expats, 275k parents have booked more than 3 million hours of childcare. We’re rated ‘Excellent’ on Trustpilot with more than 2,000 five-star reviews. Read honest parent reviews on sitter profiles.
We pre-vet babysitters - we only accept 1 in 4 sitters, ensuring they meet our high standards. Our 12 safety checks including providing information on DBS helps you make an informed choice.
We’re connected to your network - find your parent friends or connect your school, nursery and work to see which babysitters and nannies the people you know trust with their children.
Babysitting for any need - whether you need evening, daytime or after-school care; ad-hoc, short-notice or regular help, find babysitters who match your children’s personalities, interests and additional needs.
You’re in control - choose when, where and who will care for your children. Meet potential babysitters and nannies beforehand, stay connected during the sit with messaging.
We give you buyer protection. Track and pay for your sit securely in the app. Every sit is fully-insured. If it’s needed, our support team of real people are on-hand to help 9am-9pm, 7 days a week.
Think of Bubble as your companion for moments you need for yourself or when an extra pair of hands is helpful.
Because when you’re at your best, so are your kids.

bluejetty:00063547:ios.summary: A Rádio Itatiaia, também conhecida como a Rádio de Minas, transmitida pelas frequências 610 kHz – AM e 95,7 MHz – FM, é a principal emissora radiofônica do estado, e está entre as cinco mais importantes do Brasil. No ar desde 1952, conta co
bluejetty:00063547:ios.description:
A Rádio Itatiaia, também conhecida como a Rádio de Minas, transmitida pelas frequências 610 kHz – AM e 95,7 MHz – FM, é a principal emissora radiofônica do estado, e está entre as cinco mais importantes do Brasil. No ar desde 1952, conta com uma programação voltada para esportes, sempre presente na cobertura de grandes eventos, jornalismo, prestação de serviços e entretenimento.
A programação integral é retransmitida pelo canal 411 de rádio da Sky e 174 da Claro TV, e pode ser acessada de qualquer lugar do mundo, através da Internet, pelo site: www.itatiaia.com.br. Também pode ser ouvida através de aplicativos para smartphones e outros dispositivos móveis.
Rede Itatiaia – A maior rede de rádios de Minas
A Rede Itatiaia, uma das redes de comunicação mais sólidas do país, é composta pela Rádio Itatiaia AM/FM - com transmissão simultânea em Belo Horizonte e região metropolitana -, e mais quatro emissoras em Minas Gerais, localizadas em Juiz de Fora, Montes Claros, Ouro Preto e Varginha.
A maior rede de emissoras mineira detém cerca de 90% de audiência de transmissões esportivas e transmite, via satélite, o melhor do jornalismo e esporte da Rádio Itatiaia. Possui um público diversificado, de jovens e adultos, homens e mulheres, e atinge todas as classes sociais e econômicas.
As rádios que compõem a Rede Itatiaia buscam ainda se identificar com a cultura de cada local em que atuam, com programação diversificada e prestando serviços à comunidade, se tornando assim um importante meio de informação e entretenimento para o público mineiro.
Pioneira na transmissão via internet, atualmente, todas as integrantes da Rede Itatiaia possuem site próprio, onde o ouvinte pode acompanhar as programações ao vivo de qualquer lugar do mundo.
Os links estão disponíveis no site www.itatiaia.com.br.

bluejetty:00097176:ios.description:
Cocil is the professional-grade AI tool designed for creators who demand dynamic, stylized, and high-impact animated clips in the Western animation tradition. Stop sketching—start generating the next great scene for your comic, game, or short film.
Describe a "Hero fighting a behemoth" or a "Tense negotiation in space," and ChronoSketch instantly produces a visually stunning, action-packed clip.
StyleForge Mastery: Select from professional templates like "Dynamic Flat 2D" or "Cinematic 3D Render" to match your project's aesthetic.
Action Precision: Use the Action Weaver to script exact movements: from "Energy Blast" to "Epic Leap," ensuring your characters move with purpose.
Hollywood Camerawork: Apply advanced film techniques like "Crane Dive" or "Bullet-Time Focus" with the Cinematic Cam, giving your clips professional narrative power.
Visual Drama: Tweak atmosphere using the DramaFilter for perfect light and shadow—ideal for action, sci-fi, and adventure genres.
Stop drawing frames. Start building scenes. Power up your storytelling with ChronoSketch.

bluejetty:00182489:ios.description:
STAR: Super Twisted Arena Run is a game where many levels with crazy obstacles await you! Bizarre traps, serious enemies, and even elementary laws of physics stand in the way of your victory!
Your goal is to stay as long as you can. Pass the obstacle course and reach the end of this insane coliseum filled with fun! Each round is unique, and new trials will be harder than previous ones. You'll need all your skills to get the victory! Upgrade your skills and win!
HOW TO PLAY?
The game has several rounds. Each round is a race on a dangerous trail where you'll have to dodge various traps. To get to the next round, you need to reach the finish line. In the last round, you should survive in the arena to win! Can you do that?
GAME FEATURES: 
- Many levels of different difficulty levels 
- Hard obstacle courses with different traps 
- Bright and colorful graphics 
- Funny ragdoll physics 
- Easy controls 
- Intuitive interface 
- So. Much. Fun! 
STAR: Super Twisted Arena Run is absolutely free to download! The real fun is waiting for you! Can you win?
Please note that our game offers a VIP-membership subscription (VIP). This subscription lasts for 7 days and is auto-renewable. The cost of the subscription is USD 3.99 per week. You can cancel the subscription in your device subscriptions settings.

bluejetty:00175612:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of music with our interactive and engaging musical instruments learning app, specially designed for children aged 2 and above! Unlock the wonders of rhythm, melody, and creativity as your little ones embark on a delightful musical journey right from their fingertips.
With our app, children can explore a captivating collection of virtual instruments, including the piano, xylophone, trumpet, flute, violin, guitar, drums, saxophone, and accordion. Each instrument is beautifully designed and crafted to provide an intuitive and joyful learning experience.
Our app goes beyond simply learning the instruments. We provide a "play and record" feature, allowing children to unleash their inner musicians by composing and recording their own melodies. They can create their unique tunes and share them with family and friends, nurturing their creativity and self-expression.
Additionally, our app offers a "learn how to play" feature, where children can follow along with interactive lessons tailored to their skill level. They'll learn basic techniques, notes, and melodies for each instrument, gaining a solid foundation in music education.
To make learning even more enjoyable, we've included a collection of popular tunes like "Baby Shark" and "Jingle Bells" that children can play and have fun with. It's a fantastic way to engage with music and discover the joy of familiar melodies.
Our child-friendly interface and intuitive controls make it easy for young learners to navigate and interact with the app independently. Engaging animations, vibrant visuals, and delightful sound effects will captivate their attention and make learning a joyful adventure.
As parents, you'll be delighted to know that our app provides a safe and ad-free environment for your little musicians. We prioritize their online safety, ensuring a worry-free experience as they delve into the world of music.
Key Features:
- Explore a variety of musical instruments, including piano, xylophone, trumpet, flute, violin, guitar, drums, saxophone, and accordion.
- "Play and record" feature for creating and sharing original compositions.
- "Learn how to play" feature with interactive lessons for each instrument.
- Enjoy playing popular tunes like "Baby Shark" and "Jingle Bells."
- Child-friendly interface with intuitive controls and captivating visuals.
- Safe and ad-free environment for uninterrupted learning.
Unlock the endless possibilities of music education and set your child on a harmonious path of discovery. Download our musical instruments learning app today and watch your little ones transform into budding maestros!
Have a feature request you would like to see in a future version of the app? Do not hesitate to contact us at support@kidsapp.ai

bluejetty:00127179:ios.description:
The Herald-Leader local newspaper app is faster and easier to use. Read or watch daily local news coverage, investigative reporting, national headline news, crime, sports, local business, and more from Lexington, Frankfort, Winchester, Georgetown and communities across Eastern Kentucky.
The Herald-Leader local newspaper is your trusted source for local, daily news and stories from Lexington, Frankfort, Winchester and Georgetown in Eastern Kentucky. Our newsroom reports on issues affecting residents across the Lexington area and surrounding Eastern Kentucky communities including crime, local business, sports and regional developments alongside national headline news and investigative reporting.
LOCAL NEWS
• Daily local news and stories from Lexington, Frankfort, Winchester, Georgetown and communities across Eastern Kentucky.
• AI generated summaries on all articles reviewed by our newsroom.
• The Herald-Leader local newspaper opinions, editorials and columns you love.
• Edition, a digital destination for the latest news, features, and insights. Like the printed local newspaper, it is intended to be a complete report of the day’s news compiled by our editors overnight.
LIVE VIDEO
• Watch live video of local news stories and national news coverage.
• View stunning photos and videos of local news and community events.
LOCAL SPORTS
• Full coverage reporting on local, pro and college sports teams
• Stay connected to your favorite teams and favorite sports writers.
PERSONALIZATION
• Stay informed on the topics and articles that matter to you.
• Favorite topics to get personalized feeds. • Search for news articles, videos, games and more.
• Bookmark news articles to read later.
• Read articles your way with full support for dark mode and light mode.
Other Features
• Browse articles by category.
• Share articles on Facebook, X Twitter or by email.
• Comment on news articles.
• Access and download previous issues of our newspaper.
• Recharge and unwind with our puzzles and games.

bluejetty:00100107:ios.description:
Yarn Match 3D: Craft Your Cozy Adventure!
Game Description:
Step into a vibrant, yarn-woven universe where creativity and puzzle-solving collide! Yarn Match 3D is a delightful match-3 game that blends colorful challenges with the charm of knitting. Swap and link yarn balls of the same hue to unlock whimsical knitted objects, from cuddly pets and juicy fruits to famous landmarks—each level unveils a fresh, stitch-tastic surprise!
How to Play:
Match & Unlock: Swap adjacent yarn balls to make rows of 3 or more, clearing them to reveal hidden knitted pieces.
Complete the Object: Fill the progress bar by matching yarn!
Charming Themes: Journey through cozy worlds—from a Fuzzy Animal Workshop to a Stitched Cityscape—each with unique designs!
Cozy Challenges: Beat timers, untangle yarn chaos, and master tricky layouts to become the ultimate crafting champion.
Features:
100+ Levels of increasing creativity and challenge.
Adorable Knitted Art: Unlock 50+ objects, each with playful animations.
Relaxing Vibes: Soothing music and yarn-tastic sound effects.
Daily Rewards: Log in for bonus yarn balls and boosters!
Why Play?
Perfect for puzzle lovers and crafty minds! Whether you’re stitching up a quick level or diving into a yarn-bending marathon, Yarn-tastic Match wraps you in warmth, strategy, and pure fuzzy joy.
Contact us: support@cedargamestudio.com
Visit our website: https://cedargamestudio.com/

bluejetty:00091892:ios.name: Callbutton.ai
bluejetty:00091892:ios.summary: Your club, at your fingertips. CallButton connects you to the private clubs and resorts you belong to, so you can order food and drinks, ask a question, or reach the staff from your seat, whether that's a poolside cabana, the patio, the clu
bluejetty:00091892:ios.description:
Your club, at your fingertips. CallButton connects you to the private clubs and resorts you belong to, so you can order food and drinks, ask a question, or reach the staff from your seat, whether that's a poolside cabana, the patio, the clubhouse bar, or the turn.
HOW IT WORKS
Arrive and connect. Scan the placard at your cabana or table, or let CallButton find the club when you arrive. Your location is used only to detect the venue, and only while the app is open.
ORDER FROM ANYWHERE ON THE PROPERTY
Browse every menu at the venue, build your order your way, and send it. CallButton routes it to the right kitchen or bar and delivers it to where you're sitting. Follow each order from received to accepted, and reorder your usual with one tap.
ASK THE CONCIERGE
Not sure what to get? Ask in plain language. The concierge knows the menus, can suggest something for a hot afternoon by the pool, and can build the order for you.
REACH THE STAFF
Need towels, a check, or another round of waters? Request assistance or message the team directly. Your notes go to the people serving your area, right where you are.
FOR MEMBERS AND THEIR GUESTS
No membership number to remember. Verify your phone once, and each club recognizes you when you arrive. Members and guests are welcome wherever the club allows.
FOR CLUB TEAMS
Staff see every order, request, and message for their station on one screen, with who is asking and where they sit, so nothing waits.
CallButton works at participating private clubs, country clubs, resorts, and hospitality venues. If your club isn't on CallButton yet, ask them to visit callbutton.ai.

bluejetty:00132885:ios.description:
Merge Friends is a thrilling and addictive free casual merge game. Your goal is to help the community rebuild the small town by merging hundreds of exciting items, trading with neighbors, giving old houses makeovers, and building new ones. 
Level up by filling orders while you discover and merge hundreds of exciting items from the small-town shop. How many screwdrivers do you have to merge to find an electric drill? How many items does it take to fill an order for chilled champagne and strawberries? How does merging hangers lead to one of the fiercest pair of high heels ever seen in a game?
Merge Friends is the exciting free merger that you can enjoy for a few minutes on the go or sit back and take your time to immerse yourself into the world of this small town.
There is always something new to uncover and discover with exciting daily challenges, seasonal events, and regular updates. 
How to play Merge Friends
Playing Merge Friends is easy and exciting. Rebuild the town, discover hundreds of exciting items, and nurture friendships.
As the new owner of the town's General Store, it is your goal to fill neighbors' orders, trade with neighboring cities, and help the townies build their houses to rebuild the town. 
Merging items to fill orders is fun as you uncover exciting items while rummaging through old, dusty boxes left behind in the shop. Find hidden objects and earn rewards to unlock new levels and discover hidden areas of the shop.
Merge Friends features a diverse cast of characters to interact with. Each character has their own story and secrets to uncover. By helping them, you will discover all the nuances, intricacies, and drama of their past. As with all great friendships, there might be some growing pains along the way.
Are you ready to help fix the town and bring the community together? 
Download today and get lost in the small-town world of Merge Friends.
Questions about the game? Contact our support team at mf_support@potatoplay.com

bluejetty:00156413:ios.name: Kansas KS DMV Permit Test
bluejetty:00156413:ios.summary: Are you applying for the Kansas DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this application to study for, improve your score on, and ultimately pass both the CDL driver's license test and the DMV driver's license test for the state
bluejetty:00156413:ios.description:
Are you applying for the Kansas DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this application to study for, improve your score on, and ultimately pass both the CDL driver's license test and the DMV driver's license test for the state of Kansas in order to obtain your permit on the very first attempt. 
This app contains quizzes that are derived from the official Kansas Department of Motor Vehicles state manual. This application will help you in preparing for and practicing for the Car, Motorcycle, and Commercial Driver's License (CDL) tests required by the state of Kansas. All of the practice tests included in this application are based on the most recent editions of the applicable manuals. Therefore, if you are looking for preparation for the DMV driver's license test, this is the ideal DMV driver's license test practice app for you. This application is a handbook manual that may be used to practice and prepare for the Commercial Driver's License (CDL) as well as the DMV Knowledge Test Permit. 
It is developed with the learning requirements of a user who is applying for a driving license and the requirements of the driver's license test, as well as the most effective learning strategies discovered by researchers. The process of studying for the permit test is made to be more engaging and enjoyable as a result. When utilizing this application, users report that it is quite simple to provide accurate responses to the questions that appear on the actual DMV permit driver's license test. 
Following is a brief overview of the features provided by the app.
- Practice tests designed especially for you.
- Bookmark questions you want to look at a later stage.
- You can keep track of your progress and check the history of each practice test. 
- Scope of improvements suggested based on your performance. 
- Sample tests for obtaining a driver's license for a motorcycle, a car, and a commercial driver's license (CDL). 
- A very extensive bank of sample questions that covers all areas of the written examination for the driver's license. 
- Very intuitive and clutter free User Interface.
Following test categories are covered in this app : 
- General Knowledge Test
- Hazardous Materials Test
- School Bus Test
- Passenger Vehicle Test
- Air Brakes Test
- Comb. Vehicles Test
- D/T Trailers test
- Tanker Vehicles Test
- Pre-trip Insp. Test

bluejetty:00013703:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00013703:ios.description:
Explore our online Siddur, Torah, Tanakh, Tehillim, and so much more. 
We are taking the People of the Book into the digital age, and with just 500 MB you can download the entire library to access all texts offline. 
Our interface is simple and user-friendly: delve deep into the texts with the swipe of a finger. Get information on specific topics, such as Passover - the next holiday on our calendar, Daf Yomi, search using keywords, or browse the table of contents to explore texts, translations, and commentaries, and explore the connections between works in the library. 
Whether you're looking to get a deeper look at the Hebrew Bible, study tehillim, do your Talmud homework, prepare words of Torah for your Shabbat meal, recite the Bedtime Shema with your children, or say Birkat Hamazon after you eat, you've come to the right app. We offer an ever-growing list of translations for key texts, making these textual treasures available to communities around the world. We currently offer works in English, French, Dutch, Spanish, Italian, Finnish, Portuguese, Persian, Polish, Russian, and Yiddish. 
Get full access to: 
* Calendars for Parashat HaShavua (weekly Torah reading), Daf Yomi (daily Oral Torah learning), 929 (daily Tanakh), Rambam Yomi (daily Rambam teaching), and Mishnah Yomi (daily Mishnah) 
* Torah commentaries in English including Rashi, Or HaChaim, Rashbam, and many more 
* Over 50 commentaries on Tanakh - Ibn Ezra, Ramban, Haamek Davar Gur Aryeh, and more 
* Over 15 Mishnah commentaries including Bartenura, Ikar Tosafot Yom Tov, Rambam, and more 
* Over 30 Talmud Bavli commentaries including Rashi, Tosafot, Rashba, and more 
* Siddur including daily davening and Birkat Hamazon 
* As well as Midrash, Halacha, Kabbalah, Tanya, Haggadah, Zohar, Chasidut, Musar, Pirkei Avot, Tehillim, and more, with new texts added to the library all the time. 
Our mission as a non-profit organization is to allow more people access to engage with the textual treasures of our tradition. As we move our texts from print to digital we are creating not merely an archive but a platform to give these texts new life. 
Our free, living library of Jewish texts is allowing us to build the future of Jewish learning in an open and participatory way. Download our app or learn more at www.sefaria.org

bluejetty:00088824:ios.name: Fizz Wi-Fi
bluejetty:00088824:ios.summary: App to manage your Fizz Home Internet service and have your Wi-Fi network at your fingertips, whether you’re at home or not. View important details such as connected devices and troubleshooting alerts. Diagnose and optimize your home Wi-Fi
bluejetty:00088824:ios.description:
App to manage your Fizz Home Internet service and have your Wi-Fi network at your fingertips, whether you’re at home or not. View important details such as connected devices and troubleshooting alerts. Diagnose and optimize your home Wi-Fi network easily directly from your smart device. 
IMPORTANT 
• For Fizz Home Internet members only, when connected to their Fizz Wi-Fi network 
• Requires a Hitron CODA modem model 
• App available in English and French (for smart device use only) 
With the Fizz Wi-Fi app, you can: 
• Manage your Fizz Wi-Fi network from anywhere. 
• See all the devices connected to your Fizz Wi-Fi network. 
• Control online access for kids with automatic Wi-Fi off bedtime schedules. 
• Pause or block Internet access for devices you choose. 
• Easily reset or share your Wi-Fi password. 
• Create a separate, secure network for your guests. 
• Perform speed tests to validate the speed of your broadband connection, as well as the one to your device to determine for example the cause of a slowdown. 
• Troubleshoot to maximize your Wi-Fi signal and security; 
• Chat with tech support if you are stuck. 
Getting Started: 
- Download and install the Fizz Wi-Fi app on your smartphone. 
- Connect your smartphone to your Fizz Wi-Fi network. 
- Launch the app and sign in using the same credentials as your Fizz account.

bluejetty:00086485:ios.description:
تطبيق تأكد هو تطبيق قامت بتطويره الهيئة السعودية للمواصفات والمقاييس والجودة بالشراكة مع المركز السعودي لكفاءة الطاقة ويتيح للمستهلك التحقق من علامة الجودة ومنتجات البلاستيك القابل للتحلل وملصقات بطاقة كفاءة الطاقة للمنتجات الكهربائية (المكيفات، الغسالات ، الثلاجات ، السخانات 
.والمجففات) ، الإطارات والمركبات والإنارة وترشيد استهلاك المياة وأدوات القياس
خصائص التطبيق :
• قائمة البحث عن منتجات علامة الجودة
• خاصية المنتجات الحاصلة على علامة الجودة
• قائمة البحث عن منتجات البلاستيك القابل للتحلل
• خاصية المنتجات الحاصلة على ترخيص البلاستيك القابل للتحلل
• قائمة البحث عن منتجات الاجهزة الكهربائية
• خاصية البحث المتقدم في الاجهزة الكهربائية : من خلال تحديد نوع المنتج ، الطراز ، عدد النجوم أو الحروف
• قائمة البحث عن المركبات
• خاصية البحث المتقدم عن مركبة : من خلال تحديد موديل المركبه ، الشركة المصنعة ، نوع المركبة
• قائمة البحث عن الاطارات
• قائمة البحث المتقدم عن الاطارات : من خلال تحديد الشركة المصنعة ، الاسم التجاري
• قائمة البحث عن منتجات ترشيد استهلاك المياة
• خاصية البحث المتقدم عن منتجات ترشيد استهلاك المياة : من خلال تحديد نوع المنتج ، نوع المنتج الفرعي ، نوع الفئة
• طلب إشعار استيراد مركبة 
• قائمة البحث عن الانارة
• خاصية بلغ عن منتج تتيح للمستخدم تقديم البلاغات
• قائمة بلاغاتي تتيح للمستخدم مراجعة البلاغات المقدّمة
• قائمة محفظتي تتيح للمستخدم إضافة منتجات للمحفظة وظهور تنبيهات للمنتجات المستدعاه من وزارة التجارة
الجانب التوعوي :
يمكن للمستهلك معرفة المنتجات الأكثر كفاءة من خلال التطبيق ويمكن معرفة بطاقات كفاءة الطاقة المعتمدة
