Finroo is an innovative portfolio management platform that blends education and gamified learning to help users build stronger financial habits. It focuses on key markets including Stocks, Crypto, Forex, Commodities, and Real Estate. Finroo uses a smart analytics engine to provide data-driven investment insights, offering timely suggestions to support better financial decision-making.
===================
FEATURES
===================
Market Analysis for Stocks, Crypto, Forex, Commodities, and Real Estate:
Powered by our proprietary analytics engine, Finroo identifies potential market opportunities and delivers structured insights. Stay informed with alerts and curated suggestions for high-potential assets, supported by relevant news and community interest from global sources.
Seamless Portfolio Management:
Securely connect your brokerage accounts to Finroo via our trusted integration partner, Plaid. Our system analyzes your investment profile and offers strategy suggestions tailored to your risk preferences and market conditions.
Finroo Academy:
Join the Finroo community to strengthen your financial knowledge through easy-to-understand resources. We gather key market information globally and present it in a way that adapts to your learning style and financial interests.
===================
PRICING
===================
Follow trends and enhance your experience with premium insights:
10-day guest access
Basic package (FREE): One daily signal
Premium package ($9.99/month or $69.99/year): Full access to smart market strategies and advanced analytics
===================
ICONS
===================
Most of our application icons are made by Freepik from www.flaticon.com. Asset logos are provided by clearbit.com.
===================
CONTACTS
===================
If you have any questions or feedback, please contact us at info@finroo.ai
Website: https://finroo.ai
Privacy Policy: https://finroo.ai/privacy
Terms and Conditions: https://finroo.ai/terms

bluejetty:00120631:ios.description:
TaalMala provides personalized accompaniment of Tabla, Pakhawaj, Manjeera, Tanpura, SwarMandal and Lehra/Nagma on Santoor and Harmonium. Use TaalMala for your daily riyaaz or live concerts. With high-quality Tabla, Pakhawaj, Manjeera, Tanpura, SwarMandal, Santoor and Harmonium sounds sampled from real instruments, more than 372 pre-composed Taals and Sequences, and more than 253 pre-composed Lehra/Nagma compositions, and 864 SwarMandal patterns in 68 Ragas, TaalMala provides a complete practising solution for any Indian musician.
With TaalMala Composer, you can compose your own Taals, Lehras/Nagmas, SwarMandal patterns by simply typing the notation of the Taal/Lehra on special built-in Taal/Lehra keyboard. With TaalMala Sequencer, you can arrange sequences of fixed or randomized or tempo-based Taal and Lehra/Nagma patterns.
TaalMala features:
- High-quality studio-recorded Tabla, Pakhawaj, Tanpura, SwarMandal (2 tones), Santoor, Harmonium and Manjeera (Zanj) sounds
- Two sets of Tabla/Dagga sounds and ability to choose and mix-match between the two sound sets
- 372 pre-composed Taals and Taal sequences, including most popular Taals and their variations
- 253 pre-composed Lehra/Nagma compositions and sequences in multitude of ragas and Taals
- 864 pre-composed SwarMandal patterns in 68 Ragas
- New Taals, Lehras/Nagmas and compositions added frequently as updates
- Compose your own Taals and Lehras/Nagmas by simply entering the notation
- Powerful sequencer to compose fixed, tempo-based and randomized sequences from the Taals and Lehras library
- Taal/Lehra/SwarMandal pad; play any Taal/Lehra/SwarMandal pattern on-demand in live accompaniment
- Automatic Manjeera/Zanj accompaniment, synchronized with the Tabla/Pakhawaj Taals
- Adjustable tempo from 10 bpm to 1000 bpm
- Pitch control (+/- 0.5 octave), with independent fine-tuning of all instruments for precise matching with your scale
- Pitch detector for detecting your pitch and precise matching, built within the app
- Independent volume control for Tabla/Pitch, Dagga/Bass, Manjeera and Lehra/Nagma
- Choice of chromatic or just/harmonic tuning for all instruments, with fine-tuning capability.
- Up to 2 simultaneous Tanpuras
- High-quality Tanpura sounds (male and female tones) with all popular Tanpura patterns included
- Adjustable Tanpura tempo and strumming speed of 4 Tanpura strings independently
- Option to slightly vary the Tanpura plucking delays randomly for better realism
- Tap on the screen twice to set exact Taal tempo, as required
This version of the application has following limitations: Playback restricted to 5 minutes every hour.
To unlock full functionality and remove the limitation above, click "Buy" option on the main screen. Once you purchase a subscription to the app, the 5-minute per hour limitation will be removed.
Please contact us at service@taalmala.com if you have any questions.
Licensing terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Our privacy policy: https://www.taalmala.com/privacy.shtml

Black Lotus is the world’s leading meditation app loaded with quality meditation sessions, breathing exercises, meditation music, and a framework to help you unleash your potential.

bluejetty:00142153:ios.summary: MobiMatter is a travel eSIM provider: buy, install and manage your eSIMs in one app, with a choice of networks across 200+ destinations. Our range includes plans from around 20 vetted providers. Available networks and providers depend on th
bluejetty:00142153:ios.description:
MobiMatter is a travel eSIM provider: buy, install and manage your eSIMs in one app, with a choice of networks across 200+ destinations. Our range includes plans from around 20 vetted providers. Available networks and providers depend on the destination and plan.
Choose mobile data when traveling abroad for a short trip or an extended stay, with single-country, regional and global options, including plans valid for up to 365 days. Check the countries covered and when the validity period begins before purchasing. See data allowances, validity, prices and supported networks in one place.
MAKE YOUR TRAVEL DATA GO FURTHER
• Choose your network: see the available plans for your destination and choose the right balance of data, coverage and price.
• Know what you are buying: check network, hotspot, activation and top-up details before purchase. Features vary by plan.
• Get set up: install your eSIM using the available in-app installation option or QR code, then follow your plan’s activation instructions.
• Check your data: view supported plans’ usage in the app or with the Home Screen widget. Usage updates depend on the provider.
• Top up when you need more: add data to supported eSIMs directly in the app.
• Earn towards your next trip: explore purchase and referral rewards. Rewards are MobiMatter credit; eligibility and terms apply.
GET READY IN THREE STEPS
1. Search your destination and choose a plan.
2. Buy your plan and install your eSIM while you have an internet connection.
3. Follow the activation instructions for your plan and connect at your destination.
Keep your usual SIM available for calls and messages while using your travel eSIM for cellular data. Charges from your usual mobile provider may still apply.
You need an unlocked, eSIM-compatible device. Coverage, speed, validity, activation rules and top-up availability depend on the plan. Review the plan details and device compatibility before buying.
Support is available 24/7 if you need help with your eSIM.
Find your next travel eSIM in MobiMatter.
Explore plans: https://mobimatter.com/
Need help? Visit https://mobimatter.com/troubleshoot or open Help in the app.

bluejetty:00135552:ios.description:
Finally understand what's working for your body—no guesswork, no gimmicks.
Key to Health is designed for high-achieving, busy people who want to look better, feel better, and optimize their long-term health without spending hours on complex routines.
Backed by science. Guided by AI. Built for real life.
Our breath sensor gives you real-time feedback on your body's fat metabolism—so you can see what your daily choices are actually doing, not just hope for the best. Pair that with smart AI coaching, and you have a system that adapts to you.
What you'll get:
• Real-time fat metabolism tracking with our breath acetone sensor
• Personalized coaching from Key, your AI health guide
• Clear, science-based goals and progress tracking
• Tools to build strength and support long-term health
• Eat what you love—no restricted foods, no keto required
Meet Key: Your 24/7 AI Coach
Key learns from your habits, adjusts your plan, and guides you every step of the way. Instant support and personalized guidance, whenever you need it.
Grounded in clinical evidence. In a published clinical trial, participants following the Key to Health program lost an average of 10% total body weight over 48 weeks.
No fad diets. No extreme routines. No forbidden foods. Just real progress, made easy.
This app and breath monitor are for adults 18 years and older.
Subscription pricing and terms:
Key to Health offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription at $49.99/month to provide you with unlimited access to the Key to Health Premium collection while you maintain an active subscription.
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the current subscription price. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to Settings > Manage Subscription on your device after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of service: https://keytohealth.ai/terms
Privacy policy: https://keytohealth.ai/privacy

bluejetty:00185965:ios.summary: Build your dream airline and rise to the top in Airlines Manager, the #1 aviation tycoon game of 2026! Experience a deep, realistic simulation driven by a team of passionate aviation enthusiasts who bring you fresh monthly challenges with e
bluejetty:00185965:ios.description:
Build your dream airline and rise to the top in Airlines Manager, the #1 aviation tycoon game of 2026! Experience a deep, realistic simulation driven by a team of passionate aviation enthusiasts who bring you fresh monthly challenges with exciting rewards, and regular updates featuring the latest aircraft - all inspired by real-world aviation news. Join over 15 million players worldwide and start your journey today! 
KEY FEATURES
- Access 2700 airports worldwide, and set up strategic flight routes.
- Choose from over 200 airplane models from real-life civil aviation.
- Paint your own aircraft liveries and integrate them to your fleet.
- Monitor your flights in real-time on a dynamic world map.
- Unlock over 500 different types of research in the R&D center.
- Choose from over 200 services to tailor your strategy.
- Trade your planes with other players on the second-hand market.
- Two playing modes: PRO (in real-time) and TYCOON (fast mode).
WHY CHOOSE AIRLINES MANAGER
Airlines Manager delivers one of the most realistic and detailed airline simulation experiences available. With high-quality graphics, a live global flight map, and real-time tracking, you'll feel like you're running a real airline. Our exclusive partnership with the International Air Transport Association (IATA) brings an unmatched level of authenticity and data accuracy to the game.
Stay engaged with regular updates crafted by our passionate team of aviation lovers. From new aircraft and hub expansions to seasonal events and monthly challenges with exciting prizes, everything is inspired by real-world aviation news to keep your experience fresh and exciting.
Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore strategist, Airlines Manager adapts to your style. Choose between simplified or advanced gameplay modes, and enjoy the game in 8 supported languages including English, French, Spanish, and German. Join a vibrant community of over 15 million players worldwide — and connect with fellow aviation fans on our active Discord server!
ABOUT US
We are Playrion, a French gaming studio based in Paris. We are driven by the desire to design free to play mobile games linked to the world of aviation and offering a top notch user experience. We love planes, and anything that’s related to them. Our entire office has been decorated with airport iconography and plane models, including the recent addition of the Concorde from Lego. If you share our passion for the world of aviation, or simply love management games, Airlines Manager is for you!
Join the Community: https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/forums/airlines-manager.1087/

Can you become the best football player in the world?
Football Superstar focuses on character development rather than quick reflexes. You start the game as at 18 year old free agent and play until you retire. What happens in-between is up to you!
IMPROVE YOUR ABILITIES
As you gain experience, you can upgrade abilities that suit your playing style and position. Perhaps you become a superstar quarterback, lightning fast wide receiver or even a defensive powerhouse? 
CONTROL YOUR DESTINY
As your reputation improves, you will gain the attention of bigger and better teams. Do you stay loyal to your current team or move on? Do you sign for your favourite team? Are you ready to make the jump to the professional game?
LIVE THE LIFE
As you build your career, various decisions and events will mould you as a person. Do you chase the cash? Are you a team player or focus on your own individual needs? Do you seek fame or prefer a life of solitude?
PLAYER CONTRACTS
Negotiate contracts to ensure you get the deal you deserve! Perhaps you add a bonus for reaching the play-offs or for becoming the team MVP? You need to make sure you get the deal you want, after all, if you are good at something never do it for free!
HELP IS AT HAND
One thing is for sure, you’ll need help. Hire agents, coaches, stylist and various other people to help you become more than just a player. After all, there's endorsement deals awaiting the right player!
ARE YOU THE BEST
From thousands of players, you can see your progression from rookie all the way to veteran. Can you reach the top and become the All-Star MVP?
Prove it…

bluejetty:00142792:ios.description:
The Rheinbahn App makes it really easy for you to get around by bus and train in the Düsseldorf area, throughout the VRR
(Rhine-Ruhr public transport system) and NRW.
Advantages of the Rheinbahn App:
• DEUTSCHLANDTICKET: It can be bought easily as a digital ticket in the App which enables you to travel flexible and cheap throughout Germany by bus and train. 
• DASHBOARD: When you open the App, your personal dashboard opens first with the main functions for travel around Düsseldorf by public transport (ÖPNV). You may customise the dashboard according to your needs, e.g. with an overview of the tickets you have bought and are valid, save your most important connections and lines in “Schnellauskunft” (Quick Information) or display the “Abfahrtsmonitor” (Departure Monitor).
• DIGITAL SUBSCRIPTION: You can manage your subscription digitally. You can also change any smart cards into a digital subscription with barcode.
• EEZY.NRW: If you only travel occasionally by public transport in the Düsseldorf area then choose the Check-In-/Check-Out-Tarif eezy.nrw. Simply check in with the App and check out again at the end of your journey. The fare is calculated automatically according to the linear kilometres travelled. 
• TICKETS: In the Rheinbahn App you have access to the entire range of VRR tickets, VRS and NRW tickets and, of course, also the Deutschlandticket. You can also buy tickets for your bicycle or first-class tickets. We have made it even easier for you to buy your ticket and you can choose from following ways to pay: PayPal, credit card (Visa, MasterCard and American Express) and prepaid (not possible with eezy.nrw).
• MULTI-TRIP TICKETS: They are now clearly displayed and you can see at a glance how many journeys you have left.
• TIMETABLE INFORMATION FOR NRW: The timetable information system that thinks for itself: in addition to the set favourites and your current location, the stops or stations you frequently use are prioritised.
• TRAVEL INFO (VERKEHRSINFO): To help you to get around more easily, Travel Info shows you whether there are any current delays on our buses or trains. We help you plan your journey better.
• INDIVIDUAL QUICK INFORMATION („INDIVIDUELLE SCHNELLAUSKUNFT“): Simply drag and drop the icons for your start and destination favourites and the next connections will be displayed. 
• DEPARTURE MONITOR (ABFAHRTSMONITOR): Here you can choose a stop or station and the next departures will be displayed. Thanks to the punctuality forecast, you know exactly when you have to leave.
• PUSH MESSAGES: You can set your favourite lines and times individually and will receive relevant notifications of delays directly to your smartphone. You’ll keep up-to-date and can switch to other bus or train lines so that you can get around more easily.
The Rheinbahn App is under constant development for you. Please help us by sending your feedback or suggestions to
handyticket@rheinbahn.de. Please also rate us in the App-Store.
Declaration of accessibility: www.rheinbahn.com/journey/rheinbahn-app/accessibility
Working with you to get around easily in the Düsseldorf area.
Your Rheinbahn.

bluejetty:00178177:ios.description:
Background Story
God left us.
The devils from the hell have reached their claws into our world, and the enemy in the void is also staring at us with hostility. In this vital time, we need to save the world more than any time, but God is still silent. So, we can only pick up our weapons and fight for your own survival. Adventurers, except for you, who else can stand up, fight with us against the devils?
Eternal Ember is a Dark Fantasy style Online Idle RPG. You need to build an adventure team to explore the vast continent, engage in exciting battles and get the loots.
Game Features
Category of Monsters
From the basic goblins, skeletons, to the giant golems, hell devils, a wide variety of monsters are waiting for your challenges.
The various categories of monsters’ skills require you to constantly adjust your strategy in the battle. In addition, there are 9 main storyline bosses and more elites, and you must be more careful when fighting with them.
Various Classes
There are heroes of various classes in the game.
Currently, there are 8 classes available: Crusader, Ranger, Priest, Warrior, Hunter, Shaman, Sorcerer and Necro Knight. Each hero can also unlock exclusive ultimate skills, talent trees etc., completely change hero function and strategy, and create more genre of tactical play.
Idle Strategy for Your Squad
In most cases, you need to send four heroes to fight at the same time, so you not only need to consider the hero classes, the potions you carry, but also how to arrange the positioning of heroes in the map, to lead the battle toward the direction of your planning.
After doing a good pre-plan, you just need to relax, watch the heroes to automatically fight with monsters in different maps. Yes, this game doesn't need you to do too much operation during the battle, give everything to the heroes!
Customized Build
If you like to grind, the game is full of loots. Over 100 kinds of weapons and gears are waiting for you.
Gears are the important part of the game. The loots in the game is also mainly based on the gears. After all, nobody can resist the joyful sound when looting the legendary gear after killing the monster.
The game provides great freedom to those who like to pursue the ultimate gear sets. In the blacksmith, you can create your own exclusive gears, from multiple dimensions to improve the properties of gears, make it better to fit your game style.
Vast Continent
The continent in the game is divided into 11 major plates.
Each plate has completely different terrain and various fierce monsters. And there are multiple special map nodes in the game, whether you want to test your own limit or with NPC to resist fierce enemies, you can get a completely different combat experience. The whole world is waiting for you to challenge.
Explore the Rift
There is a very mysterious field in the game – the Shadow Realm. Among them, there are very powerful and unique shadow monsters. Can you overcome them, get cherished treasures?
Epilog
Eternal Ember is a free world and hope you can like it as much as we do. 
Good luck and loot well.

bluejetty:00155640:ios.summary:
ShadowShare brings proxy node importing, testing, favorites, and export into one app. Organize your nodes and compare results on your current network.
Nodes and subscriptions
• Browse and refresh free nodes, or import your own subscription
bluejetty:00155640:ios.description:
ShadowShare brings proxy node importing, testing, favorites, and export into one app. Organize your nodes and compare results on your current network.
Nodes and subscriptions
• Browse and refresh free nodes, or import your own subscriptions and nodes
• Import node links, Base64 content, text files, and QR codes
• Organize nodes by subscription source, search, save favorites, and set display names
• Export nodes or subscriptions to compatible external proxy clients
Latency and download tests
• View node latency and download speed separately
• Run individual or batch tests, sort results, and stop a test at any time
• Downloads use the selected node and consume data on your current network and node
• Results vary with network conditions, time, and the test service
ShadowShare Pro
• Sign in to access member nodes and your personal subscription for a compatible client
• Check regional availability reported by streaming and AI services
• Compare subscription sources using availability and latency reports
• Enjoy ad-free use and export, a higher favorites limit, and member themes
Free node management does not require registration. Member nodes require a signed-in account and active membership. Monthly, quarterly, and yearly subscription prices and billing periods are shown by the store at purchase.
ShadowShare manages, tests, and exports nodes. Your selected external client handles the network connection. Public nodes come from third parties, and their quality and availability can change. The app does not promise a fixed speed, latency, or continuous availability.
Privacy Policy: https://shadowsharing.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service: https://shadowsharing.com/terms-of-service.html

It fe
bluejetty:00162031:ios.description:
MXBus is a monitor mixing app for all Behringer X32 and X-Air mixing consoles that allows musicians on stage to control their own monitor mix with their iOS device. It also supports the Midas versions of these mixers (M32* and M-Air)
It features stereo channels to save screen real-estate, namable groups and automatic console discovery. Musicians can control the send levels into their monitoring mix bus for all channels aux tracks and effects returns. You can even reorder the channels within your groups to your liking. 
It makes the sound check painless and allows you to adjust the mix during the gig. 
Some key differentiating Features:
 • Linked channels are treated as a stereo channel to save screen space. 
 • Double tapping a fader knob sets it 0.
 • Double tapping the panning control on a stereo channel pans the signal hard L/R. Another double tap reverses the panning.
 • NEW: Springboard and Lock Screen widgets for quicker access.
And as always: The app is built with data privacy in mind - no adds, no tracking!
The PRO pack unlocks even more features like:
 • Decayed meters with peak memory
 • Compression meters
 • Gate LEDs
 • Channel mute buttons (X32)
 • Group mute buttons (X32)
 • Unlimited groups
 • Scenes
 • Bus EQ
 • Bus Compressor

Real-Time Lyrics Display
See synchronized lyrics in real time while listening to music, whether on your car’s screen or directly on your device. Perfect for karaoke sessions, learning new songs, or just enjoying your favorite tracks to the fullest.
Lyrics Widgets for Your Home Screen
Add beautifully designed widgets to your iPhone or iPad home screen. Choose from multiple themes and styles to match your personal taste while keeping your favorite lyrics just a glance away.
Multi-Platform Availability
Works seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, and cars.
Subscription Terms:
Your subscription is billed through your iTunes account and will auto-renew each period unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current term ends. 
Payment occurs 24 hours before renewal. 
Starting a paid subscription ends any active free trial.
Manage your subscription anytime in your iTunes Account Settings.

bluejetty:00122331:ios.description:
Compete with Foxy to find the best words on the board! 
In Words with Foxy you play against Foxy and compete to earn the most letter tiles on the board. Each letter used in a word will turn your color. Foxy will make words as well and turn the tiles to his color. There's no time limit, just turn for turn to see who can make the best words and own the most tiles at the end of each level. You need to beat Foxy in order to progress to the next level and there are many different levels to keep you occupied! 
Use booster tiles to earn rockets and shuffles, you'll need them to level the playing field as Foxy steps up his game. 
Fight to own the Gold Tile in each level! Earn them all and unlock secret bonus levels, only intended for the very best players. 
Words with Foxy will sharpen your brain and get you thinking like a fox! 
Features: 
* Strategic game play with no time pressure 
* Rankings to see how you do among all other players in the world 
* Word definition feature allows you to look up words made by you or Foxy 
* Lots of levels and bonus levels for the true wordsmiths
* Rockets and shuffles to help you beat Foxy 
* Lots of replay value as each level is randomly generated.

bluejetty:00173884:ios.summary: Hide and Seek: Stumble Baby 3D is a fun and challenging game for kids of all ages. In this game, you play the role of a father who is trying to find his mischievous child. The child can hide anywhere in the house, and it's up to you to use
bluejetty:00173884:ios.description:
Hide and Seek: Stumble Baby 3D is a fun and challenging game for kids of all ages. In this game, you play the role of a father who is trying to find his mischievous child. The child can hide anywhere in the house, and it's up to you to use your detective skills to find them.The game is easy to learn but difficult to master. 
There are a variety of hiding spots to choose from, and the child can be very creative in their hiding places. You'll need to use your logic and reasoning skills to figure out where the child is hiding. In this unique twist on the classic hide-and-seek game, the challenge is taken to the next level as you navigate through a variety of playful scenarios. From the mischievous antics of your neighbors and family members to the ever-watchful eye of the local policeman, everyone seems to be drawn into the game. 
The excitement is amplified with a central rotating bottle mechanism that determines who is tasked with finding the baby during each round. The suspense builds as the bottle spins, and the chosen seekers must quickly locate the hidden infant.
Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey filled with suspense, strategy, and heartwarming moments as you become the ultimate hide-and-seek champion and a loving dad who's up for any challenge that comes his way.
Highlighter Ability: 
To add an extra layer of strategy, players can employ a highlighter tool that marks potential hiding spots. By highlighting areas that seem suspicious or are known to be popular hiding places, seekers can focus their search and narrow down their options.
X-Ray Vision: 
A game-changing ability that lets players temporarily see through obstacles and walls. By activating X-ray vision, seekers can get a glimpse of the baby's hiding spot, gaining a strategic edge in their quest. Careful timing and utilization of this ability can lead to thrilling last-minute discoveries and heart-pounding moments.

bluejetty:00130911:ios.description:
Meet Iris in partnership with Ride KC, your new local ride. 
Iris provides convenient and affordable shared rides throughout Kansas City, MIssouri. The City is broken into service zones to better provide you access to your community, but you are not limited to your zone. You can explore the entire City with Iris. With any trip taken, you will never have to walk more than 1/4-mile to or from your pick-up or drop-off.
Iris is available 24 hours a day. Rider fares are $3 for trips taken within your zone, $4 to travel to another and $10 to travel to and from the airport. Trips that connect you to RideKC bus services at preset transit centers are free. Iris by RideKC is available to all. Iris by RideKC vehicles can seat up to 5 passengers. Should you need a trip that is wheelchair accessible or has space for a bicycle, you only need to select the corresponding feature when booking your trip. 
Paying for trips on Iris is easy. You can pay in-app or in-vehicle with a credit card or buy ride credits to be added to your account. 
Try Iris by RideKC today!

bluejetty:00033174:ios.name: Pixel Cup Soccer - Ultimate
bluejetty:00033174:ios.summary:
Pixel Cup Soccer is a retro-style arcade game, with fast-paced gameplay, is just the fun part of soccer and a great evolution from its predecessor!
Play friendly matches, tournaments, or create your team and lead it to glory in career mode!
bluejetty:00033174:ios.description:
Pixel Cup Soccer is a retro-style arcade game, with fast-paced gameplay, is just the fun part of soccer and a great evolution from its predecessor!
Play friendly matches, tournaments, or create your team and lead it to glory in career mode!
You can enjoy it solo or team up with a friend locally for some competitive or cooperative action!
It features great pixel art and soundtracks that evoke nostalgia of the glory days of the 80s and 90s arcade games.
Move, pass, and shoot the ball to victory! You will learn to play in one minute, but it takes much longer to master it.
The simple controls enable a rich set of features such as charging and aiming your shots, directing your corner kicks and throw-ins, shooting lobs, slide tackles, and more.
Play Modes:
Friendly Match
Competitions
Career Mode
Penalty Kicks
Cooperative / Competitive for 2 players.
Party Tournaments for 3 to 8 players!
Features:
Simplified controls for casual players.
Simple to pick up and enjoy, with clean and challenging gameplay.
Retro-style art resembling old games and evoking nostalgia.
Women’s Soccer.
Penalties, Free Kicks.
Fouls with injured players, yellow and red cards.
Modding Area, create your own teams and tournaments! 
Career Mode:
Build your own team from the ground up. Climb to the top.
Play leagues D, C, B, A, Country Cup, International Cup and become the Champion in the Club Global Cup!
The Board of Directors of the club has put you in charge of the important decisions of the Club! You will be the General Manager and Coach of the club.
The teams can be fully customized (name, players, shirt colors, club flag, etc.)
Competitions:
Global Cup and Women's Global Cup
American Cup, European Cup, Asian Cup and African Cup.
Global Cup 1930 (evoking the first international cup)
OlymPixel Cup (men and women)
Pixel League D, C, B, A, and Tournament
Tactical panel, to manage substitute changes, team formation, and attitude.
Deep gameplay mechanics: short pass, long pass, etc., aiming when shooting, controlled shot or lobs, player skills.
Lots of Animations (overhead kick, scorpion kick, scissors kick, diving header, etc.)
Challenging AI. Teams with very different game-playing styles (ie: Catenaccio like Italy or Tiki-Taka like Brasil).
Many game settings, including Zoom Level, Slow motion, Assisted mode, etc.
Whether you're a soccer enthusiast or just looking for some fun, this game will keep you entertained for hours!
Ready to rise to the challenge and become a champion?

bluejetty:00187395:ios.description:
Onshape is a full mechanical CAD platform designed for professional users and extended teams. Create, edit, collaborate, and comment in real time with others from any computer or mobile device with an internet connection (free sign-up required).
With Onshape’s secure cloud workspace teams can work together from anywhere on any device without the hassles of file management, IT overhead, and license key distribution, helping engineers focus more on doing their best work.
Parametric CAD:
• Design parts together in Part Studios with a full suite of parametric modeling tools
• Create mechanical Assemblies to capture complex motion
Ease of Access:
• Create, edit, and view from any computer or mobile device (internet connection required)
• Begin a project from one device and seamlessly continue from another
Collaboration:
• Instantly share your CAD data with your teams and partners. Monitor, change, and revoke permissions at any time
• Work together with other users and view changes in real-time as they are made
• Use Follow mode to see exactly what your teammate sees and add suggestions using Onshape’s built-in commenting tools
Data Management:
• Maintain a single source of truth for your data, no more sending around or checking in and out of files 
• Never worry about losing your work, all of your changes are saved automatically 
• Explore multiple design ideas in parallel and create professional release and approval processes for your designs
Onshape for iOS also features Apple Pencil support for more intuitive sketching, navigation, and precise selection.
Onshape proudly supports students and educators free of charge and is available free for non-commercial projects in an open-source public work space.
Since Onshape is updated every few weeks with dozens of new features and user-requested enhancements, keep an eye out for update notifications from the Apple App Store.

bluejetty:00134280:ios.name: Qibla Compass - Direction Find
bluejetty:00134280:ios.summary:
With our application, you can find your qibla direction by calculating your angle from your location to the Kaaba.
If you use our application CORRECTLY, we guarantee to eliminate your Qibla problem wherever you go in the world, we promise.
bluejetty:00134280:ios.description:
With our application, you can find your qibla direction by calculating your angle from your location to the Kaaba.
If you use our application CORRECTLY, we guarantee to eliminate your Qibla problem wherever you go in the world, we promise.
Thanks to our application, it is now possible to determine the direction of the qibla with the highest accuracy wherever you are with your device.
To find the qibla direction:
Turn your phone parallel to the ground in the direction of the Kaaba image until the arrow icon turns green. When the icon is green, the top of your phone will be positioned in the direction of Qibla.
WARNING: In order for the application to detect the Qibla direction with high accuracy, instant internet connection and access to location information services are required.
In addition, you should keep your mobile device away from devices and objects (especially metal objects) that can create magnetic fields during the determination of the Qibla direction.
Surrounding magnetic fields and sheaths can create deviations in calibration. Calibrate your GPS for more accurate results.

bluejetty:00185166:ios.description:
Meet the most accurate mobile metronome app! It is precisely crafted by professional musicians and lets you experience a real metronome as close as it gets! 
Not only does Metronome make it easier to keep the tempo and rhythm, it also helps you practice and learn while using it. Designed for users with different skills, Metronome games offer you to accomplish challenges to pass to a more complicated level! That makes learning process involving and gradual. 
BIRD BEAT game helps memorize rhythm better, play rhythm pattern accurately, retrieve rhythm from your memory more rapidly.
NOTES VALUE game helps get familiar with notes and their types, memorize notes value, understand melody rhythm better. 
RHYTHM TIME game helps study time signatures, operate notes value faster, memorize music notation.
BUTTON GAME helps master the art of timing and learn to play intricate rhythm patterns!
Metronome app will improve your rhythm skills and increase finger flexibility. You will read music sheets faster and understand music better!
Other features to enjoy in Metronome app:
***Visual metronome arrangement*** 
- Digital metronome click tracker; 
- Classic analog metronome click tracker.
***Tempo Animations*** 
- Animated moving pendulum and weight;
- Visual flash and vibration — see and feel the beats! 
***Tempo rates***
- All popular tempos and signatures. Set the desired timer;
- Manually set any tempo;
- Tempo ranges from 10 to 250 bpm beats per minute (timer).
***Sound Sets***
- Over 10 handpicked sounds for every band and style;
- Metronome for drums, piano, and pianoforte;
- and many more.
***Timer***
- Easy and quick to set
- Choose how long you want to practice 
- Split training time into several sections
- Focus and use your time effectively
Our Real Metronome is used by music schools' students and teachers all over the world. If you an educational organization that is using or willing to use our apps, drop us a line at support@gismart.com

Download now and dive into neo-noir chaos.

bluejetty:00165720:ios.description:
Math just got a whole lot easier with AI Math! Whether you're facing tricky equations, complex quizzes, or just need help with homework, AI Math is here to support you every step of the way. Snap a photo, and let our AI-powered scanner handle the rest – from instant answers to in-depth explanations, this app has everything you need to succeed!
Key Features:
- Math Scanner & Camera Tool
Effortlessly solve math problems by simply snapping a photo! Our smart camera recognizes equations instantly and gives you accurate solutions. No more struggling with long equations – AI Math is your go-to equation solver, always at your fingertips.
- AI Chatbot & Instant Answers
Need help understanding a concept or finding the right answer? Just ask! Our built-in AI chatbot (powered by GPT) is ready to assist with math questions, practice exercises, and even general homework questions. Get the answers you need in seconds, so you can stay focused and keep learning.
- Homework Helper & Quiz Support
Stuck on a tough homework question? Preparing for a big quiz or test? AI Math has your back with step-by-step explanations and solutions for a wide range of topics. From basic practice problems to advanced equations, get the support you need to ace every exam and assignment.
- Analyze & Visualize Graphs
Struggling with graph equations? Our advanced tools can read and analyze graphs, providing insights and explanations to help you understand every detail. Perfect for visual learners and anyone needing extra support with graph-related questions.
- Virtual Math Tutor
Consider AI Math your personal math tutor! Whether you’re studying algebra, geometry, calculus, or just need quick help with daily exercises, this app provides a reliable, on-demand tutor experience that’s as close as it gets to having a real teacher by your side.
- Practice, Test, & Improve
Practice makes perfect! With AI Math, you can solve math problems and take quizzes to sharpen your skills and improve your math knowledge over time. Tackle practice tests or random problems to see where you stand – the best way to stay prepared for any exam.
Why Choose AI Math?
- Instant Answers: Snap and solve with ease – perfect for students needing fast solutions.
- Free Access with Enhanced Options: Enjoy essential features for free, and upgrade to unlock unlimited access and premium tools.
- Ad-Free Experience: Learn without interruptions – no ads, just answers.
- Always There for You: Get reliable help whenever you need it, from homework support to exam prep.
Whether you’re working through a tough homework assignment, preparing for exams, or just brushing up on math, AI Math is here to make math easier, faster, and more accessible. Join thousands of students transforming their learning experience with AI Math – download now and explore the power of AI in math!
Perfect for:
- Students at all levels – from middle school to college.
- Parents helping kids with homework.
- Anyone looking to refresh their math skills.
Start using AI Math today and experience math made easy!

bluejetty:00138319:ios.description:
Unlock your natural radiance with personalized beauty guidance designed for modern women. Whether you're struggling with skincare confusion, searching for the perfect makeup routine, or looking to enhance your natural glow, Beauty Tips delivers expert advice tailored to your unique needs.
Celebrate Mother's Day with our special gift guide featuring curated beauty routines perfect for moms of all ages. Show appreciation with personalized skincare recommendations, anti-aging solutions, and pampering rituals that make every day feel special. Share the gift of self-care with step-by-step guides designed to help the important women in your life look and feel their absolute best.
Key Features That Deliver Real Results:
Personalized Skincare Routines - Answer a quick assessment and receive customized morning and evening routines designed for your specific skin type, whether dry, oily, combination, or sensitive. Learn which products work best together and when to apply them for maximum effectiveness.
Expert Makeup Tutorials - Master professional techniques with easy-to-follow video guides and step-by-step photo instructions. From everyday natural looks to glamorous evening makeup, discover tricks that enhance your features and save time during your morning routine.
Seasonal Beauty Adjustments - Your skin changes with the weather, and your routine should too. Get timely recommendations for spring hydration, summer sun protection, fall recovery, and winter moisture retention. Stay ahead of seasonal challenges before they impact your complexion.
Natural Beauty Solutions - Explore DIY face masks, homemade treatments, and ingredient-based remedies using items from your kitchen. Learn which natural alternatives actually work and which are myths, backed by scientific research and dermatological expertise.
Anti-Aging Strategies - Discover proven techniques for maintaining youthful, healthy skin at any age. Understand the science behind wrinkles, fine lines, and age spots, then implement preventative measures and corrective treatments that deliver visible improvements.
Complete Wellness Integration - Beauty starts from within. Access nutrition guidance, hydration tracking, sleep optimization tips, and stress management techniques that support your external glow. Connect your skincare routine to overall health for comprehensive transformation.
Product Ingredient Analysis - Decode confusing cosmetic labels and understand what you're putting on your skin. Learn to identify beneficial ingredients like hyaluronic acid, retinol, vitamin C, and niacinamide, while avoiding harmful additives and common irritants.
Hair and Nail Care - Extend your beauty knowledge beyond facial skincare. Get professional advice for healthy, lustrous hair and strong, beautiful nails. Discover treatments for common concerns like damage, breakage, and slow growth.
Daily Reminders and Tracking - Never skip your routine again with customizable notifications. Track your progress with before-and-after photos, monitor product effectiveness, and celebrate improvements as your skin transforms week by week.
Why thousands of women trust Beauty Tips for their daily routine:
Our content is developed in collaboration with licensed skincare professionals and makeup artists with decades of combined experience. We stay current with the latest dermatological research, ingredient innovations, and application techniques, ensuring you receive accurate, safe, and effective guidance. Every recommendation is vetted for safety and efficacy, giving you peace of mind while exploring new products and methods.

Privacy Policy - http://thecookbk.com/privacy.php?appname=beauty.skin.care.app

bluejetty:00036204:ios.description:
Save all information in one place: Bosch MeasureOn by Bosch Measuring Tools is your app for easy on-site documentation of floor plans, measurements, photos, and notes. With cloud-based* project access anywhere on all devices – on the construction site, at the office, on the move, or at home.
Main functions and benefits:
- USE THE NEW INFINITE WORKSPACE: Start your project, sketch floor plans as individual rooms within the flexible workspace, and add photos and notes according to your individual needs.
- DOCUMENT ON THE JOBSITE: Use your laser range finder and your smart device to capture measurements instantly and insert them error-free into the app.
- STAY ON TOP OF THINGS: Organize your projects, save time, and avoid confusion.
- SECURITY AND CONVENIENCE: Thanks to the cloud*, your data is always backed up and synchronized on all your devices. You can easily process your documentation on your desktop back at the office.
Features:
- Add floor plans as individual rooms, photos, and notes to your workspace
- Add in measurements directly from your laser range finder via Bluetooth®
- Document wall dimensions including doors and windows
- Synchronize your data automatically via the cloud*
- Share and export data in a variety of formats
Developed for tradesmen such as painters, electricians, carpenters, tilers, dry wallers, floorers, plumbers, architects, and construction managers as well as DIYers.
Compatible laser range finders:
Bosch Professional: GLM 50 C, GLM 100 C, GLM400C, GLM165-27C and GLM165-27CG
Bosch MeasureOn replaces the MeasureOn Gen 1 app. 
Experience our cloud* for free and synchronize your first project with up to three workspaces.
Questions, problems, suggestions? Contact us: Measuring.AppSupport@us.bosch.com
*Not available in all countries. In order to use the cloud service, you need to set up a Bosch account with your Bosch ID.

Save all information in one place: Bosch MeasureOn by Bosch Measuring Tools is your app for easy on-site documentation of floor plans, measurements, photos, and notes. With cloud-based* project access anywhere on all devices – on the construction site, at the office, on the move, or at home.

Main functions and benefits:
- USE THE NEW INFINITE WORKSPACE: Start your project, sketch floor plans as individual rooms within the flexible workspace, and add photos and notes according to your individual needs.
- DOCUMENT ON THE JOBSITE: Use your laser range finder and your smart device to capture measurements instantly and insert them error-free into the app.
- STAY ON TOP OF THINGS: Organize your projects, save time, and avoid confusion.
- SECURITY AND CONVENIENCE: Thanks to the cloud*, your data is always backed up and synchronized on all your devices. You can easily process your documentation on your desktop back at the office.

Features:
- Add floor plans as individual rooms, photos, and notes to your workspace
- Add in measurements directly from your laser range finder via Bluetooth®
- Document wall dimensions including doors and windows
- Synchronize your data automatically via the cloud*
- Share and export data in a variety of formats

Developed for tradesmen such as painters, electricians, carpenters, tilers, dry wallers, floorers, plumbers, architects, and construction managers as well as DIYers.

Compatible laser range finders:
Bosch Professional: GLM 50 C, GLM 100 C, GLM400C, GLM165-27C and GLM165-27CG

Bosch MeasureOn replaces the MeasureOn Gen 1 app. 

Experience our cloud* for free and synchronize your first project with up to three workspaces.
Questions, problems, suggestions? Contact us: Measuring.AppSupport@us.bosch.com

*Not available in all countries. In order to use the cloud service, you need to set up a Bosch account with your Bosch ID.

bluejetty:00043395:ios.description:
START EARNING
Apply at https://taskrabbit.com/delivery/helpers
Earn extra money on your schedule as a Helper or Hand with Taskrabbit Delivery. Use your pickup truck, cargo van, box truck, or just your hands to deliver and move big and bulky items in your city. 
Deliver for top nationwide brands like Best Buy, The Container Store, Costco, Lowe’s, Crate & Barrel, Big Lots!, Facebook Marketplace, and many more.
In addition to deliveries, there are many other moving-related jobs in your area: apartment moves, small moves, labor-only jobs, business moves, storage moves, junk removal, donation runs, and many more. 
HIGH PAYOUTS, GUARANTEED
See how much you'll get paid before requesting a task and receive 100% of customer tips! Top Helpers routinely earn over $1,000 per week.
WORK ON YOUR SCHEDULE
Work as much or as little as you’d like. You have full control over what tasks you request. Go for only the ones that suit you.
BUILD YOUR DELIVERY BUSINESS
Be your own boss and quickly grow your business with consistent, well-paid work, and live notifications of when new tasks are requested in your area.
HOW IT WORKS 
1.Get Notified & View Details - Open the Helper app to view details, items, general locations, and upfront pay.
2.Request & Get Scheduled - Request tasks to build your schedule. Connect with your customer to provide a great experience. If the task is a two person job, meet the other Helper.
3.Do the Task & Get Paid - Swipe to start. Do the task. Swipe to stop. Get paid. It’s that easy.
CITIES
Find local delivery and moving jobs in over 35 states in the U.S with Taskrabbit Delivery.. 
Service areas: Atlanta, Austin, Baltimore, Boston, Charlotte, Chicago, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Columbus, Dallas, Denver, Detroit, Fort Lauderdale, Hartford, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, Milwaukee, Minneapolis, Nashville, New Haven, New York City, Orange County, Orlando, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Portland, Raleigh-Durham, San Antonio, San Diego, San Francisco, San Jose, Tampa, and Washington, DC with more coming soon!
PERKS 
Unlock special perks as you complete tasks to get Helper-only pricing at over 28,000 national and local merchants. 
Exclusive savings on the following:
•Electronics
•Automobiles
•Movie Tickets
•Food
•Travel/Lodging

bluejetty:00064245:ios.summary: Catch up with your favorite TLC shows anytime, anywhere with the all-new TLC GO app - and now get access to up to 14 additional networks including Food Network, ID, Travel Channel, Discovery and more - all in one app. It’s FREE with your pa
bluejetty:00064245:ios.description:
Catch up with your favorite TLC shows anytime, anywhere with the all-new TLC GO app - and now get access to up to 14 additional networks including Food Network, ID, Travel Channel, Discovery and more - all in one app. It’s FREE with your pay TV subscription. 
Link your pay TV provider (cable, satellite, telco, live TV streaming service) to access TLC favorites like Sister Wives, My 600-lb Life, Dr. Pimple Popper, OutDaughtered, Seeking Sister Wife, Doubling Down with the Derricos, 1000-lb Sisters and many more - plus top shows from other networks including Home Town (HGTV), Worst Cooks in America (Food Network), Ghost Adventures (Travel Channel), Evil Lives Here (ID), Naked and Afraid (Discovery) and more. New episodes are available the same day as they premiere on TV. 
With TLC GO You Can:
• Stream TLC and more networks LIVE anytime, anywhere on all your favorite devices
• Find shows to watch with the live schedule guide
• Access thousands of episodes on demand - from current hits to classic favorites
• See new episodes of shows on the app the same day and time they premiere on TV
• Binge your favorite TLC series and specials including Sister Wives, My 600-lb Life, Dr. Pimple Popper, OutDaughtered, Seeking Sister Wife, Doubling Down with the Derricos, 1000-lb Sisters - and many more! 
• Get unlimited access to everything the Discovery family of networks has to offer - free with your pay TV subscription
Features:
• Stream live TV when you log in with your pay TV provider
• Watch select episodes and entire seasons of your favorite shows from up to 15 networks!
• Browse by genre - from Natural History, Science and Tech to Food, Home and more - to find your favorite shows and discover new ones
• Continue watching episodes where you left off across all of your devices
• Save shows and episodes to watch later with My List
• Compatible with tvOS and Chromecast
• Closed-captioning support
Requirements:
• Available in the U.S. only
• Wi-Fi connection recommended
• iOS 12 or higher 
Need help? Visit gohelp.discovery.com.
Visitor Agreement: https://corporate.discovery.com/visitor-agreement/
Privacy Notice: https://corporate.discovery.com/privacy-policy
California Privacy Notice: https://corporate.discovery.com/privacy-policy/#cappi
California Do Not Sell My Personal Info: https://corporate.discovery.com/california_dns

bluejetty:00022183:ios.summary: Come and meet your new neighbors in Papo Town Apartment! This time we added a new addictive gameplay of coloring by numbers. Color the furniture and items in each room by numbers and make your apartment alive and beautiful again! Then you c
bluejetty:00022183:ios.description:
Come and meet your new neighbors in Papo Town Apartment! This time we added a new addictive gameplay of coloring by numbers. Color the furniture and items in each room by numbers and make your apartment alive and beautiful again! Then you could play house with Papo friends! 
Coloring will help the little ones develop fine motion skills and it is also a great way to enhance their imagination and creativity! With a variety of more than 100 items and furniture, you could really enjoy the relaxing coloring time!
What style do you prefer? There are 4 styles of apartments for your choice: princess style, sport style, Mediterranean style and forest style. Don’t be surprised if your apartment is very empty at the beginning, It’s your task to follow the numbers and fill in the colors for each furniture and decorative piece, and eventually make your apartment nice and comfortable. 
After the apartment room is ready, you could play house with cute animal friends to create funny stories and experiences. Everyone could be his/her own director. 
Great news! A new app with lots of scenes and a great variety of different locations including home, school, shopping mall, park, airport and other places will be released soon! Stay tuned!
Play and learn with Purple Pink!
【Features】
 New gameplay! A combination of coloring by numbers and play house game!
 More than one hundred pictures for coloring!
 4 different styles of apartments for choice!
 No rules, more fun!
 Explore creativity and imagination.
 Support multi-touch. You could play with friends!
 More than 100 interactive props.
 No Wi-Fi needed. It can be played anywhere!
This version of Papo World Apartment is free to download. Unlock more rooms through in-app purchase. Once complete the purchase, it will be permanently unlocked and bound with your account. 
If there are any questions during the purchase and playing, feel free to contact us via contact@papoworld.com

更多上新正在计划中，欢迎许愿、提建议！

bluejetty:00018411:ios.name: Tikkie
bluejetty:00018411:ios.summary: Requesting back your money and paying back other people doesn’t have to be difficult. Tikkie lets your friends pay you back quickly and easily over WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger or by text message. And it’s really easy to transfer money wit
bluejetty:00018411:ios.description:
Requesting back your money and paying back other people doesn’t have to be difficult. Tikkie lets your friends pay you back quickly and easily over WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger or by text message. And it’s really easy to transfer money with Tikkie, no matter where you bank. Anyone can use Tikkie!
When to use Tikkie
Tikkie comes in handy when you have paid for someone else and you want your money back, or when someone else has paid for you and you need to pay them back. Whether it’s a one-off purchase or various different group expenses, Tikkie can be used in any situation. You might have paid for: 
• drinks with your club friends; 
• a present for a colleague; 
• festival tickets; 
• weekend away with friends; 
• household expenses in your student house.
Really easy payment requests
Simply use Tikkie to send a payment request over WhatsApp, Telegram or Messenger, by text message, or however else you want. The request will contain a link that your friends can use to pay you back. So you no longer need to exchange account numbers! Your friends don’t need to have Tikkie, but they do need a Dutch current account, and a Dutch, Belgian or German phone number. Tip: you can now also let your friends fill in the amount themselves. That’s handy when different people owe you different amounts.
Track your group expenses and settle up 
Tikkie makes it easy for you to keep track of group expenses too. Create a Groepie, invite your friends, and you’re good to go. All of the group members can add and settle up expenses, with a Tikkie of course! Good to know: your friends need the Tikkie app to join a Groepie.
Unique deals with Tikkie Terug
Get money back from well-known brands thanks to cashback promotions! If you see a QR code in a shop or on an online promotion page, simply scan it with the Tikkie app and get all or part of the purchase price back right away.
iDEAL | Wero payments
Your friends pay you back using iDEAL | Wero and their own banking app, and the money is paid straight into your current account. Payments through Tikkie also use iDEAL | Wero and we don’t charge any transaction fees for this.
For businesses too
If you’re an ABN AMRO business client, make things easy on yourself and your customers by sending a payment request! Tikkie is also available to businesses, from self-employed individuals to multinationals. Your invoices are paid fast and your customers are happy. They don’t need cash, and you don’t need an expensive payment terminal.
ABN AMRO initiative
Tikkie is an ABN AMRO initiative, which means your details are secure. ABN AMRO only uses your details for the payments requests and payments, and not for any commercial activities.

Shop up to 80% off fashion deals — every single day.

GOLD finds the best deals on brands you actually want to wear. Reformation, Princess Polly, Everlane, Levi's, Zara, Adidas, Aritzia, Free People, and hundreds more — all at up to 80% off. Every deal comes with free shipping, no minimums.

HOW IT WORKS

Every day at 6pm PT / 9pm ET, GOLD drops your Golden Hour — a personalized feed of fashion deals just for you. One hour. New styles daily. Never repeated.
Swipe right to save, left to skip. GOLD's AI learns your style with every swipe, so your feed gets smarter over time. No more scrolling through brands you don't care about.
Grab your favorites before the hour ends. Tomorrow brings all-new deals, all-new styles.

WHY GOLD?

→ AI-powered personal styling that actually learns what you like
→ Up to 80% off trending and designer brands across the entire internet
→ Free shipping on everything, no subscription, no membership fees
→ New deals every day — never the same thing twice

bluejetty:00174406:ios.description:
*** Decibel Meter - Measure Sound Volume with Precision! ***
Introducing Decibel Meter, the ultimate tool for accurately measuring sound levels in decibels (dB). Whether you're monitoring noise levels in your environment, checking the sound of your music, or simply curious about the volume around you, our app provides real-time measurements and easy-to-understand feedback. With a sleek interface and precise functionality, Decibel Meter is your go-to sound meter for all your acoustic needs.
Whether you're using a db meter to check your home’s background noise or need a professional-grade noise meter for your job, this app adapts to your needs. Enjoy the reliability of a finely tuned sound meter that delivers consistent performance every time. With this versatile noise meter, you can assess the loudness of any setting with confidence. Our db meter is ideal for musicians, audio technicians, and everyday users alike. Trust in our sound meter to help you create a quieter, safer, and more informed environment.
*** Real-Time Sound Measurement ***
Our db meter offers real-time sound measurement, instantly displaying the current sound volume level on your device. The main indicator not only shows the exact decibel level but also provides a brief explanation of the volume intensity, so you always know what the numbers mean.
*** Key Features of Decibel Meter ***
- Accurate Sound Measurements: Get precise sound volume readings in decibels (dB) with our advanced sound meter. Monitor the noise levels around you with ease and confidence.
- Real-Time Volume Display: The app continuously updates the current sound level in real-time, making it easy to track changes in your environment's volume.
- Volume Timeline: At the bottom of the screen, you'll find a volume value timeline that visually represents sound fluctuations over time, helping you to see trends and patterns in noise levels.
- Customizable Calibration: Tailor the app to your specific device with the calibration settings. Adjust the db meter according to your microphone's characteristics for the most accurate readings possible.
- User-Friendly Interface: Simple and intuitive, our app is designed for anyone to use. Whether you're a sound engineer or just curious, Decibel Meter makes sound measurement straightforward and accessible.
*** How to Use ***
- Open the App: Launch the Decibel Meter to start measuring sound levels instantly.
- Monitor Sound Levels: Watch as the main indicator displays the current sound volume in decibels (dB), with a helpful explanation of the sound intensity.
- Calibrate for Accuracy: Use the settings screen to calibrate the sound meter according to your device's microphone for optimal accuracy.
- Review the Volume Timeline: Check the timeline at the bottom of the screen to observe sound volume changes over time.
*** Why Choose Decibel Meter? ***
- Precision at Your Fingertips: Our app provides highly accurate sound level readings, ensuring you always have the most reliable information.
- Easy Calibration: Customize the dB meter to fit your device's microphone, ensuring precise measurements tailored to your specific needs.
- Visual and Intuitive: The combination of real-time data, visual timelines, and clear explanations makes understanding sound levels easier than ever.
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/iosdecibelmeter/privacy/
Terms and Conditions: https://zipoapps.com/iosdecibelmeter/terms/

bluejetty:00175297:ios.name: GIF Keyboard
bluejetty:00175297:ios.summary:
Say more with GIF Keyboard by Tenor. Add tone to your conversation. 
With Tenor’s GIF Keyboard for iPhone, iPad and iMessage discover or create the right GIF or video to visually sum up exactly what you’re trying to say, directly from your
bluejetty:00175297:ios.description:
Say more with GIF Keyboard by Tenor. Add tone to your conversation. 
With Tenor’s GIF Keyboard for iPhone, iPad and iMessage discover or create the right GIF or video to visually sum up exactly what you’re trying to say, directly from your keyboard. Express the emotion, inside joke, or clever response you want to share.
iMessage App Features:
- Get the same great browse and search experience as GIF Keyboard, including access to your favorites and uploads.
Create Stickers
- Press and hold on any GIF to create a sticker that you can drag and drop onto any text, image or GIF in iMessage.
Capture GIFs
- Create your own GIFs with your front or back camera and personalize them with text, a handwritten note or drawings. Share instantly or save to a Pack.
Packs
- Create packs of your favorite stickers and GIFs that you can easily share with friends and family. 
Syncs with GIF Keyboard
- Everything syncs to your Tenor GIF Keyboard so you can take your stickers and GIFs everywhere GIFs are supported. 
GIF Keyboard Features:
- Send the right GIF or video to express exactly what’s on your mind, directly from your keyboard!
- Search Tenor’s millions of GIFs and videos to find the one that perfectly fits the moment. You can also search by emoji to see the GIFs related to that emoji..
- Need inspiration? Browse by category like reactions, trending topics, and more. 
- Once you find the right GIF or video, simply tap it to automatically copy it to your clipboard, tap the iMessage text box to paste it and watch as it plays inline in your conversation. 
- See a GIF you like while browsing on your phone? Save it directly to your GIF Keyboard from Safari with the share button and our share extension. No need to save it to your camera roll because it’s instantly available from your GIF Keyboard!
- Keep the GIFs you love handy -- double tap a GIF to favorite it and customize your GIF Keyboard. 
- Works with your favorite messengers and social networks including iMessage, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, Facebook and email. Just long-press on a GIF to pull up options to share the GIF, video, link, or save to camera roll.
Tenor’s GIF Keyboard needs “full access” in your iPhone settings. This gives the GIF Keyboard full access to the internet so we’re able to give you the GIF you are searching for and ensure that our library is always updated with the latest and greatest GIFs and videos. 
Note: We do not log keystrokes or send them to our servers other than to search by key terms for the perfect GIF. If you have any other questions about full access please email us at privacy@tenor.co.
Tenor was formerly known as Riffsy.

bluejetty:00184972:ios.description:
Pocket Knights2 won the 2018 app Store Global Featuring，and accumulated 11 million downloads worldwide.
The 5th Anniversary Celebration is under way. Welcome to this casual adventure game world!
Dragons, knights and wizards live peacefully in the world Titan created. 
However, dark forces threaten the fate of the world.
To protect the fate of the world, heroes and guild,united to fight against legendary monsters or raid dragon's dens. 
They collect epic loot, and gain unimaginable power. 
Besides fairy tales, mystic heroes, dungeons and dragons,there are also PVP battles in the arena and Guild Wars controlled by other players!
Your will be the mobile legends in the world! 
Let's start an epic Adventure in Pocket Knights 2!
[Dragon City on floating islands]
Titans created floating islands and dragons built city on it.
Elves, humans, orcs, angels, gods, demons and some other mysterious races, come and settle down in this flourishing world.
Now they all gather together to save the fate of the world.
[Unique Knights Wait Your Order]
Summon over 100 knights, heroes and monsters from distinct cultures to create your own fantasy dream-team of elite warriors. 
Knights,heroes and monsters all follow your orders to act. Their fate is up to you.
Train them and order them to collect loot or start heroes wars and conquer different regions.
[Defeat Bosses to Collect Rewards]
Bosses have a lot of treasure, and randomly refresh in the world.
All you have to do every day, is to find them, then defeat him to get big loots.
[Great Dragon Mount]
Collect over 50 Mounts from different world, include many different dragon mounts.
You can ride different mount in the dragon city and show it to your friends or other knights.
[Various Fashionable Outfits]
Makeup, Dress Up, there are more than 50 outfits you can collect and choose.
You can freely match hairstyles and outfits.
Create your own unique avatar.
[BUILD YOUR STRONGEST TEAM]
Recruit and upgrade over 100 Heroes from different positions
Mix and match unique Heroes to unleash fantastic combo-skills
[REINFORCEMENT, PERFECT YOUR STRATEGY]
Master abilities to overcome the most powerful enemies
Arrange your best bench strategically for a crucial assist
[COLLECT POWERFUL GEAR]
Discover legendary equipment in mysterious battlefields
Upgrade gears to improve your combat and deal massive damage
[BATTLE ONLINE]
Dominate the Arena, participate in Guild wars, climb your own way to the top
Collect valuable resources and start Team Instances with worldwide players
[TAKE ON QUESTS TO EARN MORE REWARDS]
Enter and conquer harder battles to earn bigger treats
Find powerful loot and equipment in hidden spots
[The related instructions of automatic renewal]
1.Subscriptions Type: 90 Days, 30 Days, 7 Days
2.Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase
3.Renewal:Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period
4.Cancel:Subscriptions automatically renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your account settings on the App Store
5.After a free trial period (7 Days), subscriptions will be charged for weekly subscriptions. Can be canceled at any time.
6.Terms of Use:http://center.mngo.com/html/team
7.Privacy Policy:http://center.mngo.com/html

If you encounter any difficulties or require support, please reach us at:
Email: PKsupport@mngo.com
Facebook Page: www.facebook.com/Pocketknights2
discord：https://discord.gg/h9zknM9

bluejetty:00121718:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00121718:ios.description:
It’s My Town Movie Night! 
Enter the theater and buy a ticket for the movie you’d like to see. You get to choose from 30 different short films! Take photos with your favorite actor or super hero and grab your popcorn before settling down in your seat.
What’s even more fun than going to see a movie? Running the theater yourself! Your friends will be hungry before the movie, and you can make them their own popcorn. Don’t forget the soda! You even get to enter the projection room and run the projector all by yourself! Sometimes the projector breaks down and you’ll get to fix it with life-like tools. 
What’s even MORE fun than running a theater? Directing or acting in your own movie! At the My Town : Cinema, you can even direct or act in the movie of Oz that is being shot at the My Town movie studio.
FEATURES
 *30 mini My Town movie episodes for you to enjoy. 
*Many new characters with new costumes to dress them up in.
*So many rooms to discover and explore!
*14 characters to choose from, including: contestants, store keeps, stage managers and more! 
If you can imagine it, you can make it. Everything is possible in My Town : Cinema!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
TELL US WHAT YOU THINK!
 You can easily contact with us on Facebook or Twitter at any time to let us know what you would like changed or added. Maybe you’ve come up with a new My Town game all on your own – let us know! We promise to read all messages and reply. We love to hear YOUR ideas, so please connect with us! 
Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
 Twitter – https://twitter.com/mytowngames
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

Enjoy logic puzzles and train your brain in Logic Riddle!
Decode written clues and fill in the grid to solve each puzzle. Some words may contain two or more clues. Find hidden logics and use hints when necessary!
There are thousands of unique puzzles with increasing difficulty. From easy to expert, work your way up and become a logic master! 
Not easy at first but super fun and satisfying when you solve them. 
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS 
Subscription Options 
In our game, we have the following subscription option: 
- Diamond Membership offers subscription service at $4.99 per week. With this subscription, you can get 2500 coins, 2 hints and 2 magnifiers instantly, 1200 coins every day starting from the second day, unlock all puzzles and remove pop-up Ads.
- End of trial and subscription renewal
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. Payment will be charged to Apple Store Account at confirmation of purchase without free trial.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. 
Subscription may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Apple Store Account Settings after purchase. 
- Subscription is not a must in our game
Users can choose whether to subscribe to our game or not. Except for elements offered in the Subscription option, users who do not make a subscription will still have access to the basic elements in our game.

bluejetty:00019445:ios.description:
As laughter rings out in the depths of the wasteland, the infected's roars pierce the night, signaling danger ahead.
Ichiban Kasuga, Kazuma Kiryu, and Goro Majima arrive on the streets, ready to fight the infected with their passion and will.
State of Survival x Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth is live!
In this strategy war game, fight to survive this doomsday world filled with zombies!! Everyone's gotta show what they're made of in the zombie survival showdown! You've got to survive and dodge the creeping dead army and infection. In this doomsday scenarios, facing the ultimate survival challenge, your task is to establish and manage your own shelter, join forces with mighty allies, and take on the zombie war together. You'll need to get smart with your strategy to power up your skills, blast through the zombie mobs, and keep the invaders at bay.
You are the doomsday survivor of your shelter, and you could even become the leader of an alliance in this post-apocalyptic world. Team up with mighty allies, bring in powerful heroes, and launch a defense against the wave of zombies. You've got to collect resources, strengthen your shelter's build and defense to make sure you and your team can survive this war.
Boost Your Base: To keep your city standing and survive until the very last minute in this total war, upgrading shelter is critical. Focus on upgrade buildings, train your troops, execute your strategy and research to enhance your defense capabilities. Gear up with craft Tempest Arms and Energy Conversion Units for extra protective edge, and enhance your gear to turn the looming threat of the catastrophic world into nothing. Plus, you’ll need to gather resources to fuel your base's growth and increase your odds of survival.
Allies and Enemies: In this dark doomsday scenario, you can recruit epic heroes, form alliances, establish an alliance and fight alongside a mighty ally to launch a defense of the capital. You can also join cross-server battles for a confrontation where only the dead are left behind, and fight for survival to the very end. Make and execute your own strategy to guard your shelter and build up your defense against the onslaught from zombies. You can overcome the dark and be the last survivor!
Epic Events: In Survival Royale, you'll be thrown into a survival game and find hope through this black survival. You must escape as the danger zone gradually expands, collect plunder, and equip yourself with a powerful arsenal for your defense against incoming attacks from other players, and become the last survivor of the war. In "Desert Survival," pick your side—human or monster—in a strategic battle survival game where the dark clashes with the light in an epic doomsday face-off. In Paw-some Puzzle Party, you just need to stay relaxed and enjoy the challenge with a crew of skilled cats.
Style in the Apocalypse: join all kinds of survivor challenge events to snag HQ decorations, March Skins, Frames, Guardians, and a whole array of other cool stuff. Each player has their own Collection Hall, displaying a variety of exquisite skins. Even as the last days loom, you can survive in style!
Begin your journey from the last shelter now to change all these and allow everyone to escape from despair and the post-apocalyptic world! The world needs you to fight. Let's survive together in a war filled with doom. In this strategy war game. Are you ready?

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/TheSoSGame
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCVSyGzN8MqTfZ9W3pHC5Htg
Terms and Conditions: https://funplus.com/terms-conditions/en/
Privacy Policy: https://funplus.com/privacy-policy/en/

Start your engine and hit the “transform” button with Car Adventure, the ultimate Car Games for Kids! Watch as your vehicle undergoes a thrilling transformation!
In Car Adventure, each vehicle boasts its own unique morphing mode. From ordinary cars, watch as they transform into awesome excavators! Join us as we dig up rocks, dive underground, and possibly uncover hidden treasures and secret bases. Your car can also morph into a hovercraft, offering kids an exhilarating ride! Want to touch the sky? Your car can convert into a helicopter! Or maybe explore the depths of the ocean? Transform your vehicle into a submarine! Welcome to the world of Dinosaur Deformers in Car Adventure.
Car Adventure is all about exploration! Transform and traverse through various locations, each offering multiple routes. Sail among the clouds, unearth treasures, and take in the stunning views as you climb. Be prepared for unexpected surprises as you navigate the Deformers!
The time has come for kids to embark on their own adventure! Jump into a transforming car in Car Adventure and discover all the fun and surprises that await!
Features:
• Six unique deformers each with their distinct modes of operation and transformation
• Lifelike animations and sound effects that bring the cars to life
• Exploration in various scenes: Water park, deep sea, underground, stone forest, hilly area, and city.
• Six scenic landscapes offering multiple routes
• Perfectly suited for preschool children, aged 0-5 years old
• Free from third-party advertising

Yateland develops apps with educational values, inspiring preschoolers worldwide to learn through play! We stand by our motto with each app we make: "Apps children love and parents trust." Discover more about Yateland and our apps at https://yateland.com.
