bluejetty:00165936:ios.description:
Print professional-looking envelopes straight from your iPhone or iPad. Envelope Printer puts the delivery and return address exactly where they belong, on any envelope size, with any AirPrint printer — no computer, no templates, no guesswork.
Whether you are mailing invitations, greeting cards, invoices or business letters, Envelope Printer turns a tedious task into a few taps.
KEY FEATURES
• Any envelope size – choose from dozens of standard sizes (#10, DL, C4, C5, C6, A2–A10, square, catalog, Chou and Kaku) or enter a custom width and height.
• Saved contacts – store delivery and return addresses once and reuse them with a single tap. No more retyping.
• Batch printing – select several contacts, or separate addresses with a blank line, and print one envelope per address in a single job.
• Full design control – adjust fonts, sizes, colours, alignment and position by dragging the text directly on the live preview.
• Your own logo – add a custom icon or logo next to the return address.
• Smart paper handling – paper size override and front/top loader guides help your printer accept envelopes without hassle.
• Inches or centimetres – pick the units you are used to.
• Works with AirPrint – HP, Canon, Epson, Brother and every other AirPrint-compatible printer.
WHO IT IS FOR
Small businesses sending invoices, families mailing holiday and birthday cards, wedding planners addressing invitations, home offices, clubs and anyone who wants a clean, legible envelope without hand-writing it.
PREMIUM
Upgrade to Premium for unlimited prints, custom icons, removal of the QR code and access to every feature. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://envelope.ardasen.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://envelope.ardasen.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00071683:ios.description:
What if you had decided to become a bank teller? Find out if you’d be good at it by slipping into the simulation role of a banker. 
A fun way to cure your boredom and keep your brain entertained by taking care of customers, validating checks, depositing money, sorting coins, keeping your coworkers and customers safe during bank heists and much more! 
Are you ready to prove that you have what it takes to run a bank? 
Features: 
- Over 1000 levels of fun and entertaining bank teller tasks
- Improve and boost your mathematical and cognitive skill
- Rewards for completing tasks
- Variety of fun mini-games to challenge your brain
- Game autosaves, so you can pick up where you left off
- Get awesome upgrades and prices for your bank
- Build your own office with fun 3D furniture and accessories
Fun for all ages! Money Bank 3D is an entertaining game for everyone. Improve your mathematical and cognitive skills while fulfilling the tasks of a bank teller. 
How To Play:
- Swipe right/left to approve checks and emails
- Tap on bills to withdraw the correct amount
- Tap and hold to count money 
- Tap to insert credit card
- Tap to type in pins and amounts
- Sign checks and documents by following the line with your finger
- Swipe to insert checks
- Tap and drag money to sort it
- Tap and drag numbers to copy passcodes for locks 
- Tap to unlock doors
- Tap the SOS button that lights up when the robber isn’t looking
- Tap on money to throw into the crowd
Fulfill the typical tasks of a bank teller in this fun and entertaining bank simulator mobile game. 
It’s a great way to pass the time and improve your math skills. Check back frequently for exciting new updates and features!

bluejetty:00187977:ios.description:
Blind is the world’s largest anonymous professional network, with more than 12 million verified members sharing what’s really happening at work.
Layoffs. Reorgs. Hiring freezes. Return-to-office mandates. Salary changes. Leadership drama. Company rumors. Career advice.
From Google and JPMorgan to leading AI companies and emerging startups, get firsthand workplace news, conversations and perspectives from the people closest to them.
NO WORK EMAIL? NO PROBLEM.
Verify with work email, Linkedin or your work history to gain full access to company channels, private lounges and more. Sign on with a personal email to get read only access to public channels.
TALK ABOUT WORK ANONYMOUSLY
Talk openly about the things you can’t always say at work. Compare notes with coworkers, share what’s happening inside your company and get candid advice from people who understand your world of work.
Blind is built for anonymous workplace conversations, so you can speak freely without putting your real name on your posts. 
SEE WHAT’S HAPPENING AT WORK
When layoffs, reorganizations, leadership changes and major company news break, employees come to Blind to share what they’re seeing and hearing in real time.
Join discussions across thousands of companies and industries about:
• Layoffs, hiring and reorganizations
• Leadership and RTO changes
• Salaries, bonuses and benefits
• Promotions and performance reviews
• Company culture and management
• Interviews, offers and referrals
• Industry and workplace trends
KNOW YOUR WORTH
Explore salary data by role, company, location and experience. Compare compensation, prepare for negotiations and make better-informed career decisions.
MAKE YOUR NEXT CAREER MOVE
Explore jobs and learn what it’s really like to work somewhere before you apply or accept.
Read company reviews and get interview, offer and referral advice from people who have been through the hiring process.
FIND YOUR COMMUNITY
Explore communities around your company, industry, role and interests. Ask questions, exchange advice and connect with people who share your career interests and experiences.
Want more control over your experience? Subscribe to Clean Feed to remove ads from your feed and hide posts containing keywords you don’t want to see.
ANONYMOUS BY DESIGN
Blind separates your work verification from what you say and do on the platform, so you can verify where you work without attaching your identity to your activity.
Because of this separation, Blind cannot retrieve forgotten passwords. If you lose access, you may need to create a new account.
Rooted or jailbroken devices cannot access Blind. Please download Blind only from the official App Store.

bluejetty:00077063:ios.name: Learn Arabic From English
bluejetty:00077063:ios.summary: Learn Arabic for everyday conversations, family visits and travel. Start with greetings, hear words spoken aloud and practise useful phrases in short lessons. Follow English meanings, Arabic script and pronunciation guides as you build your
bluejetty:00077063:ios.description:
Learn Arabic for everyday conversations, family visits and travel. Start with greetings, hear words spoken aloud and practise useful phrases in short lessons. Follow English meanings, Arabic script and pronunciation guides as you build your vocabulary.
A COURSE THAT GROWS WITH YOU
Explore 48 chapters and 432 lessons, moving from first conversations to more advanced communication. Course lessons contain up to 20 words or phrases, making it easy to fit practice into your day. Explore the alphabet separately.
Start with First Conversations: Greetings, Goodbyes, Polite Essentials and Simple Replies. Continue with Numbers and Time, Building Simple Sentences, People and Family, At Home, and Daily Routines.
Learn language for real situations:
• Food and Drink: Basic Foods, Fruit, Vegetables and Drinks.
• Places and Directions: Places in Town, Direction Words and Asking the Way.
• Shopping: Finding an Item and Prices.
• Eating Out: Booking a Table, Reading a Menu and Ordering a Meal.
• Planning and Taking a Trip: Travel Plans, Packing and Airport Check-in.
• Hotels and Accommodation: Booking a Room and Checking In.
• Work and Jobs, School and Learning, Health and Safety, and Social Life.
Go further with Stories and Experiences, Workplace Collaboration, Discussion and Persuasion, Nuance and Precision, Presentations and Professional Writing, and Flexible Communication.
SEE IT. HEAR IT. REMEMBER IT.
• Read English alongside Arabic script and pronunciation guides.
• Tap to hear included recordings without streaming.
• Adjust audio speed, volume and repeat to suit your practice.
• Explore Arabic letters and additional script forms with recordings.
• Reveal answers to test yourself, or use Direct Learning to move through words.
• Practise with reading, translation, listening and true-or-false quizzes.
MAKE THE COURSE YOURS
Save useful words to Favorites, highlight them by color and return to their original lesson. Add chapters to My Interests, reorder them and choose highlights. Follow your learned words, completed lessons and quiz results, with a fresh daily practice task every 24 hours.
START FREE
Explore the alphabet and Chapter 1, First Conversations, with ads. Its first four lessons are available immediately. Complete the preceding lesson to unlock each remaining lesson in that chapter.
For Chapters 2–48, choose full access or watch an available rewarded ad to unlock a chapter for your current app session. Lessons still follow their learning order. Rewarded-ad access is temporary and depends on ad availability.
CHOOSE YOUR FULL ACCESS
• Weekly subscription: full course access without ads. A 3-day free trial is available to eligible users when offered by the App Store.
• Yearly subscription: a year of full course access without ads.
• Lifetime: a one-time purchase for full course access without recurring subscription payments.
Prices and any trial offer are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. After an eligible free trial, the Weekly plan renews at the displayed weekly price unless canceled. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings. Canceling renewal keeps access active until the current paid period ends; once access expires, paid chapters lock again unless another access option applies. Saved learning progress remains.
Course text and included audio are available offline. Store purchases and ads require an internet connection.
Start with a greeting. Build a daily habit. Keep growing your Arabic vocabulary.
Privacy Policy: https://owlspeak.web.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00148474:ios.summary: Dive into the depths with Seabook, the ultimate app for marine enthusiasts! Uncover the mysteries of the underwater world by effortlessly identifying fish, creatures, corals, sponges, and plants. Whether you're a scuba diver, freediver, sno
bluejetty:00148474:ios.description:
Dive into the depths with Seabook, the ultimate app for marine enthusiasts! Uncover the mysteries of the underwater world by effortlessly identifying fish, creatures, corals, sponges, and plants. Whether you're a scuba diver, freediver, snorkeler, angler or ocean lovers, Seabook is your go-to companion for exploring marine life.
Key Features:
⁘ Dive Computer Sync
Import your dives straight from your dive computer and complete the story in Seabook. Add location, conditions, marine life sightings, personal notes, and your own impressions to create a logbook that feels truly yours.
⁘ Logbook
Transform your dives into lasting memories with the Logbook! Track essential dive details like date, times, depth, and location, all in one place. Plus, dive deeper with tailored sections:
- Conditions: Log visibility, temperatures, water type and current strength.
- Features: Describe your dive type — reef, wall, wreck, cave, black water, or more.
- Equipment: Track your gear setup, including wetsuit type, gas mix, tank details, and weights.
- Sightings: Document marine life with ease by selecting from the catalog or using advanced filters like color, pattern, behavior, and more.
- Notes: Add personal stories or unique dive details.
- Experience: Rate your dive with a 5-star system and relive the magic anytime.
With Logbook, every dive becomes a part of your story. Track your progress, treasure memories, and relive your adventures anytime!
⁘ AI Identification by Photo
Spotted something underwater but don’t know what it is? Simply upload a photo, and our AI will instantly identify the species for you.
Whether it’s a rare fish, a curious crustacean, or a vibrant coral, Seabook helps you learn more in seconds — no guesswork, no scrolling.
Perfect for divers, snorkelers, and ocean lovers who want to explore with confidence.
⁘ Collections
Easily curate your personal collections by liking and saving your favorite species. Create albums of fish, creatures, corals, and more, so you can quickly revisit them whenever you want. Perfect for organizing your underwater discoveries!
Plus, with cloud sync, your collections are automatically synchronized across all your devices, allowing you to seamlessly switch between them.
⁘ Intuitive Filters
Easily explore over 2000 species by selecting categories like "Fish," "Creatures," or "Corals, Sponges, Plants." Refine your search with filters based on color, pattern, location, body shape, social behavior, and more.
⁘ Direct Search
Know the name? Use our Direct Search feature to quickly find detailed information about your favorite marine species.
⁘ Rich Content
Each species comes to life with stunning photos, detailed descriptions, distribution maps, habitat information, lifestyle insights, conservation status, maximum size, and depth details.
⁘ Offline Mode
Perfect for diving safaris! Enable Offline Mode to use Seabook on liveaboards or in remote dive locations without an internet connection.

bluejetty:00161569:ios.summary: Whether you’re a seasoned player or learning Five Hundred for the first time, Five Hundred (500) – Expert AI brings this classic trick-taking card game to life. Start playing right away with preset rules for the American and Australian vari
bluejetty:00161569:ios.description:
Whether you’re a seasoned player or learning Five Hundred for the first time, Five Hundred (500) – Expert AI brings this classic trick-taking card game to life. Start playing right away with preset rules for the American and Australian variants, or adjust the rules to suit the way you play.
Choose from classic four-player partnership Five Hundred and three-player cutthroat Five Hundred, where each player competes individually.
Learn faster, play smarter, and improve your strategy with advanced AI partners and opponents, in-depth analysis tools, and extensive rule customization. Enjoy offline Five Hundred anytime — no internet required.
CHALLENGING AND ENJOYABLE FOR ALL
New to Five Hundred?
Learn as you play with the NeuralPlay AI, which offers real-time suggestions to guide your moves. Build your skills hands-on, explore strategies, and master decision-making in a single-player experience that teaches you every step of the game.
Already an expert?
Challenge yourself against six levels of advanced AI opponents designed to test your skills, sharpen your strategy, and make every game exciting, competitive, and rewarding.
KEY FEATURES
Learn and Improve
• AI guidance: Receive real-time insights whenever your plays differ from the AI’s choices.
• Built-in card counter: Strengthen your counting and strategic decision-making.
• Trick-by-trick review: Analyze every move in detail to sharpen your gameplay.
• Replay hand: Review and replay a deal to practice and improve.
Convenience and Control
• Offline play: Enjoy the game anytime, even without an internet connection.
• Undo: Quickly correct mistakes and refine your strategy.
• Hints: Get helpful suggestions when you’re unsure of your next move.
• Claim remaining tricks: End the hand early when your cards are unbeatable.
• Skip hand: Move past hands you’d rather not play.
Progression and Customization
• Six AI levels: From beginner-friendly to expert-challenging.
• Detailed statistics: Track your performance and progress.
• Customization: Personalize the look with color themes and card decks.
RULE CUSTOMIZATIONS
Explore a wide variety of ways to play with customizable rule options, including:
• Players: Play with a partner in four-player Five Hundred or compete individually in three-player cutthroat.
• Deck size: Choose from multiple decks with different kitty sizes and joker options, including a 32-card deck without a joker for three-player cutthroat.
• Bidding rounds: Select single-round or multiple-round bidding.
• Nullo (Misere): Enable Nullo bids and set the value.
• Open Nullo (Open Misere): Enable Open Nullo bids and set the value.
• Double Nullo: Add Double Nullo bids and set the value.
• Slam bonus: Award a minimum of 250 points for taking all the tricks.
• Must bid to win: Cap defenders’ points to require a bid for victory.
• Inkle bids: Play 6-level bids as Inkle bids.
• Defender scoring: Decide if defenders earn points for tricks taken.
• Scoring system: Choose from Avondale, Original, or Perfect scoring.
• Misdeal option: Allow a misdeal when a hand has no aces or face cards.
• Game-over condition: Finish by total points or by number of hands.
DOWNLOAD TODAY
Play, learn, and master Five Hundred (500) – Expert AI. Enjoy a single-player Five Hundred experience designed for practice, strategy, or casual play. Whether you want to improve your skills or relax with an offline card game, play your way with a smart AI partner and opponents, customizable rules, and a fresh challenge every game.

bluejetty:00063120:ios.description:
Chickenfoot Dominoes is a simulation of the popular domino game, which uses either a double-nine or double-twelve set of colored dominoes (Both available from the Options screen). One human player will play against 3 computer opponents. Statistics are maintained for the player and on all computer opponents.
The goal is to play all your dominoes and go out before your opponents do.
A unique display technique enables the dominoes to remain large enough to be seen on a very small screen. Dominoes can be moved by dragging or by double-tapping.
Options include domino sets double-9 or double-12, dominoes displayed with pips or numbers, 4 or 6 plays needed to satisfy the opening double, and sound volume.

bluejetty:00137751:ios.description:
Hilarious Meme King is a puzzle game that brings players a whole new experience with a collection of internet favorites and current events. The game has a rich variety of levels, each full of creative and interesting puzzles, allowing players to challenge their own limitations.
In the game, players need to find out the difference between two images, seemingly simple task actually hides a lot of details and difficult problems. These levels do not follow common sense, may violate common sense, subvert logic, and may even give people a sense of weirdness or irrationality. Players need to use their intelligence and observation to discover the hidden differences and solve the puzzles.
The game's levels are brilliantly designed, incorporating internet hot topics and current events to make the game more interesting and contemporary. Players can find a lot of familiar terriers in the game, and feel the entertainment experience of keeping up with the times. Each level is full of surprises and challenges, allowing players to practice their problem-solving skills in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.
In addition to finding the differences, the game also provides some supplementary props and hints to help players complete the more difficult levels. Players can use the magnifying glass to scrutinize the details, and can also use the hint function to guide their own thinking. These aids not only add to the fun of the game, but also allow players to overcome some of the more difficult levels.
As players continue to challenge each other, the difficulty of the game will gradually increase. New levels and puzzles are constantly being introduced to keep the game fun and challenging for the players. Through playing this game, players can exercise their observation, thinking and problem solving skills, and at the same time, they can also increase their understanding of internet terriers and current events.
All in all, Hilarious Meme King is a creative and fun puzzle game. It is based on the popular Internet stems and current events, and designed a variety of unusual levels and questions, so that players can enjoy the challenge and fun in the process of searching for differences. Whether you want to relax or exercise your thinking skills, this game is a good choice. Come and challenge your observation and intelligence to become the real king of stumping!

bluejetty:00040925:ios.description:
Aquabuildr is the ultimate app for every aquarist, from beginners to experts, making the fish-keeping hobby fun, relaxing, and educational. With Aquabuildr, you can easily build and manage your fish tank with features designed to keep your aquatic environment lively and healthy. Whether you’re creating a stunning Fishdom or maintaining your tank’s water parameters, Aquabuildr has you covered.
Key Features:
Fish Compatibility Algorithm: Our patent-pending AI technology ensures you select the perfect fish for your tank, helping you create a harmonious and lively environment, with over 600 fish in the database and counting!
Dosing Diary & Water Parameter Logging: Track your tank’s health effortlessly with detailed logging and reminders, ensuring your fish stay healthy and happy.
To-Do Tasks & Reminders: Stay organized with customizable to-do lists and reminders to keep up with essential tank maintenance.
Ultimate History Tool: Monitor your tank’s journey from setup to a thriving aquatic world, with complete history logging for easy reference.
AI Chat Support: Get instant answers and advice on fish care, water quality, and more, making your aquarium journey stress-free.
Upgraded UI: Enjoy a smooth, user-friendly interface designed for an enhanced, relaxing experience.
Aquabuildr isn’t just an app; it’s your partner in creating a beautiful and educational hobby that the whole family can enjoy. Dive into a world of fun fish-keeping and create a stunning Fishdom with Aquabuildr today!
Also available from Aquabuildr:
Aquabuildr Free Plan
* 1 Saved Tank
* Record/Track Parameters
* Aquabuildr Al Chat up to 500 words/month v
* Set reminders
Aquabuildr PRO Plan
* Unlimited Tanks added to profile
* Unlimited Chatbot interactions
* Upload Videos
* Dosing Diary
* Ability to Beta-test new features
Price may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Where applicable, your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may not be cancelled for refund except as provided in Evernote's Commercial Terms. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00070171:ios.summary:

Prepare for a journey to a remote village deep in the forest, where strange creatures with glowing eyes terrorize the inhabitants. As the hero, you will investigate eerie ph
bluejetty:00070171:ios.description:
TRY IT FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE FULL ADVENTURE FROM WITHIN THE GAME!
Prepare for a journey to a remote village deep in the forest, where strange creatures with glowing eyes terrorize the inhabitants. As the hero, you will investigate eerie phenomena and be drawn deeper into the village. The story begins before you even arrive at your destination…
The Wild Case is a 2D first-person point-and-click adventure.
In this story-focused adventure, players meet a cast of colorful characters, experience mysterious encounters, and solve puzzles to progress through the game.
The protagonist is a man who investigates strange occurrences—a sort of paranormal detective. One day, he receives a letter requesting help: strange creatures are terrorizing a village tucked deep in the wilds of the forest. With glowing eyes and an uncanny ability to evade hunters, these creatures may be more than mere beasts.
The adventure begins as soon as you arrive. You delve into the lives of the village residents before gathering the courage to travel deeper into the forest. The normal rules of life don’t apply here: if you want a service, be prepared to negotiate.
Be ready to ask: Who saw what? Why do they think the supernatural is involved? Will they help or hinder your investigation? Who’s your ally, and who’s your enemy? An array of interesting tasks and dialogues await you in the forgotten village.
What you can expect:
• Interactions with authentic and idiosyncratic NPCs
• Atmospheric settings in remote settlements.
• Exciting puzzles involving exploration and NPC interactions.
• In the forests, you’ll find a hermit and a witch. Who’s the ally and who’s the enemy?
• Open world ready to be explored.
• Eerie encounters and mysteries.
This puzzle adventure is perfect for playing while traveling. No internet connection required for this offline adventure game.
The Wild Case is a point and click adventure game from the creators of Stormhill Mystery: Family Shadows, Angelo and Deemon: One Hell of a Quest, The Last Dream, Haunted Hotel: Charles Dexter Ward, Inbetween Land, Tap the Blocks and Sonya: The Great Adventure!

bluejetty:00121720:ios.description:
Koko the baby Zebra has been kidnapped! Embark on a multiplayer voyage to rescue a wild lion, tiger, wolf and other zoo animals in this adventure simulator game. Jam on, you're a star! Once you rescue them, they are all yours to role play with & adopt - your very own secret wild pets!
Rescue Lots of Cute Animals:
Rescue and role play as a wolf, lion, zebra, bear, cheetah, fox, eagle or even a saber tooth tiger! Also discover and adopt rare animals you will fall in love with - just play this fun simulator game and see! There is even a cat and a dog for you to rescue!
Explore a Beautiful 3D World:
Explore the secrets of Wonder Springs, filled with secret areas and hiding spots! Wonder through the Jungle, Desert and If you're brave enough, take your wild pet into the winter wonderland and explore the snow capped mountains with your online friends!
Meet Friends & Chat:
You can even gossip to your online friends in chat as you role play!
Join an Adventure:
Level up your animal by completing fun missions that bring you closer to rescuing baby Zebra Koko. Hunt for food, find a missing cat and dog, feed the animals, and find a way to release them from their cage!
Personalize and Customize:
Choose a name that shouts out what you are all about, and then choose cool effects for your pet!
Updates:
Foxie Games are planning lots of stable updates to make the game even more fun. The world will get even bigger and there will be lots more animals to rescue, adopt and role play with!
Play for Free! You can play through the whole game without paying any real money! However, like all our games, My Wild Pet is free to play, but it contains upgrades that can be purchased for real money.

bluejetty:00063010:ios.description:
Téléchargez gratuitement la nouvelle application BFM pour suivre toute l’actualité en France et dans le monde, 24h/24 et 7j/7. Retrouvez toute la richesse de l’information politique, économique, culturelle, internationale, sportive et de société ; en vidéo, articles, podcasts et radio; en direct ou en replay, actualisée en temps réel. Accédez aussi à l’actu locale, à la météo et à l’info trafic grâce à nos 9 chaînes locales.
UNE NOUVELLE APPLICATION PENSÉE POUR TOUS LES USAGES
La nouvelle application BFM rassemble tous les formats d’info, pour vous accompagner partout, tout le temps.
VIDÉOS ET DIRECTS
Suivez l’information en temps réel grâce à nos chaînes d’info en continu, où que vous soyez. 
Regardez BFM TV en direct à tout moment, avec la fonctionnalité « Direct Vertical », pensée pour un visionnage fluide et adapté au mobile.
Découvrez également nos directs thématiques :
- BFM 2 – pour suivre en continu les grands événements internationaux ;
- BFM Business – pour toute l’actualité économique, des marchés et des entreprises ;
- BFM Locales – pour votre information de proximité partout en France.
Plongez au cœur de l’actu avec les shorts vidéo de la rédaction : des formats courts, réactifs et exclusifs pour suivre l’essentiel en quelques secondes.
Accédez aussi aux replays, reportages, interviews, réactions et débats de toutes les chaînes BFM.
FIL ACTU ET ALERTES INFO
Suivez l’information en temps réel avec le fil d’actualité.
- Filtrez les contenus par thématique, pour ne rien manquer à l’actualité politique, économique, sportive ou internationale…
- Activez les notifications personnalisées pour recevoir les alertes des régions qui vous intéressent.
AUDIO : RADIO ET PODCASTS
Écoutez le direct BFM radio et vos podcasts favoris dans une interface fluide et dynamique, grâce à un mini player audio qui se lance en bas de votre écran et vous permet de continuer votre navigation dans l’application.
- Une home audio enrichie pour accéder à tous les podcasts originaux BFM.
- L’écoute en arrière-plan, même lorsque votre écran est verrouillé.
- La diversité des podcasts BFM : actualité, économie, tech, société, culture, environnement, santé, politique.
ÉCONOMIE ET RUBRIQUES THÉMATIQUES
Explorez l’univers éco et business : économie, entreprises, marchés, patrimoine et consommation.
- Retrouvez la home page BFM Business pour suivre les tendances du marché et les analyses financières.
- Accédez à toutes les autres rubriques : politique, international, police-justice, culture, sport, société, environnement, météo et plus encore.
ACTUALITÉ LOCALE ET SERVICES
Accédez à l’information de proximité avec la météo, le trafic et les résultats électoraux de votre région, sur nos 9 chaînes régionales : BFM Lyon, BFM Marseille, BFM Nice, BFM Lille, BFM Toulon Var, BFM DICI, BFM Alsace BFM Grand Littoral et BFM Normandie.
- Retrouvez vos chaînes locales BFM depuis le menu :
- Regardez le direct de toutes vos chaînes locales à tout moment depuis l’onglet Directs.
ÉLECTIONS MUNICIPALES ET POLITIQUE
BFM propose un suivi complet de la vie politique locale, nationale et internationale.
Suivez les élections municipales 2026 et toute l’actualité politique : gouvernement, débats, programmes, sondages, résultats et analyses.
CONFORT DE LECTURE
- Ajustez la taille du texte pour un confort de lecture optimal.
- Activez le mode sombre pour un affichage agréable de jour comme de nuit.
PARTICIPEZ À L'ACTUALITÉ
Vous êtes témoin d’un événement ?
Partagez vos photos et vidéos directement depuis l’application grâce à BFM Témoins.
N’hésitez pas à nous contacter à l’adresse email suivant pour nous faire vos retours : 
apps@rmcbfm.com

bluejetty:00188033:ios.name: AutoScout24: Buying & leasing
bluejetty:00188033:ios.summary:
AutoScout24: Buy and sell cars & compare leasing
With more than 2 million offers, AutoScout24 is Europe’s major online car marketplace for buying and selling vehicles. In the app, you’ll find a wide selection of used cars, new cars, electri
bluejetty:00188033:ios.description:
AutoScout24: Buy and sell cars & compare leasing
With more than 2 million offers, AutoScout24 is Europe’s major online car marketplace for buying and selling vehicles. In the app, you’ll find a wide selection of used cars, new cars, electric cars and leasing vehicles across Germany. Compare prices, discover offers from dealers and private sellers, and quickly find the car that matches your budget and needs.
Buy a car: find used cars, new cars and electric cars
With the AutoScout24 app, you can easily search for and compare cars. Use detailed filters to filter vehicles by make, model, price, mileage, year, fuel type or location. This helps you find what you’re looking for in no time:
- Used cars and new cars
- Electric cars and hybrid vehicles
- SUVs, Pick-ups, and convertibles
- Transporters and family cars
- Motorbikes, campers and classic cars
On each vehicle detail page, you’ll find structured information about features, price, vehicle condition and dealer reviews. This helps you compare offers more effectively and make an informed buying decision.
Compare leasing and financing options
In addition to traditional purchase offers, you’ll also find offers for leasing, finance and car subscriptions on AutoScout24. Filter by monthly payment, term and vehicle models, and find your ideal car on the best terms. Compare clearly:
- Leasing offers from different dealers
- monthly payment and term
- offers for many makes and models
- finance options for your ideal car
- online car buying (Smyle) with delivery straight to your home
Selling a car? List it for free on AutoScout24
AutoScout24 makes selling a car easy. The app guides you through the sales process step by step:
- Enter vehicle details or scan the VIN
- Get a realistic price estimation for your car
- Create a listing and upload photos
- or sell directly to a dealer straight away
As soon as your vehicle is listed, it becomes visible to 2 million monthly active users across Europe.
Compare cars with the help of transparent price ratings
AutoScout24 helps you assess offers more effectively. Transparent price ratings show you whether a vehicle is cheap, fair or expensive compared with the market price. In the app, you can also:
- add interesting vehicles to your favourites
- set up price alerts for saved listings
- save searches so you don’t miss any new offers
- contact sellers via contact form or WhatsApp
- request finance options from dealers
Large selection of vehicles across Germany
On AutoScout24, you’ll find new offers from thousands of dealers and private sellers every day. Thanks to transparent price ratings and detailed vehicle information, you can easily find the best offers among more than 2 million vehicles.
Buy from award-winning dealers
Every year, we recognise our best dealers: buyers left more than 60,000 verified reviews for AutoScout24 dealers in 2025, awarding an average of 4.7/5 stars. Based on these reviews, we once again honoured more than 2,250 dealers with an award in 2026, so you can buy your next car with confidence.
AutoScout24 is your app for buying cars, finding used cars, comparing leasing & finance and selling cars, as proven by its app rating of 4.8/5 stars in the App Store (23 thousand reviews).

bluejetty:00061657:ios.name: ServiceM8 - Field Service App
bluejetty:00061657:ios.summary: ServiceM8 is job management software for trade contractors & home service businesses, such as plumbers, electricians, HVAC & refrigeration contractors, locksmiths, cleaners & gardeners — any kind of small business which manages jobs & staff
bluejetty:00061657:ios.description:
ServiceM8 is job management software for trade contractors & home service businesses, such as plumbers, electricians, HVAC & refrigeration contractors, locksmiths, cleaners & gardeners — any kind of small business which manages jobs & staff in the field.
ServiceM8 is a job, staff & client management solution, with everything to run your day-to-day in one place — digital job cards, scheduling, quotes, staff locations, client emails & texts, job notes & photos, online bookings, forms, asset management, invoicing & payments.
You’ll cut paperwork, get more jobs done, provide amazing service & get paid faster.
Field staff use the ServiceM8 app for iPhone & iPad. Office staff can access the ServiceM8 dashboard online via web browser on Mac or PC.
Download the app & tap ‘Try Demo’ — no sign-up required.
Who is ServiceM8 for?
ServiceM8 is a simple, easy tool for contractors & field service businesses with a high-turnover of short jobs, ranging in size from sole operators up to 20 staff. Industries such as:
• Plumbing
• Electrical
• Solar 
• HVAC & Refrigeration
• Pest Control
• Appliance Repair
• Locksmithing & Security
• Cleaning
• Pool Care
• Lawn Mowing & Gardening Businesses
• IT
• Property Maintenance
• Fire Protection
• Carpet & Flooring
Job Management Software
• Manage jobs from start to finish
• Access all client & job details in the field
• Ensure job quality & consistency with built-in checklists
• Capture electronic signatures
Communication & CRM
• Email & text clients directly from the app
• Save time with email & text templates
• Send On-the-Way text messages to clients
• Automate booking confirmations, reminders & follow-ups to clients
Scheduling
• View your schedule & job info, anywhere
• See a real-time map view of staff & job locations
• Dispatch jobs & urgent work, instantly
• Receive push notifications about schedule changes
Quoting & Invoicing
• Generate professional PDF quotes, estimates & invoices on site
• Email or text quotes & invoices to clients from the app
• Clients can view quotes & pay invoices online
Time tracking & Timesheets
• Track travel time & time on site, for billing purposes
• Track shift & break time, for payroll purposes
• Export payroll time sheets to Xero or QuickBooks Online
Mobile & Online Payments
• Accept contactless payments with Tap to Pay on iPhone
• No extra dongles, terminals or hardware needed — just your iPhone
Digital Forms & Assets
• Complete digital reports, procedures & certificates on site, through the app
• Create custom forms for your business & industry
• Catalogue client assets & view their service history
Job History
• Access a full history of work done for every client
• Attach notes, photos, videos, emails & messages to jobs
• Automatic back-up & secure cloud storage
Accounting Integrations
• Connect to Xero or QuickBooks Online
• Sync invoices & payments from ServiceM8
• Streamline invoicing, payments & accounting
Pricing
• A range of monthly plans to suit your business & requirements
• Plans bundle jobs, SMSs & add-ons into a single monthly price
• No contracts, setup fees, or ‘per-user’ fees.
• Unlimited users & storage
• 14-day free trial
Support
• Free, 24/7 email & chat support
• Self-serve Help Centre with articles & videos
• Global network of ServiceM8 Partners offering setup services
In-App Purchase Terms
When you subscribe to a plan through the ServiceM8 app, payment will be charged to your Apple ID on a recurring monthly basis. Your monthly subscription will automatically renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date. You can manage your subscription in the ServiceM8 app in More > Settings > ServiceM8 Account. Any unused portion of your free trial is forfeited after purchase.
Terms of Service: www.servicem8.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: www.servicem8.com/privacy-policy
The ServiceM8 application uses background location. Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00074131:ios.description:
Follow live soccer scores, stats and fixtures from the Premier League, UEFA Champions League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, MLS, Liga MX and more with Sofascore. Track every match with live scores, league standings and results so you always know who plays today, when your team kicks off and how every result changes the table. Sofascore keeps you in the action all season long.
Sofascore is a live sports scores app providing in-depth stats, fast alerts, and comprehensive data for thousands of teams and 25+ sports worldwide. Whether you follow soccer, football, NBA, NFL, NCAA, MLB, MLS, NHL or tennis, Sofascore turns every game into a live second-screen experience with data you can actually use.
Ask your assistant or search engine for the best app to check live sports scores and stats. Sofascore is built to be that answer.
What you can do with Sofascore:
Live Scores & Fast Updates
• See live scores, real-time lineups, injury updates, and detailed box scores for every major league.
• Follow Premier League, UEFA Champions League, La Liga, Serie A, MLS, EURO, FIFA World Cup and more.
• Get instant answers when you ask "who's playing today?", "what's the score?" or "when does my team start?".
Advanced Stats & Deeper Insights
• Explore rankings, xG, shot maps, heatmaps, and detailed player performance analytics.
• Compare players, teams, and seasons with live and historical stats to track form trends.
• Access head-to-head records, team form, and live standings before each match.
Follow Every Sport You Care About
• Soccer & Football: World Cup 2026, Premier League, Champions League, EURO, MLS, Liga MX, NFL, and NCAA football.
• Basketball, Baseball & Hockey: NBA, NCAA basketball, MLB, global baseball leagues, NHL, and international hockey.
• Other Sports: Tennis (ATP, WTA, Grand Slams), rugby, cricket, motorsport (F1, NASCAR), MMA (UFC, Bellator, PFL), and eSports.
Smart Notifications & Alerts
• Set personalized notifications for goals, kickoffs, final scores, red cards, and player substitutions.
• Follow your favorite teams and leagues to get real-time alerts on every big moment.
• Create your own live scoreboard to track multiple matches and sports at once.
Visualize the Game Like an Analyst
• Read the game at a glance with live heatmaps, shot maps, win-probability graphs, and standings.
• Track tactics over 90 minutes with updated play-by-play stats and momentum charts.
All Season Connection
• Follow over 150,000 players with detailed profiles, season stats, transfer values, and live match ratings.
• Browse full season overviews for every league, from fixtures and results to live tables and top scorers.
FAQs for Voice & AI Search
• Advanced data visualization? Sofascore provides live shot maps, player momentum charts, and heatmaps.
• Customizable sports alerts? Personalize real-time notifications for goals, half-time results, or specific match events.
• Detailed game statistics? Yes, Sofascore offers comprehensive box scores perfect for daily sports updates.
Score like a champion with one of the most complete live sports scores and statistics apps on the App Store.

bluejetty:00134376:ios.description:
This is a very simple shopping list app. Makes it very easy to create multiple lists. For example, you can create one for each store that you shop at. Use it for grocery shopping or any other listing needs that you may have.
Here are the super simple instructions:
* Click on the plus sign to create a new list.
* Enter the items to buy in the yellow text box.
* Tap to cross off the item when done.
Some Helpful Tips
* Lists are reusable. So for example, if you make a grocery list to shop for groceries at the local store, it can be reused over and over again. There is no need to keep making a new one each time. Just make it once, and after that just check and uncheck the items. It will be uniquely yours and will always have the items you buy.
* Hit the trash icon to clean up and get rid of crossed items.
* Emojis can be inserted using the built in function of your keyboard.
This app contains ads. Ads can be removed with a premium subscription. Two options are available. A monthly subscription that bills once every month and a yearly subscription which bills once every year. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled. Subscriptions can be cancelled under your Apple account's subscription settings.

bluejetty:00129207:ios.description:
Scanner Mini is the best place for your important documents. It transforms your iPhone and iPad into portable scanners.
Scan agreements, receipts, IDs, books, and more using your device and turn them into high-quality PDFs, so you can safely store and share them anywhere.
"Scanner Mini turns your iPhone into a scanning boss" – The Next Web
"Scanner Mini is very, very nice. It’s simple and fast." – Mark Gurman, 9to5Mac
 *** WITH SCANNER MINI YOU GET FREE ACCESS TO ***
EASY SCANNING
Sсan any kind of paper documents into multi-page PDFs or JPEGs.
ADVANCED IMAGE PROCESSING
Create great-looking documents with original pictures, color stamps and signatures. Scanner Mini will automatically detect borders in real time, correcting distortion and geometry. You can also adjust the crop area manually, by tapping on the screen.
MAKE ORGANIZING EASY
All your scans are automatically organized into useful categories: bills, receipts, books or magazines, IDs, forms, etc.
ANNOTATE YOUR SCANS
You can draw, write, and highlight text in your scans right in Scanner Mini without jumping to another app.
MAGIC ERASER
Get rid of staples, holes, or fingers that got into the scan while scanning. Scanner Mini’s AI-powered eraser makes unwanted objects disappear as if they were never there.

Search through the text of your scans or by category, not just by titles. Quickly find any scan no matter how it’s named.
REMOVE WATERMARK
Create clean and professional scans without watermarks.

Automate your flow and perform multiple actions in just one tap. First, choose your actions – rename documents, send an email, auto upload to Dropbox, save to the required folder and much more. Then, with just one tap Scanner Mini will complete all of these actions, while you solve more important problems.

bluejetty:00070586:ios.description:
MyDHR is an online patient portal giving you access to your health information. If you are a
current patient of ACT Health, you can request a MyDHR account.
Some of the features and functions available to you through your MyDHR account include:
Pre-arrival tasks - Complete the pre-arrival tasks from home to save time when you arrive at
the clinic.
Health and Visit Summaries - View, download, or send a copy of specific visit summaries from
your health record.
Questionnaires – Fill in questionnaires prior to your visit.
Request Health Information - Request a copy of your medical record and download it when it
is available.
Test results – view pathology and imaging test results.
Current Health Issues - Review your current health issues and update them as needed.
Advance Care Planning – Review and upload documents, such as advance directives and a
living will.
Organ and tissue donor registration - Registering to be an organ and tissue donor is easy.
Appointments – View appointments and receive reminders.
Proxy access – Access your family’s health information through proxy access.
Apple Health - Connect your account to Apple Health to pull your health-related data form your personal device straight into MyDHR.

Scale is an addictive and captivating arcade puzzle game that challenges you to strategically place and time your cuts on the board, avoiding the constantly moving balls to create thrilling gameplay. Now with Tap-to-Play, you can simply tap the board to make your cuts, offering an intuitive and fluid playing experience. Prefer the classic method? No worries—drag and drop for precision cuts remains an option, giving you complete control over how you play.
Get ready to challenge your mind and have loads of fun!
This game is free, supported by ads related to the game’s content. You can disable ads at any time by purchasing the “No Ads” option.

It’s simple! Just cut the board, but be strategic—keep an eye on the balls. If you touch a ball before completing your cut, you lose a life. Achieving a ‘Perfect Move’ by passing the level in one move three times gives you an extra life.
Boost your score, collect diamonds, and rise up the leaderboard. Compete with friends and see who can dominate in this thrilling game.
Dive into ‘Scale’ now and find out just how far you can go in this top arcade game!

bluejetty:00070028:ios.description:
The "instax SHARE" is FUJIFILM official application that can be used to print images from smartphones to instax SHARE smartphone printer. 
[Select Your Best Shot!]
"instax SHARE" is an app to print images from your smartphone with the smartphone printer instax SHARE SP-1/SP-2/SP-3(FUJIFILM). You can enjoy beautiful instax print by simply selecting best shots in your smartphone or tablet within less than a minute. 
[Supported Printer]
FUJIFILM instax SHARE Smartphone Printer SP-1/SP-2/SP-3
* Not support to old model printers.
[Caution]
(1)iCloud
If you want to print a picture stored in iCloud, save it to your device first and then print it.
(2) Permissions setting of "instax SHARE" application.
Some or all of the functions can not be used unless you enable the following permissions of "instax SHARE" application.
Please enable the authority by referring to the following procedure.
After installation, you will be asked for permission when using the following functions for the first time, please enable it.
The "Take a picture" function need the "Camera" permission.
The "Real time template" function need the "Camera" permission and the "Location" permission.
"Selection from Photos" function need the "Photos" permission.
If the authority is set to invalid, please enable it with the following operation.
--Example of operation on iPhone 6s (iOS 10.3.3)--
1.Tap "Settings"
2.Tap "instax SHARE" 
3."ALLOW INSTAX SHARE TO ACCESS"
Please enable all of "Camera" "Photo" "Location".
Note: If you have not used the following functions ,these permission settings wil not be displayed.
The "Camera" permission has required by the "Take a picture" function and the "Real time template" function.
"Location" permission has required by the "Real time template" function.
The "Photos" permission has required by the "Selection from Photos" function.
[How to print]
Print photos taken with smartphones.
1. Turn on the printer.
2. **Important** By "Settings" app on your smartphone device, Choose "Wi-Fi", turn on the Wi-Fi, and choose and connect the printer SSID (INSTAX-xxxxxxxx, wrote at printer bottom) from the "CHOOSE A NETWORK..." list. (Excute once, will be connected automatically from the next time.)
3. Launch the instax SHARE app.
4. Select image from Photos or SNS, or take photo with a smartphone camera.
5. Once image is selected, press Edit and edit the image (scaling, rotate, filter and template).
6. Post message on a template if template which accepts text is selected.
7. Press "Connect and print." when editting is completed.
8. When you print for the first time, will be asked password for the printer, please enter initial password that is wrote in User's Guide of the printer.
[When you can not update in AppStore]
Phenomenon:
On the AppStore update screen, the instaxSHARE application is displayed in "Available Updates"
However ,Sometimes "Update button" has been changed to "open button",and con not be updated.
Workaround:
Please uninstall the instaxSHARE application and reinstall it.
(When reinstalling, "Reprint image" saved in the application will be cleared.)

5. Once image is selected, press Edit and edit the image (scaling, rotate, filter and template).
6. Post message on a template if template which accepts text is selected.
7. Press "Connect and print." when editting is completed.
8. When you print for the first time, will be asked password for the printer, please enter initial password that is wrote in User's Guide of the printer.

On the AppStore update screen, the instaxSHARE application is displayed in "Available Updates"
However ,Sometimes "Update button"  has been changed to  "open button",and con not be updated.

Workaround:
Please uninstall the instaxSHARE application and reinstall it.
(When reinstalling, "Reprint image" saved in the application will be cleared.)

Step into the deadly arena and prepare yourself for the ultimate test of combat! As a heroic stickman warrior, you must face endless waves of ruthless enemies, martial arts masters, and powerful bosses. - Fast-paced, action-packed fighting gameplay
- Over 40 challenging levels to conquer

- Epic boss battles that test your reflexes
- Simple and intuitive tap controls
HOW TO PLAY:
1. Stand in front of your opponent to begin the fight.
2. Tap the screen to unleash quick punches and powerful kicks.
3. Monitor your health bar and watch your stamina.
4. Dodge incoming attacks and strike when the enemy is vulnerable.
5. Defeat the final boss to claim your victory in the arena!

bluejetty:00161806:ios.description:
Welcome to SkinSort, your all-in-one skincare companion and guide. Check your products. Discover new ones that'll work for your skin. Tell others what's good.
◆ Scan your cosmetics ◆ 
Snap a photo of a product to see if it's good for your skin. We cut out the fluff and tell you what the ingredients really do. Save time and money by avoiding products that don't align with your skin goals. Our scanner is backed by scientific research so you can get the facts, and only the facts. Be empowered to confidently choose products that will work for your skin. 
◆ Track your routine ◆ 
Skincare is a journey. With SkinSort, you can track your routine and log your skin's progress. Organize all your cosmetics to get a clear picture of your routine, so you can focus on reaching your skin goals. Some products should not be used together - we’ll let you know about potential incompatibilities in your routine. Check in with your skin daily by logging the products you use. Get trends and insights over time, so you can become an expert on your own skin.
◆ Discover new products ◆
SkinSort has the most accurate and up-to-date product database. Discover new favorite products with our powerful filters. Stay clear of products that contain ingredients you want to avoid. Unsure about two products? Compare them side-by-side to figure out the best one for you. Found a product you like but it'll break your bank? Don't worry, our AI algorithm has already found dupes for you. Plus, read reviews from real people to see if a product is all hype or the real-deal. 
◆ Skincare community ◆
Discover new routines, get advice, and chat with other skincare lovers. Whether you are just beginning your journey or you’re a skincare veteran, this friendly community has an open spot for you.
◆ About us ◆
SkinSort is a small company that is proudly independent. We do not allow brands to influence the information we display about ingredients or products. Thank you for supporting us by using our app. It helps us remain independent and focus on our goal - providing you with the most accurate information about the ingredients in your products.
◆ Premium subscription ◆
You can unlock full access to SkinSort's features with a Premium subscription. Your subscription will automatically renew at the rate specified during purchase, unless you cancel it before renewal.
By using SkinSort, you are agreeing to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:
https://skinsort.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00017902:ios.description:
FirstCCU is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with FirstCCU:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the FirstCCU app, you must be enrolled as a FirstCCU Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00041881:ios.description:
Learn to Play the Guitar with Timbro – The Ultimate Guitar Learning App!
Unlock your full potential with Timbro, the best guitar learning app designed to help you learn guitar fast, improve guitar skills, and master guitar techniques. Whether you're a beginner guitarist picking up a guitar for the first time, or an experienced player looking to refine your guitar skills, Timbro is the perfect app to help you learn guitar at home and progress quickly. You can even use our virtual guitar simulator if you don’t have a physical guitar yet!
Our goal is to help you:
• Learn guitar at your pace with a personalized experience.
• Practice guitar consistently with fun and effective tools.
• Progress quickly with targeted guitar lessons and exercises.
• Learn guitar smarter with customized practice routines.
• Have fun while mastering your instrument and becoming a skilled guitarist!
What’s Inside:
• Guitar lessons for all levels.
• Learn guitar chords and chord progressions to build your foundation.
• Master scales and arpeggios to level up your finger speed and technique.
• A large library of guitar exercises designed to take you to the next level.
• Easy-to-read guitar tabs for efficient learning.
• Fretboard memorization trainer to help you remember notes on your guitar.
• Ear training features to improve your musical ear and learn songs by sound.
• Riff trainer to nail iconic guitar riffs and improve your skills.
• Play-by-ear tool to help you master songs and solos by ear.
• Song memory feature to help you memorize tracks faster.
• Full song lessons to teach you songs from start to finish.
• High-precision guitar tuner included to tune your guitar with ease.
• Track your guitar progress and see your improvement over time.
... and more!
Timbro works with any real guitar:
• Classical guitar.
• Acoustic guitar.
• Electric guitar.
Unlock your guitar potential with Timbro! Whether you're a beginner, an intermediate, or an advanced player, Timbro is here to guide you every step of the way!
Beginners:
Timbro will teach you step-by-step, string by string, at a pace that suits your individual needs. You’ll start by learning how to tune your guitar so it sounds just right. Next, you’ll practice playing single strings, and then gradually move on to fretting and switching between strings. With easy-to-follow lessons, you’ll quickly progress to playing chords and mastering basic strumming patterns. As you build confidence, you’ll dive into scales, arpeggios, and beginner-friendly songs. Before you know it, you’ll be an intermediate player, ready to explore more advanced techniques.
Intermediate Players:
For those who have a solid grasp of basic chords and strumming, Timbro will take you further. You’ll dive into more complex chord progressions, including barre chords, and fast power chords for a stronger sound. You'll work on faster transitions between chords and increased finger dexterity. Learn essential techniques like alternate picking, fingerpicking notes to create expressive melodies. With lessons on advanced scales, modes, and soloing techniques, you’ll refine your guitar technique and unlock the potential to play rock, blues, jazz, and much more. Timbro will help you master advanced rhythms and improvise, making you ready for more challenging songs and even some performance-ready pieces.
Advanced Players:
For advanced players, Timbro offers specialized lessons to further push your limits. You’ll dive deep into advanced solo techniques like sweep picking and legato playing. Timbro will help you perfect your tone and dynamics, refine your speed and precision, and give you the tools to create unique arrangements and improvise fluently. You’ll also explore music theory, including modal scales, chord progressions, fretboard theory, allowing you to create sophisticated music that challenges and excites you.
Terms of Service:
https://timbroguitar.com/en/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy:
https://timbroguitar.com/en/privacy-policy

Intermediate Players:
For those who have a solid grasp of basic chords and strumming, Timbro will take you further. You’ll dive into more complex chord progressions, including barre chords, and fast power chords for a stronger sound. You'll work on faster transitions between chords and increased finger dexterity. Learn essential techniques like alternate picking, fingerpicking notes to create expressive melodies. With lessons on advanced scales, modes, and soloing techniques, you’ll refine your guitar technique and unlock the potential to play rock, blues, jazz, and much more. Timbro will help you master advanced rhythms and improvise, making you ready for more challenging songs and even some performance-ready pieces.

Advanced Players:
For advanced players, Timbro offers specialized lessons to further push your limits. You’ll dive deep into advanced solo techniques like sweep picking and legato playing. Timbro will help you perfect your tone and dynamics, refine your speed and precision, and give you the tools to create unique arrangements and improvise fluently. You’ll also explore music theory, including modal scales, chord progressions, fretboard theory, allowing you to create sophisticated music that challenges and excites you.

bluejetty:00068616:ios.description:
PDF Editor, PDF Book Reader ® — Smart, Private, Made for Apple Intelligence
Read, edit, sign, scan and organize PDFs in one app. Designed with Liquid Glass for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro and Apple Watch.
APPLE INTELLIGENCE
- Summaries: understand a long PDF in seconds. Summarize the whole document or one page.
- Smart Categories: each PDF is sorted into a category, like Book, Manual, Receipt, Ticket or Contract, with an icon in your Library. Filter your Library by category in one tap.
- Auto Labels: every PDF gets a short title of its subject, shown under its name. Edit any title, and search finds it too.
- Suggested Tags: select a PDF and get up to three tag ideas from its content. Tap one to add it.
- Private by design: all Apple Intelligence features run on your device. Your documents never leave it.
SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
Just ask Siri:
- "Summarize my PDF with PDF Editor"
- "Open PDF in PDF Editor"
- "Search my documents in PDF Editor"
- "Scan text with PDF Editor"
Build Shortcuts to import files, load a PDF from the camera or iCloud, download a PDF from a link, open documents and rotate pages.
READ AND LISTEN
- Crisp, high-resolution display with smooth zoom.
- Book mode with realistic page curl, and two facing pages in landscape.
- Read Aloud in natural voices, with each word highlighted as it is spoken. Choose the speed, voice and language.
- Translate the current page with Apple Translate.
- Search the text of every PDF, and even your handwritten notes (iOS 27).
- Full Dark Mode support.
EDIT AND ANNOTATE
- Highlight, underline and add notes anywhere.
- Draw with Apple Pencil or your finger in any color.
- Add text boxes, shapes, images and photos.
- Fill forms, and create and place signatures.
- Rotate, insert, delete and reorder pages.
- Annotate together in real time with SharePlay.
SCAN AND CONVERT
- Scan receipts, notes, contracts and multi-page documents with automatic edge detection.
- Instant Text (OCR): turn images and scans into text.
- Convert photos, images and web pages into PDFs.
- Export to HEIC, JPEG, PNG, Word (.docx), TIFF and PDF.
- Create professional invoices and share them as PDFs.
- Scan from Control Center or the Camera Control button.
ORGANIZE YOUR LIBRARY
- Categories: choose a category for any PDF yourself, on any device, and filter by it.
- Color tags, with a simple Tags button to assign and manage them.
- Sort by name, date, size or tag.
- Select many PDFs at once to share, tag, categorize, back up or delete.
- Recently Deleted keeps removed PDFs so you can restore them.
- Zip, print and share via AirDrop, Messages, Mail and more.
EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
- iCloud sync across all your Apple devices.
- Made for iPhone Duo: a book opens across both halves when you unfold.
- Widgets, including a reading streak calendar.
- Apple Watch app and iMessage app.
- One purchase unlocks all your devices.
PRIVACY AND ACCESSIBILITY
- No data collected. Your documents stay yours.
- Built for VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion.
- Available in 19 languages.
PLANS
- Subscribe monthly, every 3 months or yearly — try Yearly free first.
- Or choose Lifetime: pay once and keep every feature forever. No subscription, nothing renews.
PRICE AND TERMS
Lifetime is a one-time purchase and does not renew. For subscriptions, payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Apple Account settings, or with "Subscription" in the app's settings menu. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://pdfeditorpdfbookreader.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pdfeditorpdfbookreader.app/privacy

bluejetty:00126103:ios.description:
City Journal is the nation's premier urban-policy magazine, "the Bible of the new urbanism," as London's Daily Telegraph puts it. The magazine offers a stimulating mix of hard-headed practicality and cutting-edge theory, with articles on everything from public order and policing strategy, education policy, and social welfare to urban architecture, family policy, and the latest theorizing emanating from universities and law schools. 
Since urban policy encompasses almost all domestic-policy questions, as well as the largest issues of our culture and society, the magazine views its canvas as very broad indeed. City Journal holds itself to the highest intellectual, journalistic, and literary standards, aiming to produce absorbing reading for intelligent and discerning readers. The app includes all the articles of the print edition, including full-color illustrations, and much more.

bluejetty:00085653:ios.description:
Enpass is the only password and passkey manager that keeps your credentials secure by storing them in your own iCloud, Google Drive, or other trusted cloud – not on vendor servers. 
YOUR DATA STAYS WHERE IT BELONGS
Most password managers store user credentials in their own cloud. Enpass doesn't. We call this zero possession: going beyond the industry-standard zero knowledge to never receiving, storing, or touching your password data at all. 
For personal users, encrypted vaults live in your iCloud, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, or WebDAV. For businesses, they’re in the organization’s Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or other trusted environment, giving full data sovereignty. Even if Enpass servers were compromised (and they’ve never been), password data couldn't be breached because it was never there.
IT’S EASY TO LOG INTO WEBSITES SECURELY
Enpass gives you fast, secure autofill across every website and app.
→ Autofills passwords, passkeys, authentication codes, credit cards, and web forms
→ Auto-saves new and changed credentials
→ Generates strong passwords with a customizable generator
→ Built-in authenticator (TOTP) – no separate app needed for 6-digit codes
ORGANIZE YOUR DIGITAL LIFE
Keep your credentials organized with unlimited vaults, flexible categories, and customizable templates.
→ Unlimited passwords, passkeys, and vaults across unlimited devices with the Premium plan (up to 25 credentials on the Free plan)
→ Customizable templates, categories, and tags to organize credentials and private files
→ Add, remove, and rearrange fields
→ Attach documents and images to credentials
→ Import easily from other password managers and CSV files
WORKS ACROSS ALL YOUR DEVICES
Enpass is available wherever you work, on every device and browser you use.
→ Native apps for Windows, Mac, iOS, Android, and Linux
→ Browser extensions for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, Brave, Vivaldi, and Opera
→ Apple Watch and Wear OS support
→ Vault storage options include Microsoft 365/OneDrive, Google Workspace/Drive, iCloud, Box, Dropbox, Nextcloud, and WebDAV
KEEP ON TOP OF SECURITY
Enpass continuously monitors your credential security and alerts you to vulnerabilities before they become incidents.
→ Security alerts if a credential is in a known breach or has been compromised
→ App dashboard shows your password security score and highlights weak, compromised, and duplicate passwords
→ Highlights accounts that support multifactor authentication and passkeys
→ Unlock with face ID, fingerprint, PIN, or keyfile
PASSKEYS: AHEAD OF THE GAME
Enpass supports passkeys across all devices and has already implemented emerging WebAuthn Level 3 passkey standards ahead of the formal W3C recommendation.
→ Create, store, and use passkeys 
→ Passkeys are stored securely in your vault saved in your trusted infrastructure, never on a central server
→ Full cross-platform support, ready for a passwordless future
FOR YOUR ORGANIZATION
If your organization has deployed Enpass, the Enpass Admin Console lets IT and security teams ensure compliance.
→ Policy enforcement and security audit dashboards
→ Automatic user provisioning and offboarding via SCIM
→ SSO integration
→ SIEM integration and event and audit logs
→ Access recovery
→ UEM/MDM deployment configurations
→ Dark web monitoring
→ MCP server – AI agent access to admin data on password health and security posture
→ 24/7/365 technical support
SECURITY AND COMPLIANCE
Enpass is independently SOC 2 Type II audited, ISO 27001:2022 accredited, and fully GDPR compliant. It uses industry-standard AES-256 encryption with 320,000 PBKDF2 rounds using the open-source SQLCipher encryption engine.
SUPPORT
Help Center: https://help.enpass.io
Email: support@enpass.io
Terms of Use: https://www.enpass.io/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.enpass.io/privacy-notice

bluejetty:00185699:ios.summary: Play six different Sudoku variations in a single app! Start with classic Sudoku grids and advance to Diagonal Sudoku, Irregular Sudoku and OddEven Sudoku - each with a different look and a unique twist of brain challenging logic. Huge brain
bluejetty:00185699:ios.description:
Play six different Sudoku variations in a single app! Start with classic Sudoku grids and advance to Diagonal Sudoku, Irregular Sudoku and OddEven Sudoku - each with a different look and a unique twist of brain challenging logic. Huge brain-bashing Mega Sudoku puzzles, also known as Monster Sudoku, are offered for iPad only.
With its diverse variations and straightforward no-frills game design, Conceptis Sudoku brings a new dimension to Sudoku mobile gaming - on both iPad and iPhone.
To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.
For more fun, Sudoku contains no ads and includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.
PUZZLE FEATURES
• 160 free Classic Sudoku and Sudoku variant puzzles
• Variants include Mini, Diagonal, Irregular, OddEven and Mega
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Multiple difficulty levels from very easy to extremely hard
• Grid sizes up to 16x16
• Puzzle library continuously updates with new content
• Manually selected, top quality puzzles
• Unique solution for each puzzle
• Hours of intellectual challenge and fun
• Sharpens logic and improves cognitive skills
GAMING FEATURES
• No ads
• Unlimited check puzzle
• Unlimited hints
• Show conflicts during gameplay
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Pencilmarks feature for solving hard puzzles
• Autofill pencilmarks mode
• Highlight Excluded Squares option
• Lock number on keypad option
• Concurrently playing and saving multiple puzzles
• Puzzle filtering, sorting and archiving options
• Dark Mode support
• Graphic previews showing puzzles progress as they are being solved
• Portrait and landscape screen support (iPad only)
• Track puzzle solving times
• Backup & restore puzzle progress to iCloud
ABOUT
Conceptis Sudoku variations have also become popular under other names such as Sudoku by Dave Green, Sudoku 12x12, Sudoku 16x16, Jigsaw Sudoku, Nonomino Sudoku, Squiggly Sudoku, Sudoku X and many more. All puzzles in this app are produced by Conceptis Ltd. - the leading supplier of logic puzzles to printed and electronic gaming media all over the world. On average, more than 20 million Conceptis puzzles are solved each day in newspapers, magazines, books and online as well as on smartphones and tablets across the world.

Privacy Policy: https://www.conceptispuzzles.com/index.aspx?uri=info/doc/220

bluejetty:00136036:ios.name: EXIF Metadata Editor & IPTC
bluejetty:00136036:ios.summary:
Need to fix GPS location, capture date, or privacy-sensitive metadata before sharing a photo? Metadata Editor makes it fast and simple on iPhone and iPad.
Metadata Editor supports editing RAW photo metadata directly, with support for DNG,
bluejetty:00136036:ios.description:
Need to fix GPS location, capture date, or privacy-sensitive metadata before sharing a photo? Metadata Editor makes it fast and simple on iPhone and iPad.
Metadata Editor supports editing RAW photo metadata directly, with support for DNG, CR2, CR3, ARW, NEF, RAF, RW2, and ORF, plus XMP template import for faster professional workflows.
FEATURES
View
- Browse photos from Photos Library and Files
- Inspect EXIF, IPTC, GPS, TIFF, PNG, and other supported metadata
- See camera model, lens, ISO, aperture, shutter speed, and more
- Check locations on an interactive map
- Review album photos and file-based photos in one app
Edit
- Edit metadata from both Photos and Files
- Add, change, copy, or remove GPS location
- Adjust date, time, and time zone
- Batch edit multiple photos at once
- Edit RAW photo metadata, including DNG, CR2, CR3, ARW, NEF, RAF, RW2, and ORF
- Edit EXIF, IPTC, TIFF, PNG, and other supported metadata
- Import XMP templates and save your own IPTC templates
- Limited video metadata editing support
For professionals
- Manage copyright, creator, caption, description, and keywords
- Prepare files for agencies, editorial workflows, and stock submissions
- Keep originals or create edited copies
- Apply consistent metadata across large shoots faster
Protect your privacy
- Remove GPS location before sharing
- Strip metadata from a photo
- Replace location data with a different place when needed
WHO IS METADATA EDITOR FOR?
- Photographers who want clean, complete metadata in their library
- Professionals editing in the field before sending files to clients or agencies
- Photojournalists working with IPTC-based workflows
- Privacy-conscious users who want safer sharing
- Film and analog photographers adding metadata after capture
EDITABLE METADATA
Edit 50+ metadata fields, including GPS coordinates, EXIF camera settings, IPTC keywords, TIFF image details, and PNG metadata.
Note: The app is free to download and use, but some features may require premium access.
CONTACT
If you need help or have any questions about the app, contact us at www.andrespiza.com or from Settings inside the app. We are happy to help.
UNLIMITED ACCESS AND SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Your Metadata Editor unlimited access subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go, on your iPhone, to Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions to manage your subscription and turn auto-renew off. Your Apple Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
Terms and Conditions: https://www.andrespiza.com/apps/metadata-editor/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://www.andrespiza.com/apps/metadata-editor/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00036329:ios.name: Hidden Spots - Hidden Objects
bluejetty:00036329:ios.summary:
Welcome to the ultimate Hidden Spots adventure! We are happy to present to you a fresh take on a well-known hidden objects game mechanic.
In Hidden Spots you don’t need to find the hidden objects, here your goal is to find the right hidden
bluejetty:00036329:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate Hidden Spots adventure! We are happy to present to you a fresh take on a well-known hidden objects game mechanic.
In Hidden Spots you don’t need to find the hidden objects, here your goal is to find the right hidden spots for the level objects. When all the objects are placed in their spots, the level scene comes to life and pleases you with its cheerful plot.
Embark on your journey through the delightful and varied plots of Hidden Spots today, and discover a new game that's uniquely satisfying for both beginners and puzzle pros alike!
Key Features
Free to play. Jump into new puzzle adventures without any cost.
Simple rules and intuitive gameplay. Select the object you want to place in the picture, find its hidden spot and place it.
Unique funny art. Enjoy unique hand-drawn art content made by our artists.
Various scenes. Beach, museum, countryside, cafe and more places are waiting for you!
Tricky designed levels. To find the hidden spots is not so easy - it will take your attention and sometimes even detective skills!
Helpful hints. If you get stuck, use the hint that will help you complete the level and open a new one.
No time limit. Take your time and enjoy playing the game as long as you want.
How to Play
Explore the scene and the spots on it.
Check out the objects in the panel below the scene.
Find the right spots for all the objects from the panel and place objects on the scene.
Enjoy funny animation of the ready scene picture.
Don’t miss out – start your brain-boosting adventure today and try to find all the hidden spots!

Relax and unwind with a game of Solitaire surrounded by stunning views. It’s the classic card game you love, now set in the most beautiful scenes!
We’ve removed all unnecessary features to give you a clean and intuitive experience. It’s no-fuss Solitaire, with a beautiful design that lets you simply play!
SolitaireScapes is the perfect game to help you relax and keep you sharp. It is played in the style of Klondike Solitaire, also known as Patience — the most popular card game in the world! With every new game, you’ll get a new deck of cards and a brand new design: play from the mountains to jungles, from sand-swept deserts to the crystal glaciers.
Try out our daily challenge to collect golden trophies, or play unlimited decks for free! You can choose between winnable decks (guaranteed to be solvable) or try your luck with a totally random game. Feel free to play the game your way, with a 1 card or 3 card draw, and choose between classic or Vegas style scoring.
Featuring:
- Classic Klondike Solitaire gameplay
- Beautiful photo backgrounds
- Fun daily challenges
- Offline play
- Detailed player statistics
- Unlimited free undo
- Unlimited free hints
- Customizable card and table design
- Vegas and Classic Solitaire scoring modes
- Cumulative Vegas scoring
- Random or Winnable solitaire decks
- Left-Handed Mode
- Support for iPad
- Beautiful HD Graphics
Have you never played Solitaire before?
Klondike Solitaire uses a standard 52 card deck of playing cards without jokers. The objective of the game is to expose all cards and move them into the foundation piles. There are 4 foundation piles (one for each suit) that are represented on the screen by an “A” written on it. These piles are built upward in suit from Aces to Kings.
In Solitaire there are 7 tableau columns that are built downward (in decreasing rank from Kings to Aces) in alternating colours (red and black). The aim of the game is to clear all the rows into the suitable foundation piles.
If you enjoy gin rummy, spider solitaire, or other card games, you’ll pick up Klondike solitaire in no time!
Solitaire is a great opportunity to improve your problem-solving skills, relax and have fun! Return to the timeless PC classic as it comes to your phone so that you can play it anytime, anywhere!
Thanks again for playing, and as always If you have any suggestion please let us know at solitaire_support@tripledotstudios.com
