bitFlyer is the official app of a JFSA-registered cryptocurrency exchange. Buy and sell crypto like Bitcoin and Ethereum from just 1 yen. Open an account in 9 minutes and trade the same day.*2
Why choose bitFlyer?
1. Buy from just 1 yen. Pick an asset, enter an amount, and go at your pace.

- bitFlyer Recurring Buy: Auto-buys from small amounts daily, weekly, or monthly
- Earn Bitcoin: Get Bitcoin through eligible services
- V-POINT Exchange: Convert your V-POINT to Bitcoin
- bitFlyer Credit Card: Earn Bitcoin cashback rewards
- Lending / Staking: Utilize your assets to receive lending fees or staking rewards*4
6. Pro Trading on bitFlyer Lightning with charts and order book data, backed by Japan's No. 1 Bitcoin volume.*1 Small buys to advanced trading, all in one place.
Apple Watch support

bluejetty:00165607:ios.description:
Are you ready to finally quit weed and take control of your life? Want to stop smoking for good or maybe just take a tolerance break?
Grounded is the quit weed tracker that helps you stay weedless, take a tolerance break, and manage cravings and cannabis withdrawal with confidence. It gives you the tools to stop smoking and live a healthy lifestyle. Start your quitting journey today with the quit tracker that works!
TAKE BACK CONTROL WITH A QUIT WEED TRACKER
Grounded is more than a basic quitting app. It’s built for people who want to stop smoking apps style, manage cravings, and track progress with a days clean tracker. If you feel you have a weed addiction or are just curious about how a weed tolerance break can help, this THC tracker makes it simple to log your journey, record your urges in a weed journal, and watch your quit counter grow. Along the way, you’ll notice benefits like better focus and money saved, keeping your motivation high.
MANAGE WEED WITHDRAWAL AND CRAVINGS
One of the hardest parts of weed quitting is the first few days. Grounded helps by showing what to expect, tracking progress with a sobriety counter, and guiding you through via an urge tracker. It’s not only about how to quit smoking, it’s about creating healthier habits, reducing marijuana dependence, and enjoying a clearer mind.
PERFECT FOR TOLERANCE BREAKS AND WEED BREAKS
Not everyone wants to quit smoking cannabis forever. Some just want to take a weed break, cleanse their system, and reset their tolerance. Grounded supports every approach: use it as an abstinence counter for a short tolerance break or as a system to quit addiction for good. By tracking your clean time counter and sober day counter, you’ll always know your progress. Choose your path—whether that’s weedless living, a reset, or simply staying in control with a reliable weed app.
TRACK CLEAN TIME WITH SOBRIETY CLOCKS
Your progress matters. Grounded offers detailed sobriety clocks and clean time counters so you always know how long you’ve been weed-free. This days clean tracker isn’t just numbers on a screen—it’s motivation to keep going. Every milestone builds confidence and shows you can stop smoking weed, overcome cravings, and move forward.
A COMPLETE WEED QUITTING AND BAD HABIT BREAKER APP
Grounded is more than just a cannabis tracker. It’s a tool for people tired of bong weed habits or being addicted to ganja. If you’ve tried to quit smoking weed before, you know how tough cravings can be. With Grounded, you get a quit tracker that doubles as a weed journal and bad habit tracker. It supports you through weed detox, helps you understand triggers, and keeps you grounding your focus on your goals. We provide a supportive environment that stays anonymous, focusing purely on your recovery.
QUIT SMOKING CIGARETES, VAPING, TOLERANCE BREAK AND MORE
Many people who use cannabis also want to quit vaping. Grounded supports you if you want to stop smoking weed, cut down on cigarettes, or quit vaping tracker style. Built as a quit weed tracker, it also works as a quit vaping app, helping you break bad habits and track clean time.
DOWNLOAD OUR APP TODAY and take control with the quit weed tracker built to support your recovery. From a tolerance break to a weedless lifestyle, Grounded helps you manage cravings, track sober days, and quit smoking cannabis.

**Mom’s Choice GOLD Award**
**500K+ Parents Rate ABCmouse 5 Stars**
**National Parenting Product Award Winner 2025**
FREE LEARNING ACTIVITIES FOR KIDS AGES 2–8
Play ABCmouse FREE with a daily curated collection of engaging learning games, read-to-me books, videos, songs, puzzles, and art activities.
 • Daily Curated Content: Every day holds new learning opportunities with a select collection of engaging learning activities in reading, math, science, music, art, social studies, and more
• Designed by Learning Experts: Backed by research, each activity is crafted with specific learning objectives in mind
UNLIMITED ACCESS WITH ABCMOUSE PREMIUM
Upgrade to access 13,000+ learning activities, brand new play areas, and other features
• Unlimited Access to ALL Learning Areas: hundreds of hours of educational activities in math, reading, social studies, science, art, music, and more
• Personalized Step-by-Step Learning Path: Encourages independent or guided, personalized learning.
• Learning through Play: From social emotional learning to spatial reasoning to coding basics, ABCmouse offers learning through creative play areas
• Safe Learning Environment: 100% ad-free. Earned the kidSAFE+ COPPA Seal as a COPPA-compliant program
• Tickets and Rewards System: Designed to motivate toddlers and kids to complete activities
No wifi, no problem. Once installed, ABCmouse works offline on your device, so learning can continue on road trips, flights, or anywhere without a connection.
EARLY LEARNING CURRICULUM
Engaging educational activities tailored for preschool and kindergarten learners in key academic subjects, including:
• Reading: Spans the entire range of early reading and includes phonics activities, letter recognition, parts of speech, and more
• Math: Teaches numbers, addition and subtraction, shapes, patterns, measurements, and more through fun games and creative activities
• Social Studies: Enriches understanding on history, geography, symbols, holidays, and cultures of the world
• Science: Sparks curiosity about the world, health, space, and more through live action experiments, videos, and kid-friendly animation
• Arts and Colors: Drawing and painting gives children the opportunity to use lines, shapes, and colors to create original works of art
• Music: Rhyme, repetition, and catchy tunes help reinforce important subjects and concepts

 "On ABCmouse my children are learning to read, they're doing math problems, social studies, science, everything.”
—Elementary School Teacher

—First Grade Teacher and mother of 5-year-old girls

bluejetty:00074021:ios.name: Cross Clip: Edit, Post, Grow
bluejetty:00074021:ios.summary:
Cross Clip is the easiest way for live streamers to turn Twitch, Kick clips, and other short videos into content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and other platforms. 
One of the most effective ways to grow your channel and gain viewers is
bluejetty:00074021:ios.description:
Cross Clip is the easiest way for live streamers to turn Twitch, Kick clips, and other short videos into content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and other platforms. 
One of the most effective ways to grow your channel and gain viewers is to post content across multiple platforms, but layouts and orientations are fundamentally different when you’re live streaming. Cross Clip makes it easy to post your content across multiple platforms and gives your channel the best opportunity to reach more viewers and grow your audience.
GET CLIPS
Head to crossclip.streamlabs.com to get started. Either enter the URL of the Twitch clip you would like to use or upload the video file. Once imported, you’ll be taken to the editor.
EDIT
Select a preset layout or start from scratch. You can add and rearrange layers, clip your videos, and drag content boxes around the screen. When you’re finished, just click compile.
OPTIMIZE
Once happy with your clip, select your desired frames per second (FPS) and output resolution (720 or 1080). You can remove the watermark and outro video.
DOWNLOAD
Once you’ve clicked compile, open this app and log in with Twitch to see all your clips in one place. Download, delete, or share your clips on different platforms. You will also receive an email notification when your clip has finished compiling.
SHARE
On each video, you’ll have the option to share directly to TikTok and other platforms when they’re available. 
Happy clipping!
Privacy Policy: https://streamlabs.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://streamlabs.com/terms

Coloring Book is an entertaining game for toddlers. With its help, children can bring a black-and-white world to colorful life with their own fingers! The koala, the sloth, the crocodile, the robot and all the others can't wait to let their colors show!
No need to worry about your child drawing on the walls with markers or colored pencils! With Coloring Book, you don't need those. All children need are their own fingers, and they can do everything themselves!
As one of the default settings, the game uses auto-fill, which colors each space neatly. For older children, you can turn on paintbrush mode. Even adults can enjoy Coloring Book. Coloring is so much fun!
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
By subscribing, you get unlimited access to all the drawings in the application.
Terms of Use: https://neiman.tilda.ws/coloring-book-terms
If you have any questions or requests, please write to neumandev@gmail.com. We are eager to hear your comments on how to improve the app.

bluejetty:00065345:ios.name: Summit Credit Union
bluejetty:00065345:ios.summary: We’re all about improving your financial life AND how it makes you feel! With our free app full of tools to easily manage your total financial picture, feel more confident and stress-free overall. Summit (and this app!) will help you build
bluejetty:00065345:ios.description:
We’re all about improving your financial life AND how it makes you feel! With our free app full of tools to easily manage your total financial picture, feel more confident and stress-free overall. Summit (and this app!) will help you build wealth and financial security every step of the way.
Feel connected
· Get a total view of all your Summit accounts.
· See all transactions together seamlessly, including credit card purchases. 
· View all your account activity, balances and statements.
Feel in control
· Transfer money between your Summit and outside accounts.
· Pay bills on the go with Bill Pay built right into the app. 
· Send money to family and friends – fast and easy with Zelle®. 
· Schedule one-time and recurring bill payments.
· Deposit checks with a fast photo from your phone – easily with mobile deposit.
Feel motivated
· Set goals and track your progress, monitor spending, get alerts and more.
· Create and name sub-savings accounts for different goals to celebrate your progress.
· Set credit and debit card spending limits to reach your budget goals. 
Feel secure
· Manage security and balance alerts for your accounts.
· Turn debit and credit cards “off” when lost or not in use, and “on” again.
· Be alerted fast to potential unauthorized debit and credit card transactions with automatic, ongoing fraud monitoring.
· Get advanced security features, like multi-factor authentication on each login. 
· Use biometric login (face and fingerprint ID) on supported devices
Feel supported
· Find the closest Summit branch or surcharge-free ATM (lots to choose from!).
· Send secure messages to us with questions or anything you need.
· Schedule a phone or in-person appointment with us.
If you have questions, we’re just a tap away!
Visit us at SummitCreditUnion.com for complete details. 
(Summit Credit Union is based in Wisconsin.)

Solve the mystery and tricks and help them return to their home!
Find the bread in the candy forest after clearing!
Can you find them all?

・There are many cute animals!
・Easy to start for first players. Let’s challenge!

・Search by tapping the screen.

・Keeping the enlarged item, you can tap another item, and then compose it.
・There is a hint button from MENU which is the upper left corner of the screen.

bluejetty:00183973:ios.description:
Hey Banco es un banco 100% digital. Pone en una App todos los productos que esperas de un banco tradicional. Con Hey puedes manejar tu tarjeta de débito, de crédito, tus ahorros, inversiones y más cuando quieras desde tu teléfono móvil. 
Abre tu cuenta desde tu celular y maneja tu dinero con el respaldo de un banco protegido por el IPAB. Invierte con tasas siempre altas y obtén una tarjeta de crédito sin anualidad, con recompensas en efectivo y con tarjeta virtual para mayor seguridad. 
Además, obtén las herramientas y la información que necesitas para tomar mejores decisiones financieras, ya sea para construir o mejorar tu historial crediticio, formar hábitos de ahorro o profundizar en las herramientas de inversión.
Cuenta Hey
Abre tu cuenta en minutos desde tu celular, donde quiera que estés. Tu Cuenta Hey no tiene un monto mínimo de apertura ni una renta mensual, y te permite:
realizar transferencias 24/7 desde donde quiera que estés, 
hacer compras en línea con tu Tarjeta Virtual
bloquear o desbloquear tu tarjeta desde la App
obtener una Tarjeta Dual con diseños exclusivos
Tarjeta de Crédito Hey
Una tarjeta de crédito con tasa preferencial y sin anualidad que puedes solicitar desde tu celular.
Tasa preferencial
Sin anualidad de por vida
Recompensas en efectivo 
Compras a Meses Sin Intereses
Tarjeta virtual para compras en línea
Acceso a promociones exclusivas
Ahorro Hey
Forma buenos hábitos de ahorro programando tu Ahorro Hey desde tu celular y obtén excelentes rendimientos con la seguridad del respaldo del IPAB. Con Ahorro Hey puedes: 
establecer hasta 5 metas de ahorro
programar depósitos semanales, quincenales o mensuales
obtener siempre excelentes rendimientos. 
También puedes programar que se deposite a tus ahorros el equivalente a un porcentaje de lo que gastas y combatir los efectos de los gastos hormiga. 
Inversión Hey
Haz crecer tu dinero con una inversión a 7 días y desbloquea una tasa aún más alta por usar tu Tarjeta de Débito o Tarjeta de Crédito. Reinvierte, actualiza o retira de tu inversión desde tu celular. 
Fondos Hey y Capitales Hey
Invierte tu dinero en fondos diversificados diseñados por Hey Banco o crea tu propio portafolio de inversiones. Tus inversiones están integradas a tu Cuenta Hey y las puedes administrar desde tu celular.

Contrata un seguro respaldado por Chubb en minutos desde tu celular.

bluejetty:00079845:ios.description:
Every cats from Dear My Cat embarks on a journey on the beautiful Sky Island.
Dear My Cat is a relaxing game that helps in relaxation and calm sleeping. 
The game is full of endearing cats and colourful backdrops by adding a dreamlike quality to the experience.
Are you suffer from insomnia and anxiety? Improve mood, ease anxiety and stress with adorable cats.
It will fit relaxation into a busy schedule. Busy life, open mind by relaxing chill out game - Dear My Cat!
-Expand and decorate your peaceful Sky Island
>Expand Sky Island and unlock the new destination
>You can create new animals including dog, whale, raccoon by unlocking the new destination
>Each destination has various theme-thermal spring, ramen shop, campsite.
>Beautiful relaxing music for stress releif. You can change the background music for each seasons. 
The high quality soothing sounds will help you relieve your stress and anxiety.
-Easy and simple clicker game! Anti-stress!
>Dear My Cat is idle game, which is very easy to play and offers a low-pressure experience. No stress!
>The game allows you to continue playing game without needing to perform the initial action. Just enjoy and watch!
>The easy clicker game which is free for everyone and anyone can play anywhere.
>You can easily collect adorable cats-even when you're not playing!
>Loads of mini game and puzzle game will be updated every month!
>You can bask in a sense of relaxation while watching over the little critters as they take part in their activities-fishing, campfire, napping and so on. It create calm, mental stillness, and peace of mind.
-Relieve your stress and anxiety while decorating the Sky Island
>FREE island decoration & Island improvement game. 
>Decorate island for moggies with various of deco items,
>You can freely change the theme of island.
>You can visit your friend's island. Show off your island to your friends!
>Craft accessories to gift to your furry friends, and expand the island so they can have a larger environment.
If you are one of these gamers, download the game now!
- A cat lover wanting to raise cats
- The best relaxing animal game for animal lovers!
- Cat moms and dads who wants more cats
- Students or workers who need some rest right now
- Those looking for cute animal games or cat games
- Those looking for relaxing games, idle games or roleplay games
- Those who can’t stop saying “Cats are cute

bluejetty:00100030:ios.description:
Merge Sticker Story innovatively combines stickers with merging mechanics, creating a richer and more enjoyable gaming experience.
1.Merge and Match
Blend vibrant stickers with engaging color-matching and sorting mechanics to unlock new pages. Experience the satisfaction of solving each puzzle by merging pieces together.
2.Innovative Coloring Experience
Forget traditional coloring! Use stickers to bring designs to life in a paint-by-number style. It’s a creative twist that lets you fill each page with beautiful, colorful designs.
3.Diverse Themes and Puzzles
Discover a wide range of themes, including nature, animals, and iconic landmarks. Each page presents a unique puzzle that challenges your problem-solving skills and rewards you with stunning artwork.
4.Perfect for All Ages
Whether you're a kid or an adult, Merge Sticker Story offers fun for everyone. Enjoy a calm solo experience or team up with friends and family for some puzzle-solving fun!
5.Sticker Mastery Awaits
Unlock rewards and achievements as you progress. Merge stickers, match colors, and watch your collection grow with every level you complete.
6.Relaxing ASMR Gameplay
Immerse yourself in a soothing environment with calming visuals and gameplay, combining merging, coloring, and puzzle-solving into one relaxing adventure.

-- This is an newer upgraded stand alone version of the existing old app (www.simpleprospectmanager.com) which has already been installed by 14K users --
SW SW SW? SW => Some will, Some wont, So what? Some where Six will.
We Love Network marketing!
Being in network marketing industry we know how valuable your time is..why not use it for building your business? and let us help you automate your prospect tracking as much as possible and be your Tracking genie!
But is this app only for Network marketing or Direct Selling users? 
No. We have customized it in a way anyone in any Small Medium business can use it. 
This is a one stop CRM or Lead manager app for Network marketing Leaders, Users or Sales Leader to Manage or Track contacts.
Why Simple Prospect for your Network marketing or Small Medium business?
- No more Clutter in your Phone Book with hundreds of unqualified prospects. No more need to maintain an excel list of contacts!
- Simple and very Affordable for a price of coffee or less than your literature pack or CD which never comes back! (Free version available too!)
- Track your prospects and keep your prospects list separate from Phone Book or together with Phone Book. !
- Assign your prospect into any custom categories, tags, buckets or groups. whatever you want to name it.
- Import your existing contacts from PHONE BOOK and EXCEL
- Create followup events for your leads with just couple of taps and send semi automated reminder text to your prospects!
- Get a historical log or notes of a prospect with a easy tap and access it from multiple place in the app.
- Network marketing users - Track your client and manage your team. Create Getting started checklist for your New down lines.
-Export your existing contacts to EXCEL
-Send messages with existing text templates or create a brand new template text.
- MLM users - Set goals for your Presentations and Prospect list and track it from dashboard.
- EASY to learn! No Lengthy tutorials.
- Back up your contacts in the cloud. We value privacy very seriously!
- Try and evaluate it for up to 2 months free of premium version!
Additional Details:
Who Can use Simple Prospect Manager?
- Leaders, IBO or from MLM, Network Marketing or Direct Sales Business
- Call center Teams
- Life Insurance Sales
- IBOs for AMWAY
- Consultants for Herbalife Business
- IBOs for ACN
- Roden + Fields
- Real Estate Professionals
- Sales teams in all organizations
- World Ventures, Usana, BWW, World wide group, 4Life, Marykay, Avon, Ambit or any network marketing Business
Download
Download the App today and Try for Free and get upgraded to Premium version automatically for a limited time!!
Support
Email: helpsimpleprospects@gmail.com
Website: https://www.simpleprospect.app
FAQ: https://www.simpleprospect.app
Common question:
Can I import the data from my old app to this newer app?
No, This is NOT built as an update for the old simple prospect manager app for 2 reasons. 
1. The infrastructure of the old and new app is completely different which makes it very complicated to migrate the data as in the old app the data is currently saved in users device and we do not have any control on it. 
2. we did not make this as an update to the app because if we do, all the users data from the old users app will be completely lost.
WHAT IS THE WORK AROUND TO IMPORT FROM OLD APP?
One thing user can do is export the data from old app from all the categories into excel. and import it again to the new app and when you import it assign the same category name that you used before in the old app.
*About Premium billing*:
If you choose to purchase Premium, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can choose to be billed monthly or annually. You can turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID Account Settings any time after purchase.

bluejetty:00145262:ios.description:
GO Count Object - Your Ultimate Thing Counter
GO Count Object -Things Counter is a smart, automatic counting app that accurately detects and counts items through photos, streamlining your workflow in seconds. This next-level productivity tool offers businesses and individuals the most precise and efficient counting solution on the market. Leveraging advanced object recognition technology, users can effortlessly count items directly through their device camera. 
Whether you're in construction, logistics, manufacturing, or any other field, GO Count Things is designed to save you time, reduce manual errors, and boost your productivity. Experience the future of counting—fast, easy, and reliable.
**COUNT ANY TYPE OF OBJECT—SIMPLY AND EFFECTIVELY** 
This advanced counter is incredibly easy to use yet makes a significant impact in industries and businesses alike. Whether you're in manufacturing, construction, retail, or warehouse management, GO Count Object is designed to meet your needs. Constructors, merchandisers, storekeepers, wholesalers, and more can unlock its full potential and streamline their workflows. GO Count Object handles an impressive variety of items with precision—pills, tablets, pipes, bricks, coins, metal rods, and beyond. No matter the challenge, this powerful app ensures fast, accurate counts, saving time and eliminating manual errors.
**COUNT ITEMS IN SECONDS** 
With this pocket-sized counting app, getting accurate results is fast and effortless. Simply snap a photo of the items you want to count, select one of them, and the app will do the rest—automatically calculating the total. Need adjustments? You can easily add or remove items manually to fine-tune the results to your liking.
**VERSATILE OBJECT RECOGNITION** 
Count Things - Pill Count excels at identifying and counting an extensive range of objects—whether it's products on a shelf or birds in the sky. This flexibility makes it an invaluable tool for diverse scenarios, adapting seamlessly to both personal and professional needs.
**PHOTO ANALYSIS**
Upload any photo from your gallery, and GO Count Things will accurately analyze and count the objects within it. Perfect for post-event reviews or working with saved images, this feature ensures you never miss a detail. 
**DETAILED REPORTS**
Receive comprehensive breakdowns of your counts, including object types and quantities. Easily export reports in multiple formats for seamless record-keeping, sharing, or deeper analysis.
**SHAREABLE RESULTS**
Effortlessly share your counting outcomes with colleagues, friends, or on social media with just a few taps, keeping everyone in the loop.
**SAVE TIME, EFFORT, AND ENERGY**
GO Count Object isn’t just for industrial use—it’s a game-changer for everyday tasks too. Planning to build your dream house? The app will help you quickly count bricks, planks, logs, metal pipes, and other essential materials. 
Are you a home-based wholesaler aiming to scale your business by selling products like tomatoes, eggs, or other goods? With GO Count Object, you can streamline your operations and reach the market faster. Just download the app and unlock your entrepreneurial potential with ease!
Email:macflamedev@outlook.com
Privacy Policy:https://counter.rgb-radio.com/privacy
Terms:https://counter.rgb-radio.com/term

bluejetty:00174994:ios.name: Weather Strip
bluejetty:00174994:ios.summary:
The quickest way to see when to go outside.
This beautifully crafted app and widget bundle shows forecasted clouds, rain, snow, wind, auroras, rainbows, and other weather phenomena in a compact timeline that's easy to understand at a glanc
bluejetty:00174994:ios.description:
The quickest way to see when to go outside.
This beautifully crafted app and widget bundle shows forecasted clouds, rain, snow, wind, auroras, rainbows, and other weather phenomena in a compact timeline that's easy to understand at a glance.
Innovative features include:
• Extreme weather warnings are shown directly on the timeline, so you can see exactly when the danger is expected — including thunderstorms, fires, hurricanes, flooding, and landslides.
• Includes 23 remarkably detailed widgets for the home screen, lock screen, desktop, and StandBy.
• Minute-by-minute precipitation forecasts show the next-hour conditions derived from radar stations.
• Air quality forecasts combine local sensor readings to provide health guidance.
• Our proprietary algorithm even predicts the chance of rainbows!
Use the interactive map to request forecasts for any location in the world — including mountains, trails, lakes, and literally anywhere you place a marker.
We take privacy seriously with NO ads, NO tracking, and NO third-party analytics. Weather Strip only stores location data on your local device, and it always uses approximate locations when requesting weather forecasts.
Weather Strip also respects your data plan, with optional background app refresh that automatically learns your habits, and the ability to view your recent forecasts even when your connection drops.
Weather Strip is completely free to try for two weeks. After that, a minimal subscription price helps us keep the service running. (Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.)
Not all features are available in all locations. Forecasts are issued by Foreca and Apple Weather globally and by the U.S. National Weather Service (NOAA NWS) in the United States.
Designed by data visualization researcher Robin Stewart to help everyone enjoy the outdoors.

bluejetty:00163201:ios.description:
Besoin d’un avis médical rapidement et votre médecin n’est pas disponible ? Qare, c’est une équipe de médecins disponibles en moins de 15 minutes*, et plus de 23 spécialités médicales accessibles. Avec Qare, accédez à une téléconsultation vidéo avec un médecin en moins de 15 minutes*.
Première clinique digitale de France, Qare est agréée par le Ministère de la Santé depuis 2024. Qare réunit plus de 2 500 médecins, inscrits à l’Ordre des Médecins et formés à la téléconsultation. Depuis 2017, 3 millions de patients ont téléconsulté sur Qare et 97% sont satisfaits.
Avec Qare, vous pouvez choisir une consultation en ligne avec ou sans RDV. A l’issue de la consultation en visio et si nécessaire, vous recevez une ordonnance valable dans toutes les pharmacies de France, ainsi que vos documents médicaux dans votre espace patient sécurisé. Les téléconsultations sur Qare sont remboursables* par l’Assurance Maladie lorsque le parcours de soins est respecté.
Qare vous accompagne également pour la santé mentale et la gestion du poids avec des programmes personnalisés quotidiens.***
Qare, votre réflexe pour votre santé physique et mentale 
· Consultez un médecin en ligne en moins de 15 minutes*
· Avec ou sans rendez-vous,
· Téléconsultation vidéo remboursable par l’Assurance Maladie**
· Pour la santé du quotidien, la santé mentale et la gestion du poids
· Programmes d’accompagnement personnalisés en santé mentale et en gestion du poids***
· Service agréé par le Ministère de la Santé
· Ordonnances et documents médicaux sécurisés disponibles dans votre espace patient
· Généralistes et spécialistes, inscrits à l’Ordre des Médecins en France
· Suivi possible avec le même médecin
· Support patient réactif 7j/7 (réponse en 2 minutes en moyenne)
Une équipe de médecins de 23 spécialités rapidement et facilement accessibles
· Médecin généraliste
· Pédiatre
· Gynécologue
· Dermatologue
· Psychiatre
· Et de nombreux autres spécialistes
L’exigence médicale au service de tous
· Société de téléconsultation agréée par le Ministère de la Santé
· Créée en 2017 avec des médecins
· 3 millions de patients ont téléconsulté
· 9 millions de téléconsultations réalisées
· 97% de patients satisfaits
· Données de santé sécurisées
Avec Qare, vous pouvez
· Consulter rapidement un généraliste ou un spécialiste
· Obtenir un avis médical sans se déplacer
· Renouveler une ordonnance si nécessaire
· Suivre une maladie chronique quand votre médecin le juge adapté
· Obtenir un second avis médical 
· Bénéficier d’un suivi personnalisé et quotidien en santé mentale***
· Être accompagné(e) dans la gestion de son poids***
Exemples de motifs
· Médecin généraliste : infection urinaire, maladies chroniques, migraine, allergies saisonnières, suivi vaccinal, éruptions, IST, maux de gorge, troubles digestifs, rhinopharyngite…
· Psychiatre : stress, surmenage, burn-out, anxiété, phobies…
· Pédiatre : conjonctivite, alimentation, poux, varicelle…
· Gynécologue : SPM, grossesse, endométriose, mycoses, infections urinaires, vaginose, IST…
· Dermatologue : acné, eczéma, éruptions, démangeaisons…
· Addictologue : arrêt du tabac, réduction/arrêt alcool…
· Nutritionniste : gestion du poids, diabète, hypercholestérolémie, intolérances alimentaires…
Téléchargez Qare dès maintenant pour prendre soin de votre santé simplement et en toute confiance quand votre médecin n’est pas dispo.
Notes et mentions
* Moyenne septembre 2025, téléconsultations sans rendez-vous, médecine générale. Le délai peut varier selon l’affluence, la spécialité et l’heure.
** Lorsque le parcours de soins est respecté par le patient. Des frais non remboursables peuvent s’appliquer selon les services choisis.
*** Programme payant optionnel, non remboursable par la Sécurité Sociale et n'inclut pas de téléconsultations médicales

bluejetty:00065846:ios.summary: It’s vacation time! Hop into your camper van, ready your caravan, polish your minibus! Get out of your house and begin the adventure today. Feel the summer breeze and prepare for a fun ride! Now updated with 5 new cars and 25 new missions!
bluejetty:00065846:ios.description:
It’s vacation time! Hop into your camper van, ready your caravan, polish your minibus! Get out of your house and begin the adventure today. Feel the summer breeze and prepare for a fun ride! Now updated with 5 new cars and 25 new missions!
FEATURES:
▶ BEAUTIFUL OUTDOOR ENVIRONMENT - eye-catching, sunny locales
▶ 15 UNIQUE CARS (5 brand new!) - each providing a different driving experience!
▶ REALISTIC TRAFFIC - be careful not to crush the massive vehicle you’re driving
▶ PRO MISSIONS TO COMPLETE - huge campaign to beat, earn in-game money for your progress
Camper Van Beach Resort features multiple different cars, each of them suited for a weekend getaway as well as long-term camping. Can you drive them around with style and precision required? If you want to earn your time in the sun you will have to give it your best!
You will drive campers, caravans, minibuses and even a boat trailer. The game features a wide selection of different cars. Each one of them has to be handled with care and precision.
Most of the time the narrow passages and roadside obstacles will be all of your problems. But the game also features realistic traffic that has to be taken into account. Remember – you’re driving a massive vehicle. You don’t want to crash it!
Drive around crowded campsites, avoiding tents and leftover equipment. Behold the magnificent view of the beach as you pass through tight oceanside routes. The game features beautiful sunny locales which make driving around a true pleasure.
The Main Game Mode is 100% FREE to play, all the way through, no strings attached! Extra Game Modes which alter the rules slightly to make the game easier are available through optional In-App Purchases. Each mode has separate leaderboards to make for totally fair competition!

- Remove unwanted frames instantly

Creative Overlays & Styling Tools
- Add your own Logo for personalized branding
- Colored or Patterned Backgrounds

- Sketch with Pen Drawing
High-Quality Export & Social Optimization
Share your creations instantly with optimized file sizes and the highest possible quality.

bluejetty:00015512:ios.description:
Trusted by 10 million students worldwide. New school year, all in one place — build your schedule, track homework, and let Scout help you plan and stay on top of it all.
MyStudyLife is the #1 student planner — trusted by over 10 million students across 187 countries to organize classes, manage homework, track grades, and prepare for exams.
"Staying organized is a critical part of being a disciplined student, and the MyStudyLife app is an excellent organizer." — The New York Times
"MyStudyLife offers a comprehensive palette of schedules, timetables and personalized notifications" — Forbes
Whether you're starting a new semester in high school with a rotating schedule, heading off to college, or juggling lectures, labs, and deadlines at university, MyStudyLife brings your entire academic life together in one place.
SCOUT: YOUR AI STUDY COACH
Meet Scout, MyStudyLife's new AI Study Coach. Ask Scout to help plan your studying, track your workload, or figure out how to organize your week — plus reminders to keep you on track.
SMART CLASS SCHEDULER
Build your class schedule in minutes, with support for weekly & rotating schedules. View your daily and weekly calendar with color-coded classes, assignments, and exams.
HOMEWORK PLANNER & TASK MANAGER
Stay on top of every assignment by organizing tasks, setting deadlines, creating subtasks, and receiving timely reminders. Track recurring coursework each semester.
GRADE TRACKING
Log your grades and assessments as you go, so you always know where you stand and what it'll take to hit your target GPA.
EXAM TRACKER & STUDY PLANNER
Plan ahead for exams with study schedules and reminders. Spread your study sessions over time to reduce stress and improve preparation.
FOCUS TIMER
Boost productivity with the built-in Focus timer. Study in focused intervals while building healthier study habits.
XTRA PLANNER
Organize extracurriculars, clubs, sports, volunteering, part-time jobs, and personal commitments — not just school.
FAMILY CONNECT
Share your schedule with a parent or guardian. Family Connect keeps everyone informed while students stay in control of what they share.
SYNC EVERYWHERE
Your classes, assignments, exams, and schedules stay synced across every device automatically.
WIDGETS & PERSONALIZATION
See upcoming classes and deadlines from your Home Screen widgets. Light and Dark Mode included.
FEATURES
Scout: AI Study Coach for studying, workload & reminders
Schedule Scan: add your timetable from a photo
Weekly and rotating class schedules
Homework planner with reminders and priorities
Grade tracking and GPA overview
Exam calendar and study planner
Subtasks for complex assignments
Built-in Focus timer
Xtra Planner for extracurricular activities
iCal calendar synchronization
Home Screen widgets
WHY STUDENTS CHOOSE MYSTUDYLIFE
Built specifically for students and designed with executive function in mind — not a generic calendar or paper planner.
Download MyStudyLife today and start the new school year organized.
MYSTUDYLIFE+ & FAMILY CONNECT SUBSCRIPTIONS
Free to download. Optional auto-renewing subscriptions unlock premium features:
• MyStudyLife+ (Individual): $6.99/month or $39.99/year ($3.33/mo equivalent)
• Family Connect, 1 Student: $9.99/month or $59.99/year ($5.00/mo equivalent)
• Family Connect, 2 Students: $14.99/month or $89.99/year ($7.50/mo equivalent)
• Family Connect, 3-5 Students: $19.99/month or $119.99/year ($10.00/mo equivalent)
Prices shown in USD; may vary by region.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time from your Apple ID Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://www.mystudylife.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00083018:ios.description:
Preglife is the go-to app for pregnancy, postpartum and early child development. We provide evidence-based content from experts in an accessible and inclusive way, to enable well-informed and empowered decisions in a time of information overload. We are the midwife in your pocket!
Expecting a child, giving birth, and becoming a parent are among life's most significant changes, both physically and mentally. That's why we've developed the ultimate app for you, your child, and your potential partner, all to ensure you have a safe and well-informed time.
All content in the app is fact-checked by specialists. Preglife collaborates with an international network of midwives and doctors.
Pregnancy App
► Personalized content about your pregnancy and your baby's development
► Articles with detailed information about the baby in the womb, diet and nutrition during pregnancy, recommendations from the Public Health Agency regarding vaccines, and much more
► 3 different podcasts with expert advice on childbirth and parenthood
► Guides on important topics such as breastfeeding, car seats, insurance, and vaccinations
► Partner category for tips and advice for the partner and activities to do together
During your pregnancy
► Pregnancy calendar - Follow your pregnancy and your baby's development week by week
► Fruit comparison - Each new week of pregnancy displays a fruit or vegetable symbolizing the baby's size
► Checklist - for everything important to remember
► Contraction timer - Time contractions when the time comes
► Vaccination guide - Keep track of recommended and free vaccines
► Free online childbirth classes in Swedish and English
Exercise with Mumfulness - content created by experts for your well-being
Regular exercise helps you feel good when you're expecting a child. In Mumfulness, you can access a wide range of safe and fun exercise sessions, yoga classes, and guided meditations that you can use during pregnancy and the first stages of parenthood.
Preglife Connect
Don't forget to download Preglife Connect, our app designed for parents like you to meet other parents.
Good luck with your pregnancy and parenthood. We are with you every step of the way! Feel free to reach out if you have any questions or feedback: info@preglife.com.
► Follow us on social media
• Instagram: instagram.com/preglife

listings.description:
Preglife is the go-to app for pregnancy, postpartum and early child development. We provide evidence-based content from experts in an accessible and inclusive way, to enable well-informed and empowered decisions in a time of information overload. We are the midwife in your pocket!

Expecting a child, giving birth, and becoming a parent are among life's most significant changes, both physically and mentally. That's why we've developed the ultimate app for you, your child, and your potential partner, all to ensure you have a safe and well-informed time.

All content in the app is fact-checked by specialists. Preglife collaborates with an international network of midwives and doctors.

Pregnancy App

► Personalized content about your pregnancy and your baby's development
► Articles with detailed information about the baby in the womb, diet and nutrition during pregnancy, recommendations from the Public Health Agency regarding vaccines, and much more
► 3 different podcasts with expert advice on childbirth and parenthood
► Guides on important topics such as breastfeeding, car seats, insurance, and vaccinations
► Partner category for tips and advice for the partner and activities to do together

During your pregnancy

► Pregnancy calendar - Follow your pregnancy and your baby's development week by week
► Fruit comparison - Each new week of pregnancy displays a fruit or vegetable symbolizing the baby's size
► Checklist - for everything important to remember
► Contraction timer - Time contractions when the time comes
► Vaccination guide - Keep track of recommended and free vaccines
► Free online childbirth classes in Swedish and English

Exercise with Mumfulness - content created by experts for your well-being

Regular exercise helps you feel good when you're expecting a child. In Mumfulness, you can access a wide range of safe and fun exercise sessions, yoga classes, and guided meditations that you can use during pregnancy and the first stages of parenthood.

Preglife Connect

Don't forget to download Preglife Connect, our app designed for parents like you to meet other parents.

Good luck with your pregnancy and parenthood. We are with you every step of the way! Feel free to reach out if you have any questions or feedback: info@preglife.com.

bluejetty:00142774:ios.description:
Guitar Tuner Master is a free, professional-grade tuning app designed for musicians of all levels. It’s not just a tuner for a wide range of string instruments—it also helps you learn new chords and rediscover old ones. For guitarists of any skill level, it’s the simplest, fastest, and most accurate tuning app available!
Perfect for tuning ukuleles, guitars, violins, guzheng, erhu, pianos, pipa, cellos, guqin, kalimbas, and other chord-based instruments.
Features:
- Precision Tuning: Real-time pitch detection with accurate results, aligned with international pitch standards and minimal tuning error.
- Auto Tuning: Simply pluck a string or press a key, and the app will instantly display the current pitch for quick tuning.
- Manual Tuning: Select the specific string or key you want to tune for targeted adjustments.
- Guitar Simulator: Nylon guitar, steel guitar, jazz guitar, and clean guitar—experience realistic playing simulations.
 - Solo Mode: Choose from different guitar types and freely play your favorite notes.
 - Chord Mode: Explore various chord combinations—a great way to practice and quickly become a guitar expert.
- hord Dictionary & Practice:
Offers multiple chord demonstrations and smart practice features to make chord transitions smooth and efficient.
UNLIMITED ACCESS SUBSCRIPTION
- No ads
- Play guitar use any chord
- Support any types of guitars
- Unlock 1000+ guitar chord
- Reverse guitar chord finder
- practice tools anytime
- The subscriptions are $2.99 monthly with free trial
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that service, where applicable

bluejetty:00123544:ios.description:
Paleo (io) is the best paleo food list in the world – Never google "is ____ paleo?" again!
Simply type in the food you are curious about into the search box and the app will tell you whether or not that food is paleo. 
Paleo (io) helps thousands of people discover which foods are paleo every day.
Have you ever seen a food and asked yourself, "is it paleo?" Well now you can have the answer faster than ever before with the best "is it paleo" app around! Never use google again with Paleo (io) in your pocket.
OVERVIEW 
• Paleo.io searches over 3,000 food items to identify which foods are paleo and which foods are not
• Easily stick to the paleo diet without driving yourself crazy – Paleo.io makes the paleo diet easy!
• Simple yes & no paleo food lists
• Perfect to bring to the grocery store, use as a reference guide or check a food on-the-go
• Food list reviewed & audited by Amy Kubal, paleo dietician
• In-depth articles explaining why a specific food is or is not paleo (in the more info section)
• Are we missing a food? Email us and we'll add it to our database!
• Brought to you by the team at Ultimate Paleo Guide
WHAT OTHERS ARE SAYING (5 STAR REVIEWS)
"This app is a really straightforward and easy way to learn about eating paleo. I like how the articles don't beat around the bush and get to the facts quickly, especially since Im reading them on my phone and want answers fast…" – JillB1987
"For beginners like me – AWESOME! I'm new to Paleo and this app is really convenient and easy to use…" – Ray S.
"I love this app. It's always been a little hard to figure out exactly what I can and can't eat, especially when I eat out with friends. This app has made it SO easy to pick what to eat. Super fast, and designed beautifully. Thanks!" – ekuck87
"This app is such a fast resource. As you type in the foods it shows the results with a fast thumbs up or down. Quite a thorough list as well…" – Deb R.
MAIN FEATURES 
• Paleo made easy! Simply search for a food and know whether or not it is paleo with the best paleo food list app around
• Search through over 3,000 different food items
• Intuitive design – green thumbs up means its paleo, red thumbs down means its not paleo
• "More info" button shows you why a food is paleo and enables you to be your own food detective and determine if a food is paleo or not
WHAT IS PALEO?
Although its often called a "diet," paleo is simply a different way of looking at how you eat food. Paleo is actually quite simple.
The paleo diet is focused on eating food that has been around since the Paleolithic era. That's why the paleo diet is also known as the caveman diet. Its focused on eating nutrient-dense, whole, unprocessed foods that are easy for your body to digest.
Put the power of paleo in your pocket, and stay paleo out there! 
Built with Love in Texas by IMPOSSIBLE ® 
Have a food you want to see in this app? Email us at foods@paleo.io and we'll add it to our database!

Happy doctor is one of the most famous time management games and also one of the top hospital games, where the only priority is to cure the patient because we believe the only wealth is health. Just Step into the bustling world of the happy hospital games and become a compassionate nurse in medical games by providing exceptional care of ear cleaning and beauty care to the patients of all ages. 
The doctor games have an addictive gameplay of asmr games! Our Hospital games offer a rewarding experience for those seeking to experience the challenges and joys of working in a happy hospital of the dentist games.
If you want to manage a dream team of professional asmr doctors in a crazy hospital, our time management games are the right game for you. While playing doctor games you will also be able to decorate your own Happy Hospital! Are you still waiting? Dive in and open the doors of this hospital asmr simulator in your own happy clinic!

Get Most exciting and Unique events in our hospital games.
Design and build your own happy hospital with different themes.
Enjoy the most addictive time management games gameplay.
Experience different type of patients and diseases in our doctor games.
Cure patients in your crazy hospital with a variety of medicine and latest technology.
In our medical games hire multiple doctors from different countries to treat your patients better.
In our hospital asmr simulator build your own happy clinic.
Get endless mode for extreme level fun in our hospital asmr games.
Engaging levels are also available in our nurse games.

Manage Medications: Keep track of the medications and ensure patients in our doctor games. 
Emergency Situations: Be prepared for unexpected emergencies and Handle critical cases and stabilize patients in our hospital games.
Expand Hospital Facilities: Upgrade your happy hospital equipments like pimple remover or other tests machines to accommodate a growing number of patients in our medical games. 
Hire and Train Staff: Recruit skilled happy doctors, nurses for beauty care, popping pimples and support staff to work in your crazy hospital. 
To get the best experience, build advanced research centers, where different doctors can research on different diseases in our hospital asmr games. With this type of addictive gameplay, happy hospital becomes the most exciting hospital game which is best for time management games enthusiasts!
Play now and experience a unique, fun and casual hospital asmr simulator!
Follow us on Facebook for the latest updates. Visit our Facebook page at https://www.facebook.com/happydoctorasmr

The official Les 3 Vallées app helps you plan and enjoy your mountain stay.
Find all the essential information about Les 3 Vallées and its seven resorts: Courchevel, Méribel, Brides-les-Bains, Les Menuires, Saint-Martin-de-Belleville, Val Thorens, and Orelle.

- Pass purchase
- 3-day weather forecast
- Webcams
- Open and closed status of ski lifts, slopes, and inter-resort links
- Restaurants and available points of interest
- Important live information notifications
In winter, make the most of your ski day with live resort information:
- Ski map
- Slope grooming information
- Mountain restaurants
In summer, explore the destination with useful information for your outdoor activities:
- Hiking and trail running routes
- Mountain bike, e-bike, and cycling trails
Simple and intuitive, Les 3 Vallées Official gives you quick access to the key information you need to find your way, check conditions, and make the most of your stay in the world’s largest ski area.

bluejetty:00015714:ios.description:
Smart Optometry is #1 choice for eye care professionals around the world! Give your patients’ best care with 15 FREE INTERACTIVE, PRECISE and SIMPLE eye exams in 9 languages. Join 100.000+ eye care specialists using Smart Optometry for eye examinations!
Why should your customers undergo the same tests they always go through when they have their eyes tested? Why should this advanced industry stick with old and outdated practices?
Smart Optometry includes 15 TESTS are available for FREE:
– Colour Vision
– Contrast
– Visual Acuity
– Worth Four Dot 
– Schober
– OKN Stripes
– Flourescin Light
– Red Desaturation
– Hirschberg
– Accommodation
– Duochrome
– Aniseikonia
– Amsler Grid
– MEM Retinoscopy
– Visual Acuity +
To help you make your work simpler, we also included 2 CALCULATORS:
– Vertex Conversion
– Visual Acuity Conversion
Because we know language barrier can be a problem, we localised our application to 11 LANGUAGES: English, Spanish, German, French, Russian, Italian, Polish, Norwegian, Czech, Croatian and Slovenian! Want your language added? Let us know at: info@smart-optometry.com.
Still not convinced? Read what sets us apart!
Our solution is SIMPLE to use!
Eye screening and testing shouldn’t be difficult and inconvenient for neither practitioner or customer! Smart Optometry application is very simple to use: just select the test, read through short guidelines for performing the test, execute it and let our application give you the basic diagnosis – final result or point you in the direction of possible problems that need more thorough examinations!
Tests are FAST!
While you are filling out paperwork for a patient, he or she can already test his or her eyesight with basic tests provided by Smart Optometry application. There is no logistics involved in performing the tests: just pick up your iPad and test-away!
Results provided are PRECISE and reliable!
Eye testing and screening often requires eye-care professionals to make calculations – giving the room for error. Eliminate this risk with precise calculations and interpretations done by our Smart Optometry application. Our tests are as precise if not more than the currently used on-the-wall testing equipment.
All tests are INTERACTIVE and fun!
Wouldn’t it be easier to let patients do the things you ask them, rather than try to explain what they see to you? Smart Optometry application is uniquely interactive: user presses buttons, draws on the screen and this way provides precise results – while having fun! Interactive handling with the Smart Optometry application also enables it to give you result interpretations.

bluejetty:00024632:ios.summary: Stay in touch with friends and family. Enjoy the security and connectivity of global messaging with the Garmin Messenger™ app. Pair with your compatible inReach® satellite communicator for fast, easy direct messaging and interactive SOS tha
bluejetty:00024632:ios.description:
Stay in touch with friends and family. Enjoy the security and connectivity of global messaging with the Garmin Messenger™ app. Pair with your compatible inReach® satellite communicator for fast, easy direct messaging and interactive SOS that’s not limited to cellphone coverage areas (active satellite subscription required). The app supports group messaging as well as photo and voice messaging when paired with a compatible Garmin device (1). Automatic switching between internet, cellular, and satellite networks gives you the best connectivity and efficiency for all your messaging. When you have connectivity, the app will work seamlessly even if your inReach device is turned off. Invite your friends and family to download the app to stay connected and keep the conversation going on and off the trail. With the use of the LiveTrack™ feature, loved ones can follow your location in real time (2) and see data such as distance, time and elevation. 
(1) See compatible devices at garmin.com/p/893837#devices
(2) When used with your compatible smartphone and the Garmin Earthmate® app or when used with your compatible inReach® technology-enabled Garmin device.
Note: Some jurisdictions regulate or prohibit the use of satellite communication devices. It is the responsibility of the user to know and follow all applicable laws in the jurisdictions where the device is intended to be used.

bluejetty:00171670:ios.description:
Phần mềm KQXS xem kết quả xổ số trực tiếp dùng tra cứu kết quả xổ số 3 miền (XS3M) hàng ngày: Xổ số miền Bắc, xổ số miền Nam, xổ số miền Trung nhanh nhất và chính xác nhất. Sau đây là lịch tường thuật trực tiếp kết quả sổ xố minh ngọc các ngày trong tuần để các bạn tiện theo dõi
1. Xổ số kiến thiết miền Bắc XSMB, SXMB, KQXSMB
Thứ 2: XSTD, XSHN
Thứ 3: XSQN, Xổ số quảng Ninh
Thứ 4: XSBN, xổ số Bắc Ninh
Thứ 5: Xổ số thủ đô Hà Nội
Thứ 6: XSHP, xổ số hải phòng
Thứ 7: XSND, xổ số Nam định
CN: XSTB, xổ số thái bình
2. Xổ số kiến thiết miền Nam XSMN, SXMN minh ngọc , KQXSMN
Mở thưởng ngày thứ 2: 
Xổ số đài thành phố Hồ Chí Minh XSTP HCM, 
Xổ số Đồng tháp XSDT, 
Xổ số Cà mau XSCM
Thứ 3: 
Xổ số bà rịa vũng tàu XSVT, 
Xổ số Bến tre XSBT, 
Xổ số Bạc liêu XSBL
Thứ 4: 
Xổ số đồng Nai XSDN, 
Xổ số Cần thơ XSCT, 
Xổ số Sóc Trăng XSST
Thứ 5: 
Xổ số Tây Ninh XSTN, SXTN
Xổ số An Giang XSAG, SXAG
Xổ số Bình thuận XSBTH, SXBTH
Thứ 6: 
Xổ số Bình Dương XSBD, SXBD
Xổ số Trà Vinh XSTV, SXTV
Xổ số Vĩnh Long XSVL, SXTV
Thứ 7: 
Xổ số đài thành phố XSTPHCM, SXHCM 
Xổ số Long An XSLA, SXLA
Xổ số Bình Phước XSBP, SXBP
Xổ số Hậu Giang XSHG, SXHG
Chủ Nhật: 
Xổ số đà Lạt - Lâm đồng XSDL,
Xổ số Kiên giang XSKG, 
Xổ số Tiền Giang XSTG
Nếu bạn muốn dò kết quả xổ số miền Tây thì bao gồm những tỉnh sau: Long An, Tiền Giang, Vĩnh Long, Bến Tre, Đồng Tháp, Trà Vinh, An Giang, Cần Thơ, Hậu Giang, Bạc Liêu, Sóc Trăng, Kiên Giang và Cà Mau
Xổ số miền Đông gồm có tỉnh sau: Bình Dương, bà Rịa Vũng Tàu, TP HCM, Bình Phước, Đồng Nai, Tây Ninh
3. Xổ số kiến thiết miền Trung XSMT, SXMT, KQXSMT
Thứ 2: 
Xổ số Phú Yên XSPY, 
Xổ số Huế XSTTH, XSHUE
Thứ 3: 
Xổ số Đắk Lắk XSDLK,
Xổ số Quảng Nam XSQNM
Thứ 4: 
Xổ số Đà Nẵng XSDNG, SXDNG
Xổ số Khánh Hoà XSKH, SXKH
Thứ 5: 
Xổ số Quảng Trị XSQT, 
Xổ số Quảng Bình XSQB, 
Xổ số Bình Định XSBDI
Thứ 6: 
Xổ số Gia Lai XSGL, 
Xổ số Ninh Thuận XSNT
Thứ 7: 
Xổ số Đà Nẵng XSDNG, 
Xổ số Quảng Ngãi XSQNG, 
Xổ số Đắc Nông XSDNO
Chủ nhật: 
Xổ số Khánh Hoà XSKH, 
Xổ số Kon Tum XSKT, SXKT
Kết quả xổ số Vietlott Mega 6/45 thứ 4,6, chủ nhật hàng tuần
Kết quả xổ số điện toán tự chọn Vietlott Max 4d thứ 3, 5, 7 hàng tuần
4. Thống kê lô gan - lô khan kết quả xổ số miền Bắc, các tỉnh xổ số miền Nam và miền Trung đưa ra các bộ số lâu chưa về nhất và dễ ăn nhất
5. Quay thử KQXS miền Bắc, các tỉnh miền Nam, miền trung giúp bạn quay thử lấy những số may mắn (lấy hên) trong ngày.
Bên cạnh cho phép tra cứu ket qua xo so ngày hôm nay, phần mềm cho phép xem nhanh KQSX mới nhất theo các ngày kèm theo thống kê đầu đuôi
Khi có kết quả mới nhất, phần mềm sẽ báo cho khách hàng bằng âm thanh và hiệu ứng rung rất thuận tiện để theo dõi. Phần mềm hoàn toàn miễn phí, dung lượng nhỏ, mượt thích hợp mọi dòng máy và nhanh hơn rất nhiều các ứng dụng xổ số việt, xosoviet, xo so live

bluejetty:00150923:ios.description:
Welcome to Manulife Vitality
Ready to start your journey towards a healthier, happier life?
Manulife Vitality is all about helping members live healthy, earn rewards, and save money. And with the Manulife Vitality app, you can keep track of all the little steps you take towards a healthier you and enjoy all program’s benefits and rewards! From your smartphone you can:
Check in your goals and Vitality Points™
Monitor your progress towards your weekly goal to unlock rewards
Log a workout using GPS*
Submit proof of a completed activity (e.g 5K, dental check-up, etc…)
Enjoy the daily newsfeed with hot tips to help you live a healthier life
Link to Apple’s Health app to sync data via iPhone or Apple Watch
*Some features, like gym visits, may require GPS location services. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
The app is available for anyone to download, but you must have a Manulife insurance policy with Manulife Vitality and register on the website before you can log in. Once you’ve registered, you’ll use your Manulife Vitality website log in to sign into this app.

bluejetty:00183121:ios.description:
Can you become the best basketball player in the world?
Basketball Superstar focuses on character development rather than quick reflexes. You start the game as at 18 year old free agent and play until you retire. What happens in-between is up to you!
IMPROVE YOUR ABILITIES
As you gain experience, you can upgrade abilities that suit your playing style. Perhaps you focus on becoming an all-out attacker with amazing shot-making skills or maybe you improve the metal side you your game so that you keep a cool head when the pressure is on?
CONTROL YOUR DESTINY
As your reputation improves, you will gain the attention of bigger and better teams. Do you stay loyal to your current team or move on? Do you move for money or sign for your favourite team? Are you ready to make the jump to the professional game? It’s up to you...
PLAYER CONTRACTS
Negotiate contracts to ensure you get the deal you deserve! Perhaps you add a bonus for reaching the play-offs or for becoming the team MVP? You need to make sure you get the deal you want, after all, if you are good at something never do it for free!
HELP IS AT HAND
One thing is for sure, you’ll need help. Hire agents, coaches, stylist and various other people to help you become more than just a player. After all, there's endorsement deals awaiting the right player!
ARE YOU THE BEST
From over 10,000 players, you can see your progression from rookie all the way to veteran. Can you reach the top and become the All-Star MVP?
Prove it…

bluejetty:00113629:ios.description:
Play these thrilling soccer games and rise to become a soccer star on the field. 
Assemble your ultimate team, wear your kits with pride, and play with professional tactics to score goals and win all soccer matches. Whether you're playing in career mode or representing your national team, the experience of becoming a hero is within your reach. Live your dream of a champion and win the league with your strategic shots.
Unleash the power of your team and show the world which nation has the best soccer players. With your strategic shots, professional tactics and skills, you'll dominate the field and lead your dream team to victory in every match, season after season. So put on your soccer kits, kick the ball, and win the hearts of fans in stadiums around the world, all the way to the semi-finals and finals.
Get acquainted with controls with Basics, and put on your kits for tournaments and other soccer events.
GAME MODES
CAREER INCLUDES
- Next match - Play soccer matches, improve your league progress, and move up to the better league.
- Team management - Be a soccer manager and edit your players.
- Statistics - Follow your team's progress and statistics.
- Season objectives - Complete 4 objectives during each soccer season.
EVENTS INCLUDE
- Daily Challenges - A set of 5 challenges every day.
- Champions Cup - The best European teams meet every year to win the cup.
- Europa - Win the cup which is held every 4 years in Europe.
- Copa Del Sur - Compete with the best South American teams.
- Tournament - Triumph soccer matches of 32 national teams.
Train hard, come to the field, and triumph over all your opponents in every match to become a soccer legend. Score goal after goal with your precision passing, dribbling, and shooting skills. Master your penalties, free-kicks, and corner kicks with ease, while always staying alert to avoid getting caught offside. And if it comes down to a penalty shootout, respect the referee and trust your goalkeeper to make the crucial saves.
As a forward, midfielder, or defender, you will be a crucial part of your team's success on the field. So work together with your teammates and always be ready to make that crucial pass, tackle, or interception that can make you a soccer star. Or even score a hat trick or win the Golden Boot!
From the first whistle of the soccer season to the final match of the championship, this game has everything for you to become a true soccer legend. Whether you're playing in a league or tournament, dressing up in your ultimate team colors or just kicking the ball, it is a chance to lead your team to victory.
Work on your ball control, passing accuracy, and shooting precision, and get ready for all the tournaments. Whether you're playing in career mode, representing your national team, or leading your club to the championship, win every match. So step onto the field, and let your goals speak for themselves.
Play soccer games and lead your team to glory in prestigious league tournaments. Win every match, show your talents on the field, score goals, and earn the recognition of soccer fans and fellow players alike. Make a name in the competitive world of soccer. So grab your ball, hit the field, and become the soccer legend you were born to be!

Read, Organize, and Sync Your PDF eBooks Effortlessly
PDF Library is the ultimate solution for reading long-form PDF documents and eBooks. Seamlessly manage, organize, and sync your PDF collection across all your devices, ensuring you have easy access wherever you are.

- Home Screen Widgets: Instantly access recent PDFs right from your home screen.

- Auto-Save Reading Progress: Your place is saved automatically, so you’ll never lose track of where you left off.
- Flexible Reading Modes: Read in Single-Page or Continuous mode, with both horizontal and vertical scrolling options.
- Sepia Reading Mode: Reduce eye strain with a warm, soft color filter that provides a gentler reading experience.
- Easy Navigation: Use the built-in Table of Contents for quick jumps to sections within any document.
Organize Your PDF Library:
- Track Reading Status: Mark PDFs as "Read Next", "Finished", or add them to your Favourites list for easy access.
- Archive Documents: Clear up your Library by moving completed or inactive PDFs to the Archive.
PDF Library Pro – Unlock Advanced Features:
Enjoy PDF Library free with no limits on the number of PDFs you can store. Upgrade to PDF Library Pro with a one-time purchase to enhance your reading experience and support independent app development.
Pro Features Include:
- Organize into Collections: Create personalized Collections to group and sort your PDFs.
- Edit Titles & Authors: Customize your Library’s display by editing document titles and authors.
- Change Cover Art: Update the cover images of your PDFs for better organization and visual appeal.
PDF Library Pro supports Family Sharing – so you can share these advanced features with your family members at no extra cost!
PDF Library is perfect for students, researchers, and professionals. Whether you're at uni, working on university papers, or diving into educational ebooks and scientific research, PDF Library makes reading and managing your documents effortless. With features designed to streamline your workflow, it's ideal for organizing class notes, research papers, and ebooks for study or work.

izzyondroid:tf.charles.droid.alarme.name: Alarm
izzyondroid:tf.charles.droid.alarme.summary: An alarm clock with sunrise simulation and scheduling based on your calendars
izzyondroid:tf.charles.droid.alarme.description:
An alarm clock that adapts to your routine and your calendars.
 Wake up gently with sunrise simulation lighting and gradually increasing sound volume. Set your alarms to repeat on selected days of the week, and use your calendars to decide when they should ring.
 Features:
 Sunrise simulation lighting for a gentle wake-up.
 Gradually increasing alarm volume.
 Support for the external screen on Samsung Galaxy Z Flip phones.
 Alarms that repeat on selected days of the week.
 Calendar rules that enable or silence an alarm depending on events currently in progress in a selected calendar.
 Use your calendars to add exceptions to your routine. For example, record your holidays in a dedicated calendar and set your alarm to stay silent whenever an event in that calendar is in progress.
 You can also do the opposite: allow an alarm to ring only when an event is in progress in a particular calendar. Adapt your wake-up schedule to your working days or activities.
 External screen support may also work on other foldable flip phones, but compatibility with these devices has not been tested.
